Passionate about travel? Build your career with industry expertise and staff benefits.", "content2": "

Tour Planner & Travel Consultant

Kija Travel is seeking an experienced Tour Planner & Travel Consultant to join our growing team in Bali. This is a full-time, office-based position for someone with proven experience in the travel industry who is passionate about creating exceptional travel experiences.

Important: This role is Wednesday to Sunday, with Monday and Tuesday as your regular days off, to provide weekend operational support. Please do not apply if you are unable to commit to this permanent work schedule. Preference will be given to applicants who are available to start immediately.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design customised travel itineraries for FIT, leisure, group and corporate clients.

  • Plan and book flights, accommodation, transfers, tours and other travel services.

  • Use Sabre and other reservation systems to manage flight bookings and ticketing.

  • Prepare quotations, itineraries and travel documentation.

  • Liaise with hotels, airlines, tour operators and suppliers to secure the best rates and services.

  • Manage bookings from enquiry through to travel completion.

  • Assist clients with travel advice, visa requirements, travel insurance and destination information.

  • Work closely with the sales and operations teams to deliver exceptional customer service.

What We're Looking For

  • Minimum 3 years' experience in a travel agency, tour operator or wholesale travel company.

  • Experience using Sabre is essential. Experience with Amadeus, Galileo or other airline and travel booking systems is highly regarded.

  • Strong knowledge of international travel planning, flight ticketing and tour operations.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple bookings simultaneously.

  • Excellent customer service, communication and problem-solving skills.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and general computer applications.

  • A positive attitude, attention to detail and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

  • Applicants available for an immediate start will be given preference.

Why Join Kija Travel?

  • Competitive salary based on experience.

  • Career growth and development opportunities.

  • Friendly and supportive team environment.

  • Staff travel opportunities.

  • Office-based position in Bali with a growing travel company.

About Kija Travel

Kija Travel is a Bali-based Destination Management Company specialising in customised travel experiences throughout Indonesia and beyond. We provide complete travel solutions including flights, accommodation, tours, transportation, travel insurance and destination management services, delivering exceptional service to both B2B and B2C clients.

Apply Now

If you have the experience and passion to join our team, we'd love to hear from you.

Please send your CV and Cover Letter to ••••@kija.travel.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

  • Mengelola seluruh proses rekrutmen, mulai dari posting lowongan hingga onboarding Karyawan Baru

jobs.title: Partnership Development Officer
jobs.description: Deskripsi pekerjaan Kami mencari team untuk melakukan Pengembangan dan juga Ekspansi Business yang berpengalaman untuk bergabung dengan Hamaren Education Center di Kalijati, Jawa Barat. Sebagai Staf Partnership Development , Anda akan memainkan peran strategis dalam merancang dan mengimplementasikan inisiatif pengembangan organisasi yang berkelanjutan. Posisi ini merupakan kontrak dan memerlukan profesional yang mampu mengidentifikasi peluang pertumbuhan, menganalisis kebutuhan stakeholder, dan merumuskan strategi yang sejalan dengan visi perusahaan. Anda akan bekerja secara langsung di lokasi Kalijati, Jawa Barat, dengan fokus pada perencanaan strategis dan eksekusi program pengembangan yang berdampak positif bagi institusi pendidikan kami. Tanggung Jawab Utama Mengidentifikasi peluang pengembangan dan area pertumbuhan yang strategis untuk mendukung ekspansi dan peningkatan kualitas layanan pendidikan Merancang dan mengembangkan rencana strategis jangka pendek dan jangka panjang yang sejalan dengan visi dan misi Hamaren Education Center. Melakukan riset pasar dan analisis mendalam terhadap tren industri pendidikan untuk menginformasikan keputusan strategis. Berkolaborasi dengan departemen internal dan pemangku kepentingan eksternal untuk memastikan implementasi strategi yang efektif dan terkoordinasi. Memantau dan mengevaluasi kemajuan program pengembangan terhadap target yang telah ditetapkan. Menyiapkan laporan analitik dan presentasi strategis untuk Internal Mengidentifikasi dan mengelola risiko potensial yang dapat mempengaruhi pencapaian tujuan strategis organisasi. Deskripsi pekerjaan

Kami mencari team untuk melakukan Pengembangan dan juga Ekspansi Business yang berpengalaman untuk bergabung dengan Hamaren Education Center di Kalijati, Jawa Barat. Sebagai Staf Partnership Development, Anda akan memainkan peran strategis dalam merancang dan mengimplementasikan inisiatif pengembangan organisasi yang berkelanjutan. Posisi ini merupakan kontrak dan memerlukan profesional yang mampu mengidentifikasi peluang pertumbuhan, menganalisis kebutuhan stakeholder, dan merumuskan strategi yang sejalan dengan visi perusahaan. Anda akan bekerja secara langsung di lokasi Kalijati, Jawa Barat, dengan fokus pada perencanaan strategis dan eksekusi program pengembangan yang berdampak positif bagi institusi pendidikan kami.

Tanggung Jawab Utama

  1. Mengidentifikasi peluang pengembangan dan area pertumbuhan yang strategis untuk mendukung ekspansi dan peningkatan kualitas layanan pendidikan

  2. Merancang dan mengembangkan rencana strategis jangka pendek dan jangka panjang yang sejalan dengan visi dan misi Hamaren Education Center.

  3. Melakukan riset pasar dan analisis mendalam terhadap tren industri pendidikan untuk menginformasikan keputusan strategis.

  4. Berkolaborasi dengan departemen internal dan pemangku kepentingan eksternal untuk memastikan implementasi strategi yang efektif dan terkoordinasi.

  5. Memantau dan mengevaluasi kemajuan program pengembangan terhadap target yang telah ditetapkan.

  6. Menyiapkan laporan analitik dan presentasi strategis untuk Internal

  7. Mengidentifikasi dan mengelola risiko potensial yang dapat mempengaruhi pencapaian tujuan strategis organisasi.

Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan

  1. Pendidikan minimal SMA/SMK (Berpengalaman) atau Sarjana (S1) dalam bidang Manajemen, Strategi Bisnis, Perencanaan Pembangunan, atau disiplin ilmu terkait lainnya.

  4. Pemahaman mendalam tentang sektor pendidikan dan dinamika institusi pendidikan di Indonesia (lebih disukai)

  5. Kemampuan analisis data yang kuat dengan keahlian dalam menggunakan tools analitik dan spreadsheet canggih.

  6. Keterampilan komunikasi dan presentasi yang excellent untuk menyampaikan strategi kompleks kepada berbagai audiens.

  7. Kemampuan manajemen proyek yang solid dengan pengalaman dalam melacak dan melaporkan progress inisiatif strategis.

  8. Kemampuan berpikir kritis dan problem solving yang baik dalam menghadapi tantangan bisnis yang kompleks.

Benefit

1. Competitive Salary
2. Performance Incentive
3. Operasional Allowance
4. BPJS Kesehatan & Ketenagakerjaan
5. Kesempatan belajar lebih dalam mengenai industri dan budaya kerja Jepang
6. Lingkungan kerja yang kolaboratif dan suportif

Wujudkan dampak positif bersama kami.", "content2": "

Kami mencari team untuk melakukan Pengembangan dan juga Ekspansi Business yang berpengalaman untuk bergabung dengan Hamaren Education Center di Kalijati, Jawa Barat. Sebagai Staf Partnership Development, Anda akan memainkan peran strategis dalam merancang dan mengimplementasikan inisiatif pengembangan organisasi yang berkelanjutan. Posisi ini merupakan kontrak dan memerlukan profesional yang mampu mengidentifikasi peluang pertumbuhan, menganalisis kebutuhan stakeholder, dan merumuskan strategi yang sejalan dengan visi perusahaan. Anda akan bekerja secara langsung di lokasi Kalijati, Jawa Barat, dengan fokus pada perencanaan strategis dan eksekusi program pengembangan yang berdampak positif bagi institusi pendidikan kami.

Tanggung Jawab Utama

  1. Mengidentifikasi peluang pengembangan dan area pertumbuhan yang strategis untuk mendukung ekspansi dan peningkatan kualitas layanan pendidikan

  2. Merancang dan mengembangkan rencana strategis jangka pendek dan jangka panjang yang sejalan dengan visi dan misi Hamaren Education Center.

  3. Melakukan riset pasar dan analisis mendalam terhadap tren industri pendidikan untuk menginformasikan keputusan strategis.

  4. Berkolaborasi dengan departemen internal dan pemangku kepentingan eksternal untuk memastikan implementasi strategi yang efektif dan terkoordinasi.

  5. Memantau dan mengevaluasi kemajuan program pengembangan terhadap target yang telah ditetapkan.

  6. Menyiapkan laporan analitik dan presentasi strategis untuk Internal

  7. Mengidentifikasi dan mengelola risiko potensial yang dapat mempengaruhi pencapaian tujuan strategis organisasi.

Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan

  1. Pendidikan minimal SMA/SMK (Berpengalaman) atau Sarjana (S1) dalam bidang Manajemen, Strategi Bisnis, Perencanaan Pembangunan, atau disiplin ilmu terkait lainnya.

  2. Minimal 1-3 tahun pengalaman dalam peran pengembangan strategis, perencanaan bisnis, atau konsultasi strategi.

  3. Memiliki pengalaman di bidang Marketing, Partnership, Canvassing, atau Business Development (lebih disukai)

  4. Pemahaman mendalam tentang sektor pendidikan dan dinamika institusi pendidikan di Indonesia (lebih disukai)

  5. Kemampuan analisis data yang kuat dengan keahlian dalam menggunakan tools analitik dan spreadsheet canggih.

  6. Keterampilan komunikasi dan presentasi yang excellent untuk menyampaikan strategi kompleks kepada berbagai audiens.

  7. Kemampuan manajemen proyek yang solid dengan pengalaman dalam melacak dan melaporkan progress inisiatif strategis.

  8. Kemampuan berpikir kritis dan problem solving yang baik dalam menghadapi tantangan bisnis yang kompleks.

Benefit

1. Competitive Salary
2. Performance Incentive
3. Operasional Allowance
4. BPJS Kesehatan & Ketenagakerjaan
5. Kesempatan belajar lebih dalam mengenai industri dan budaya kerja Jepang
6. Lingkungan kerja yang kolaboratif dan suportif

jobs.title: Finance Accounting Tax Manager
jobs.description: We are Retail company based on Jakarta, we need FAT Manager with detail job Descriptions as below: Job Responsibilities To oversee company's financial operations and maintain proper accounting system in accordance with PSAK (Indonesian Accounting Standards). To ensure accuracy and completeness of accounting records across all financial functions. To prepare monthly management reports and perform financial analysis on the performance of the company. To review & monitors AP/AR/GL/Stock Inventory Movement To manage cash flow to ensure efficient use of fund and adequate working capital. To handle statutory submissions including annual financial audit, transfer pricing documentation, corporate tax and withholding tax returns. To ensure compliance with Indonesian tax regulations (VAT, PPh 21/23/25/26, etc.) and to handle application of tax incentives. To liaise with local authorities, customs, and related government agencies for licensing, importation of goods and compliance matters. To support Management in budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning. To perform other ad-hoc duties as assigned by Management. To support management to provide profit and lost report Qualifications: Proven track at the same role Has 5 years experience as FAT Manager Education background from Bachelor Degree in FAT Major Strong understanding of accounting principles and financial reporting. Having knowledge of tax regulations and compliance requirements. Proficiency in accounting software (e.g., QuickBooks, SAP, Accurate) and Microsoft Office, particularly Excel. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. Strong attention to detail and accuracy. Effective communication and interpersonal skills. Able to speak English fluently Able to manage team and able to collaborate with cross function department regarding budgeting Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

jobs.title: Asisten Pabrik - Palm Oil Mill
jobs.description: DESKRIPSI PEKERJAAN Mengawasi, menganalisis, dan memastikan kualitas produk, meliputi Crude Palm Oil (CPO), palm kernel, dan shell , sesuai dengan standar perusahaan. Memantau efisiensi proses produksi serta kualitas air dan limbah guna mendukung kelancaran operasional dan pencapaian target perusahaan. Menjalankan dan mengawasi kegiatan operasional laboratorium pabrik sesuai dengan Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) yang berlaku. Memastikan akurasi hasil pengujian, pencatatan data laboratorium, dan pelaporan hasil analisis secara tepat waktu. KUALIFIKASI KHUSUS Pendidikan minimal S1 Teknik Kimia . Memiliki pengalaman minimal 3 tahun sebagai Asisten Laboratorium , khususnya di industri pengolahan kelapa sawit. Memahami proses analisis mutu CPO, palm kernel, shell, air, dan limbah. Teliti, analitis, serta mampu bekerja sesuai dengan prosedur dan target operasional. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 3 tahun di posisi Asisten di Pabrik Kelapa Sawit, khususnya di bagian Laboratorium Bersedia ditempatkan dan dimutasi ke seluruh areal operasional perusahaan.

jobs.title: Sales Engineer, HVAC
jobs.description: Who we are: Build your best future with the Johnson Controls team As a global leader in smart, healthy and sustainable buildings, our mission is to reimagine the performance of buildings to serve people, places and the planet. Join a winning team that enables you to build your best future! Our teams are uniquely positioned to support a multitude of industries across the globe. You will have the opportunity to develop yourself through meaningful work projects and learning opportunities. We strive to provide our employees with an experience, focused on supporting their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing. Become a member of the Johnson Controls family and thrive in an empowering company culture where your voice and ideas will be heard – your next great opportunity is just a few clicks away! What you will do? As a Sales Engineer, HVAC at JCI, you will be responsible for driving sales of our innovative Fire Control Security solutions to both new and existing customers. Your role will include understanding customer needs, developing tailored solutions, and effectively communicating and presenting these solutions to stakeholders. You will work closely with the sales team to convert leads into opportunities, ensuring customer satisfaction and adherence to sales targets. How you will do it: Study product knowledge and company working procedures, continuously improving domain knowledge of product, company and industry. Plan annual secured order strategy aligned with Department goal. Achieve business sales target with YOY growth expectation in the region. Prepare and issue tenders and proposals to customers. Lead negotiation and/or bidding activity at optimum profit levels to the company. Close orders to achieve the goals and targets assigned. Responsible for payment collection. Provide monthly reporting on assigned vertical secured and revenue attainment as well as nonfinancial reporting to the management team. Be proactive to liaise, develop relationships and influence customer(s) to maintain a long-term service relationship, ensure customer satisfaction at high level. Develop sales leads and identify customer requirements. Monitor and collect competitors’ activities in the market and report periodically directed by the company. Independently develop and follow up the projects to provide solutions for customers. Compliance with Johnson Controls’ policies and procedures at all times. To obtain an effective understanding of York products and offers, to produce and supply quotations to suit customer requirements. To maintain constant field intelligence, feeds back pertinent information concerning competitors’ activities, products, prices, promotional programs and results as applied to York and competitive activities. To liaise with sales / service administrator and finance department pertaining to the computerize system, timely collection of payments (Credit Officer) from customers, credit issues and maintaining good customer credit profile. To update all customers on all York product information and offers. What we look for: Minimum Degree in Mechanical / Electrical / Electronic Engineering or equivalent. At least 1-2years of experience as Sales in HVAC (chiller), pump, cooling tower - open for fresh graduate Experience in selling products to contractors, consultants, or company owners, and in handling projects. Knowledge of Building HVAC, Fire Protection, Controls would be preferred. Experience in Building industry would be preferred. Basic understanding of SAP operations will be advantageous. Personal qualities of the candidate: ambition, good understanding in project, and good relationship with contractor, consultant, or company’s owner. #LI-AA3

As a global leader in smart, healthy and sustainable buildings, our mission is to reimagine the performance of buildings to serve people, places and the planet. Benefit

• GF (2 digit)

• Bonus/komisi tindakan

jobs.title: QC Warehouse Fresh – Bogor
jobs.description: Tanggung Jawab : - Melakukan pemeriksaan kualitas produk fresh/frozen pada proses Inbound, Inventory, hingga Outbound. - Memimpin dan mengoordinasikan tim QC (±5 orang) dalam pelaksanaan kegiatan inspeksi harian. - Mengidentifikasi dan menindaklanjuti permasalahan yang berkaitan dengan kualitas produk. - Membuat laporan hasil pemeriksaan dan dokumentasi kualitas secara detail dan akurat. - Memastikan penerapan standar GHP, GWP, GMP, FIFO/FEFO, dan Leading Time di area kerja. - Berkoordinasi dengan tim gudang dan operasional untuk menjaga mutu dan keamanan produk. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively in English. Passionate about health, fitness, and delivering exceptional guest experiences. A team player with a professional attitude, strong work ethic, and attention to safety and guest well-being. jobs.title: HEAD TEACHER
jobs.description: We are hiring for Head Teacher Role for our Preschool and Daycare programs in Green Lake City and Puri Cengkareng site to support the learning of children from 1-6 Y.O. As a Head Teacher at Circle Time, you’ll lead learning at the center, supporting teachers, guiding classrooms, and keeping our teaching joyful, high-quality, and consistent every day. Key Responsibilities: Teach, plan and deliver engaging, age-appropriate learning activities. Ensure teaching quality through daily classroom presence and supervision. Maintain curriculum fidelity by validating lesson plans and managing implementation. Support teacher development with coaching, mentoring, and ongoing feedback. Facilitate reflections & evaluations to improve teaching and learning practices. Partner with the Center Director on children’s learning and development progress Lead and motivate the teaching team with empathy and clarity. Check and ensure the report is delivered in English and following learning objectives Lead the school event with clear instruction and structure What we are looking for: 1. Traits Aligned with our values for love of learning, healthy habits, and excellence. Passionate about early childhood education, especially child-centric learning. Communication and collaboration skills—building trust is key 2. Skills and Competencies Strong in strategic and classroom management skills Ability to coach, mentor, and motivate teachers with empathy and clarity. Skilled in collaborative lesson planning, reflection facilitation, and problem-solving. Good documentation, reporting, and communication skills (verbal and written in English and Indonesian Language). Comfortable working with digital tools (e.g., lesson planners, observation forms, Google Workspace). 3. Foundation in Education Min. Bachelor Degree in Education (or related fields: Psychology, Family Studies, etc.) Knowledge of various pedagogical approaches (e.g., Montessori, thematic learning). Min. 2 years of teaching experience Min. 1 year of leadership experience 4. English Fluency Sufficient to lead class in English and comfortable in basic daily conversation. Can be proven with any of the following: At least 1 yr teaching in English class or English-speaking school English test score (TOEFL, IELTS, TOEIC, etc.) or English course certification Experience overseas (living, studying, working) 5. [Optional] Additional Certifications Certification in Montessori Certification from education, psychology, health & nutrition workshop or course

jobs.title: Houseman Daily Worker (Raffles Residences)
jobs.description: Company Description A global luxury brand with hospitality at its heart, Raffles Hotels & Resorts encompasses 20 ultra luxury hotels and resorts in key international destinations, some with additional branded private residences. Four further hotel properties will open under the Raffles brand in 2024-25. Named after the pioneering British founder of Singapore, Sir Stamford Raffles, the Raffles brand is synonymous with the elegant British etiquette, effortless glamour and sophistication of an earlier era, while bringing a sensibility that is in tune with the lives of our well-travelled guests – at once a vibrant heart and a tranquil haven. At Raffles our service style is warm, personalised and gracious, with a legendary spirit of generosity embodied by our signature Raffles Butlers. We have led the way in creating hotel interiors that are art museums in their own right; we are fertile ground for creativity in the culinary arts, attracting leading chefs; and we work with expert practitioners and specialist partners to create next-generation wellness experiences. We have always sought to preserve both cultural and natural heritage, employing historians, marine biologists and art curators within the properties, to underline an experience that is truly authentic. At Raffles, visitors arrive as guests, leave as friends and return as family. Along the way they will discover a place to celebrate, adventure, exchange ideas and be inspired; and a new meaning of luxury that touches the emotions as elegantly as the Raffles name itself. Raffles Jakarta is strategically located in the heart of the Kuningan district within Jakarta's Golden Triangle. It is an art-filled oasis that elegantly blends history, culture, and luxury. The hotel is more than just a place to stay; it's a meeting point for art and ideas, business and leisure, glamour and fashion. Connected to Lotte Shopping Avenue and the Ciputra Artpreneur Centre, home to The Hendra Gunawan Museum, and a 1,200-seat Broadway Musical Theatre, our location is ideal for both local and international guests, offering convenience and a wealth of cultural experiences. The hotel offers exceptional facilities, including the serene Raffles Spa, a tranquil outdoor pool, versatile meeting spaces, and a state-of-the-art fitness centre, providing luxury and comfort. At Raffles Jakarta, we pride ourselves on our dedicated team, who excel in delivering exceptional service and attention to detail. Founded by Dr. (HC) Ir. Ciputra, our hotel brings the legacy of renowned Indonesian artist Hendra Gunawan to life through our magnificent interiors. We are deeply committed to sustainability and community engagement, striving to minimize our environmental impact and actively support the local community. By choosing Raffles Jakarta, you do not just work at a luxury hotel but also support a hotel that cares about the local community. By joining our team, you will join a community that values excellence, creativity, and sustainability. Embark on a rewarding career journey with Raffles Jakarta and contribute to our art, history, and luxury legacy. Job Description The Houseman – Residences is responsible for supporting the overall cleanliness, presentation, and upkeep of the Residences, ensuring that common areas, corridors, and public spaces are consistently maintained to the highest standards. The role performs a variety of housekeeping duties, including cleaning and vacuuming, dusting and polishing surfaces, replenishing supplies, and supporting the movement and arrangement of housekeeping equipment and items. Working closely with the Housekeeping team, the Houseman – Residences contributes to creating a welcoming, comfortable, and well-presented environment for residents and visitors. With attention to detail, reliability, and a strong sense of teamwork, the position plays an important role in maintaining the high standards of service and presentation expected at Raffles Residences. Qualifications Education: A high school diploma or equivalent is required. Additional education or vocational training in hospitality, housekeeping, or a related field is an advantage. Experience: Previous working or internship experience in Housekeeping or a similar role within the hospitality industry is preferred. Experience in a luxury hotel or residences environment will be an advantage. Physical Fitness: Physically fit and able to perform physically demanding tasks, including lifting and moving items and carrying out repetitive activities safely and effectively. Attention to Detail: Strong attention to detail with a keen eye for cleanliness and presentation, ensuring all areas are consistently maintained to high standards. Teamwork and Communication Skills: Good teamwork and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with Housekeeping colleagues and other departments to ensure smooth coordination and daily operations. Knowledge and Skills: Good understanding of housekeeping practices, cleanliness standards, and safety procedures. Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks effectively. Professionalism and Attitude: Professional, reliable, and flexible, with a positive attitude, strong work ethic, and commitment to maintaining high standards of service and presentation.

jobs.title: People and Culture Manager
jobs.description: Company Description Located in the heart of Alam Sutera, Mercure Serpong Alam Sutera is situated between EMC Hospital and Living World Shopping Mall, at the center of the lifestyle, entertainment and gastronomical hub. Our 171 stylish rooms and modern facilities make our hotel ideal for both business and leisure travellers. Discover Alam Sutera, well known as the best town for cycling and jogging with a green and healthy environment. Explore the culinary indulgence, entertainment and shopping experience, such as Flavor Bliss, Living World, IKEA, and Mall @Alam Sutera. Join a hotel that is a member of the Accor network, whose group brings together more than 45 brands, 5,500 hotels, 10,000 restaurants and lifestyle destinations. Here, we believe in you and what you bring to the table. There are many opportunities for development and advancement. Every gesture, every smile, every action, contributes to creating a positive and memorable impact for our customers, our colleagues and also for our planet. Together, we embody the vision of responsible hospitality. Take the opportunity to become a Heartist®, and let your heart guide you in this world were life beats faster. Job Description The People & Culture Manager is responsible for leading all People & Culture functions within the hotel, ensuring compliance with company policies and local labour regulations while fostering a positive Heartist experience. This role oversees recruitment, talent development, employee engagement, performance management, payroll administration, industrial relations, and organizational culture to support the hotel's operational and business objectives. Key Responsibilities 1. Recruitment & Talent Acquisition Develop and execute recruitment strategies to attract qualified talent. Manage the full recruitment cycle, including sourcing, interviewing, selection, onboarding, and orientation. Maintain talent pipelines for critical positions. Ensure all recruitment activities comply with company standards and employment regulations. 2. Learning & Development Develop the annual training plan and training calendar. Coordinate onboarding and orientation programs for new Heartists. Identify training needs through performance reviews and operational requirements. Monitor mandatory training completion and learning compliance. Promote continuous learning and career development. 3. Performance Management Coordinate the annual performance review process. Support department heads in setting goals and evaluating employee performance. Monitor completion of performance appraisals and development plans. Provide coaching and guidance to managers on performance improvement. 4. Employee Engagement & Culture Lead employee engagement initiatives and recognition programs. Organize employee activities, celebrations, wellness, and CSR programs. Conduct employee surveys and develop action plans based on feedback. Foster an inclusive, respectful, and high-performing workplace culture. 5. Employee Relations & Industrial Relations Handle employee grievances and disciplinary cases fairly and professionally. Ensure compliance with labor laws, company policies, and employment contracts. Maintain positive relationships with employees, government agencies, and external stakeholders. Support dispute resolution and conflict management. 6. Compensation & Benefits Oversee payroll preparation and ensure timely salary processing. Administer employee benefits, insurance, leave, and attendance. Maintain accurate employee records and HRIS data. Support salary benchmarking and compensation reviews. 7. Compliance & Administration Ensure compliance with labor legislation and company standards. Maintain personnel files and confidential employee documentation. Prepare HR reports, manpower analysis, and monthly P&C reports. Manage employee contracts, probation reviews, confirmations, and separations. 8. Talent Management & Succession Planning Identify high-potential employees and future leaders. Coordinate succession planning and career development initiatives. Support talent review discussions with department leaders. Monitor internal promotions and career progression. 9. Health, Safety & Wellbeing Promote workplace health, safety, and employee wellbeing initiatives. Ensure compliance with occupational health and safety requirements. Support emergency response planning and employee awareness programs. 10. Budget & Strategic Planning Prepare and manage the annual People & Culture budget. Monitor departmental expenses. Contribute to the hotel's strategic planning and organizational development initiatives. Recommend improvements to HR policies and processes. Qualifications •Minimum 3 years of experience in Learning & Development, Human Resources, or People & Culture, preferably in the hospitality industry. •Strong knowledge of training management, payroll administration, and HR systems, with excellent analytical and organizational skills. •Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence, coach, and collaborate across all levels of the organization. Additional Information Your team and working environment: Our commitment to Diversity & Inclusion: We are an inclusive company and our ambition is to attract, recruit and promote diverse talent. Diversity & Inclusion for Accor means welcoming each and everyone and respecting their differences by giving priority only to qualities and skills in extending employment and development opportunities. Our ambition is to provide meaningful employment, a warm and welcoming culture, excellent working conditions and to promote the development of all people, including those with disabilities. When applying, do not hesitate to let us know of any specific needs you may have so that we can take them into consideration.

jobs.title: CAREGIVER - KARANG TENGAH
jobs.description: STAF PENGASUH Gambaran Umum Sebagai seorang Pengasuh di Circle Time, Anda akan berdedikasi untuk menyediakan lingkungan yang aman, nyaman, dan stimulatif bagi anak-anak usia dini. Peran ini bertanggung jawab atas perawatan harian, pemenuhan kebutuhan dasar, serta dukungan terhadap kegiatan bermain dan belajar anak. Kami mencari individu yang penyabar, proaktif, dan memiliki semangat tulus dalam mendukung tumbuh kembang setiap anak. Tanggung Jawab Utama 1. Perawatan Harian dan Pemenuhan Kebutuhan Dasar Anak: Menyambut anak setiap pagi, membantu proses check-in, dan memastikan semua perlengkapan anak telah sesuai. Melaksanakan rutinitas harian seperti memandikan anak, mengganti pakaian dan popok, serta memastikan kebersihan dan kenyamanan anak sepanjang hari. Mendampingi anak saat waktu tidur siang dan memastikan anak beristirahat dengan nyaman. Menyiapkan dan mendampingi anak saat akan pulang (check-out) , memastikan semua barang bawaan anak lengkap. Mendampingi anak selama waktu makan, mendorong kebiasaan makan yang baik dan memastikan anak mendapatkan asupan cairan yang cukup. 2. Dukungan dalam Kegiatan Pembelajaran dan Stimulasi: Membantu persiapan dan pembersihan setelah aktivitas bermain, seperti sensory play atau kegiatan seni. Memastikan keselamatan anak selama aktivitas fisik dan permainan di dalam maupun luar ruangan, serta mendorong interaksi sosial yang positif antar anak. Mendukung guru selama sesi pembelajaran dengan membantu mengelola anak, terutama bagi anak yang memerlukan perhatian lebih agar kegiatan berjalan kondusif. (khusus Pengasuh Toddler Learning Daycare). 3. Kesehatan, Keselamatan, dan Pemantauan Anak: Melakukan pemeriksaan kondisi fisik anak saat kedatangan dan secara rutin sepanjang hari (misalnya saat mengganti popok atau mandi) untuk mendeteksi gejala ketidaknyamanan, penyakit atau cedera. Segera melaporkan insiden atau masalah kesehatan anak kepada guru atau atasan untuk ditindaklanjuti. Mengikuti protokol keselamatan dan tanggap darurat sesuai arahan, serta membantu menenangkan dan merawat anak jika terjadi insiden. Melakukan update kondisi kesehatan dan rutinitas keseharian anak (healthy habits) melalui aplikasi komunikasi orangtua dan sekolah (Little Lives Health). KRITERIA DAN KUALIFIKASI PROFIL KANDIDAT Pendidikan terakhir minimal SMA/SMK/MA dan setingkatnya Pengasuh: Pengalaman bekerja sebagai pengasuh anak usia 0-6 tahun (minimal 6 bulan) Menyukai dan tertarik untuk bekerja di dunia anak-anak Bertanggung jawab, mampu bekerja dengan detail, jujur Mampu berkomunikasi dan berkolaborasi untuk membangun kepercayaan Sabar, memiliki inisiatif dan semangat belajar Bersedia untuk bekerja di atau bepergian ke Karang tengah

Sebagai seorang Pengasuh di Circle Time, Anda akan berdedikasi untuk menyediakan lingkungan yang aman, nyaman, dan stimulatif bagi anak-anak usia dini. Peran ini bertanggung jawab atas perawatan harian, pemenuhan kebutuhan dasar, serta dukungan terhadap kegiatan bermain dan belajar anak. Kami mencari individu yang penyabar, proaktif, dan memiliki semangat tulus dalam mendukung tumbuh kembang setiap anak.

Tanggung Jawab Utama

1. Perawatan Harian dan Pemenuhan Kebutuhan Dasar Anak:

  • Menyambut anak setiap pagi, membantu proses check-in, dan memastikan semua perlengkapan anak telah sesuai.

  • Melaksanakan rutinitas harian seperti memandikan anak, mengganti pakaian dan popok, serta memastikan kebersihan dan kenyamanan anak sepanjang hari.

  • Mendampingi anak saat waktu tidur siang dan memastikan anak beristirahat dengan nyaman.

  • Menyiapkan dan mendampingi anak saat akan pulang (check-out), memastikan semua barang bawaan anak lengkap.

  • Mendampingi anak selama waktu makan, mendorong kebiasaan makan yang baik dan memastikan anak mendapatkan asupan cairan yang cukup.

2. Dukungan dalam Kegiatan Pembelajaran dan Stimulasi:

  • Membantu persiapan dan pembersihan setelah aktivitas bermain, seperti sensory play atau kegiatan seni.

  • Memastikan keselamatan anak selama aktivitas fisik dan permainan di dalam maupun luar ruangan, serta mendorong interaksi sosial yang positif antar anak.

  • Mendukung guru selama sesi pembelajaran dengan membantu mengelola anak, terutama bagi anak yang memerlukan perhatian lebih agar kegiatan berjalan kondusif. (khusus Pengasuh Toddler Learning Daycare).

3. Kesehatan, Keselamatan, dan Pemantauan Anak:

  • Melakukan pemeriksaan kondisi fisik anak saat kedatangan dan secara rutin sepanjang hari (misalnya saat mengganti popok atau mandi) untuk mendeteksi gejala ketidaknyamanan, penyakit atau cedera.

  • Segera melaporkan insiden atau masalah kesehatan anak kepada guru atau atasan untuk ditindaklanjuti.

  • Mengikuti protokol keselamatan dan tanggap darurat sesuai arahan, serta membantu menenangkan dan merawat anak jika terjadi insiden.

  • Melakukan update kondisi kesehatan dan rutinitas keseharian anak (healthy habits) melalui aplikasi komunikasi orangtua dan sekolah (Little Lives Health).

KRITERIA DAN KUALIFIKASI PROFIL KANDIDAT

  1. Pendidikan terakhir minimal SMA/SMK/MA dan setingkatnya

  2. Pengasuh: Pengalaman bekerja sebagai pengasuh anak usia 0-6 tahun (minimal 6 bulan)

  3. Menyukai dan tertarik untuk bekerja di dunia anak-anak

  4. Bertanggung jawab, mampu bekerja dengan detail, jujur

  5. Mampu berkomunikasi dan berkolaborasi untuk membangun kepercayaan

  6. Sabar, memiliki inisiatif dan semangat belajar

  7. Bersedia untuk bekerja di atau bepergian ke Karang tengah

jobs.title: QC INSPECTOR FROZEN GUDANG SRENGSENG
jobs.description: Tanggung Jawab : - Melakukan pemeriksaan kualitas produk fresh/frozen pada proses Inbound, Inventory, hingga Outbound. - Memimpin dan mengoordinasikan tim QC (±5 orang) dalam pelaksanaan kegiatan inspeksi harian. - Mengidentifikasi dan menindaklanjuti permasalahan yang berkaitan dengan kualitas produk. - Membuat laporan hasil pemeriksaan dan dokumentasi kualitas secara detail dan akurat. - Memastikan penerapan standar GHP, GWP, GMP, FIFO/FEFO, dan Leading Time di area kerja. - Berkoordinasi dengan tim gudang dan operasional untuk menjaga mutu dan keamanan produk. Kualifikasi: - Berpengalaman di bidang Quality Control produk fresh/frozen, terutama di lingkungan gudang (pengalaman minimal 1 tahun diutamakan). - Memahami metode AQL sampling dan memiliki dasar pengecekan parameter menggunakan alat ukur. - Mengetahui proses kerja di area Inbound, Inventory, dan Outbound produk fresh/frozen. - Memahami karakteristik produk fresh seperti sayur, buah, daging, dan produk sejenis. - Memahami konsep GHP, GWP, GMP, FIFO/FEFO, serta Leading Time. - Teliti, komunikatif, mampu bekerja dalam tim, dan memiliki kemampuan analisis yang baik. - Pendidikan minimal SMA/Sederajat atau S1 (Fresh Graduate dipersilakan melamar). - Bersedia ditempatkan di Warehouse Srengseng, Jakarta Barat

jobs.title: ASISTEN APOTEKER RS
jobs.description: Kesempatan Rumah Sakit Khusus THT CIRANJANG' membuka kesempatan bagi Tenaga Teknis Kefarmasian yang berdedikasi, profesional dan berintegritas untuk bergabung sebagai Asisten Apoteker shift Malam. Tanggung Jawab Utama Menyiapkan dan menyerahkan obat sesuai Resep dokter. Menghitung pengelolaan stok obat dan Alat Kesehatanan (Alkes) harian. Melakukan pengecekan tanggal kadaluarsa obat. Melaksanakan pelayanan farmasi sesuai SOP rumah sakit. Setiap hari berkoordinasi dengan Apoteker Penanggung Jawab Mendukung kegiatan distribusi obat ke unit-unit layanan pasien rawat inap dan rawat jalan. Melakukan dokumentasi dan pencatatan farmasi sesuai dengan prosedur dan peraturan yang berlaku. Menjaga kebersihan ruangan, kebersihan udara, dan kerapian ruang farmasi. Melakukan komunikasi efektif dengan perawat, dokter, dan staf medis lainnya terkait ketersediaan dan informasi obat-obatan. Mendukung program keselamatan pasien di lingkungan farmasi. Melakukan stok opname setiap minggu dan memberikan pelaporan kepada Manajemen RS dan Apoteker. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Ijazah Diploma (D3) Farmasi. Transkrip Nilai STRTTK minimal 3.20 Penguasaan pengetahuan dasar farmakologi, farmasi teknologi, dan keamanan obat-obatan. Memiliki STRTTK Aktif. Memiliki Sertifikat Kompetensi (diutamakan) Pengalaman sebelumnya di Farmasi rumah sakit atau Apotik minimal 2 - 3 tahun Mampu mengoperasikan komputer dan microsoft office. Teliti, jujur, disiplin, dan bertanggung jawab. Memiliki komunikasi yang baik dan kemampuan untuk bekerja secara Individu maupun dalam tim . Kemampuan mengelola waktu dan prioritas dalam menangani multiple tasks. Menjaga kebersihan Farmasi, keselamatan, dan regulasi rumah sakit. Bersedia mengikuti pelatihan berkelanjutan dan pengembangan profesional. Tentang Kami Rumah Sakit Khusus THT CIRANJANG' adalah institusi kesehatan yang berspesialisasi dalam pelayanan Telinga, Hidung, Tenggorok (THT) . Dengan komitmen terhadap keunggulan medis dan kepuasan pasien, kami menyediakan layanan kesehatan berkualitas tinggi menggunakan teknologi terkini dan tim profesional yang berpengalaman. Lamar Sekarang Jika Anda tertarik untuk bergabung dengan tim kami dan berkontribusi dalam memberikan pelayanan farmasi terbaik, kami mengundang Anda untuk melamar sekarang. Kirimkan CV, surat lamaran, fotokopi sertifikat D3 Farmasi, STRTTK Aktif. Kami menantikan untuk mengenal Anda lebih lanjut!

jobs.description: TL Inbound - Memimpin, membimbing, dan mengawasi tim inbound dalam kegiatan sehari-hari - ⁠Mengatur dan mengelola okupansi untuk penyimpanan barang - ⁠Menangani masalah terkait dengan penerimaan, keterlambatan, atau kerusakan barang - ⁠Membuat laporan stok TL Outbound - Memimpin, membimbing, dan mengawasi tim outbound dalam kegiatan sehari-hari - ⁠Mengatur dan mengelola replenishment, picking, pengemasan, dan pemuatan barang keluar - ⁠Menangani masalah terkait dengan pencatatan stok, dan keluarnya barang - ⁠Membuat laporan stok TL Inventory - Memimpin, membimbing, dan mengawasi tim inventory dalam kegiatan sehari-hari - Menyusun berita acara hasil DCC dan analisis yang diperlukan untuk pengambilan keputusan terkait inventory - Menangani masalah terkait dengan persediaan, seperti kelebihan atau kekurangan stok, dan merancang solusi yang tepat. jobs.title: Kitchen Crew Tangerang Selatan
jobs.description: Operasional Memastikan seluruh kegiatan operasional berjalan lancar sesuai standar perusahaan. Melakukan pengecekan kesesuaian stok fisik dengan data inventory. Melakukan update data stok, inventory, dan proses inbound di sistem secara akurat. Menyusun laporan operasional harian sesuai kebutuhan. Menjaga kebersihan area kerja, peralatan, dan lingkungan operasional sesuai standar kebersihan dan keamanan pangan. Persiapan & Produksi Mengolah bahan baku menjadi menu siap saji sesuai resep dan SOP perusahaan. Menyiapkan bahan baku, bumbu, dan perlengkapan memasak sebelum proses produksi. Melakukan preparation (prep) untuk memastikan seluruh kebutuhan produksi tersedia. Memastikan kualitas, kebersihan, dan konsistensi produk yang dihasilkan. Penjualan Mengelola operasional penjualan pada kanal non-aplikasi sesuai jam operasional toko. Memastikan ketersediaan stok produk yang dapat dijual. Memastikan seluruh pesanan diproses dan diselesaikan tepat waktu (order fulfillment). Kualifikasi Pendidikan minimal SMA/sederajat. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 1 tahun di bidang F&B, kitchen, atau barista. Teliti, cekatan, disiplin, dan bertanggung jawab. Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim. Memiliki SKCK aktif menjadi nilai tambah. Persyaratan Penempatan Bersedia bekerja 6 hari dalam seminggu, termasuk hari libur nasional atau tanggal merah. Bersedia bekerja dengan sistem shift.

jobs.title: QA FRESH HUB KOTA TANGERANG
jobs.description: Inbound Fresh (Quality Assurance) Tugas & Tanggung Jawab Melakukan proses inbound barang sesuai SOP, termasuk bongkar muat dari kendaraan ke area penerimaan. Memastikan keamanan kendaraan selama proses inbound berlangsung. Memeriksa kesesuaian surat jalan, Supply Order (SO), dan barang fisik yang diterima. Mendokumentasikan barang lebih, kurang, rusak (badstock), atau tidak sesuai, serta membuat laporan selisih penerimaan. Menginput dan memperbarui data penerimaan barang di Warehouse Management System (WMS). Menata barang menggunakan metode FEFO (First Expired, First Out) dan FIFO (First In, First Out). Memastikan akurasi stok antara data sistem dan stok fisik di hub. Melakukan pemeriksaan kualitas produk fresh dan frozen saat barang datang maupun selama penyimpanan. Memantau suhu penyimpanan (chiller, freezer, dan area ambient) sesuai standar perusahaan. Memastikan produk disimpan sesuai standar agar kualitas tetap terjaga. Mengumpulkan data dan menyusun dokumentasi hasil pemeriksaan kualitas serta kondisi stok. Kualifikasi Kualifikasi Umum Pendidikan minimal SMP/sederajat. Mampu berkomunikasi dengan baik. Teliti, cekatan, disiplin, dan bertanggung jawab. Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim. Kualifikasi Teknis Memiliki pengalaman minimal 1 tahun di bidang retail atau pergudangan produk fresh (sayur, buah, daging, atau produk sejenis). Memahami kualitas dan karakteristik produk fresh. Memiliki SKCK aktif menjadi nilai tambah. Persyaratan Penempatan Bersedia mengikuti onboarding selama 1 hari di lokasi training yang ditentukan sesuai jadwal perusahaan. Bersedia mengikuti pelatihan selama 6 hari di hub yang ditentukan . Bersedia bekerja pada hari libur, termasuk hari libur nasional. Bersedia ditempatkan di seluruh Hub Astro di area Tangerang sesuai kebutuhan operasional. Bersedia bekerja dengan sistem shift (pagi, siang, maupun malam).

jobs.title: QA FRESH JAKARTA Barat
jobs.description: Tugas & Tanggung Jawab Melakukan proses inbound barang sesuai SOP, termasuk bongkar muat dari kendaraan ke area penerimaan. Memastikan keamanan kendaraan selama proses inbound berlangsung. Memeriksa kesesuaian surat jalan, Supply Order (SO), dan barang fisik yang diterima. Mendokumentasikan barang lebih, kurang, rusak (badstock), atau tidak sesuai, serta membuat laporan selisih penerimaan. Menginput dan memperbarui data penerimaan barang di Warehouse Management System (WMS). Menata barang menggunakan metode FEFO (First Expired, First Out) dan FIFO (First In, First Out). Memastikan akurasi stok antara data sistem dan stok fisik di hub. Melakukan pemeriksaan kualitas produk fresh dan frozen saat barang datang maupun selama penyimpanan. Memantau suhu penyimpanan (chiller, freezer, dan area ambient) sesuai standar perusahaan. Memastikan produk disimpan sesuai standar agar kualitas tetap terjaga. Mengumpulkan data dan menyusun dokumentasi hasil pemeriksaan kualitas serta kondisi stok. Kualifikasi Kualifikasi Umum Pendidikan minimal SMP/sederajat. Mampu berkomunikasi dengan baik. Teliti, cekatan, disiplin, dan bertanggung jawab. Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim. Kualifikasi Teknis Memiliki pengalaman minimal 1 tahun di bidang retail atau pergudangan produk fresh (sayur, buah, daging, atau produk sejenis). Memahami kualitas dan karakteristik produk fresh. Memiliki SKCK aktif menjadi nilai tambah. Persyaratan Penempatan Bersedia mengikuti onboarding selama 1 hari di lokasi training yang ditentukan sesuai jadwal perusahaan. Bersedia mengikuti pelatihan selama 6 hari di hub yang ditentukan (wilayah Jabodetabek). Bersedia bekerja pada hari libur, termasuk hari libur nasional. Bersedia ditempatkan di seluruh Hub Astro di area Jakarta Barat. Bersedia bekerja dengan sistem shift (pagi, siang, maupun malam).

This is a full-time position where you will play a crucial role in developing students' proficiency in Mandarin language and fostering an appreciation for Chinese culture. As a Mandarin Teacher, you will be instrumental in shaping the linguistic abilities and cultural awareness of secondary-level learners, contributing directly to our institution's mission of providing comprehensive language education. Key responsibilities Develop and deliver engaging Mandarin language lessons that align with curriculum objectives and cater to various proficiency levels Assess student progress through examinations, assignments, and oral evaluations, providing constructive feedback to support learning Create a dynamic and inclusive classroom environment that encourages student participation and cultural engagement Prepare lesson plans, teaching materials, and resources that incorporate both traditional and contemporary teaching methodologies Incorporate Chinese culture, traditions, and customs into lessons to enhance cultural competency and language acquisition Collaborate with colleagues to coordinate interdisciplinary projects and maintain consistency across language programmes Communicate regularly with students and parents regarding academic progress and attendance Participate in professional development activities and stay current with effective language teaching practices Support extracurricular activities such as language clubs, cultural events, and Mandarin competitions What we're looking for Bachelor's degree in Mandarin Language, Chinese Studies, Education, or a related field Minimum 2 years of teaching experience at secondary level, preferably in Mandarin language instruction Native or near-native proficiency in Mandarin Chinese (Simplified or Traditional characters) Strong command of English language skills for effective communication in a diverse educational environment Teaching qualification or certification such as TEFL, CELTA, or equivalent Mandarin teaching credentials Excellent classroom management skills and the ability to engage students of varying abilities Familiarity with modern teaching technologies and digital learning platforms Passion for cultural exchange and promoting Mandarin language learning Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple responsibilities simultaneously Commitment to professional development and continuous improvement in teaching practice What we offer We are committed to supporting our teaching staff with a comprehensive benefits package. We offer competitive salaries , opportunities for professional development and training to enhance your teaching practice, and a supportive school community that values collaboration and innovation. You will have access to modern teaching resources and technology to facilitate effective learning experiences. We also prioritise work-life balance with reasonable working hours and paid leave entitlements. Additionally, we provide opportunities to participate in cultural events and workshops that enrich both your professional and personal growth. About us Liuli Mandarin is a dedicated educational institution committed to excellence in language teaching and cultural education. We specialise in providing high-quality Mandarin language instruction to secondary-level students, fostering linguistic proficiency and cross-cultural understanding. Our institution is built on values of academic excellence, cultural respect, and student-centred learning. We create an inclusive and dynamic environment where students and staff can thrive together, preparing our learners to become confident communicators and informed global citizens with a deep appreciation for Chinese language and culture. Apply now If you are a passionate Mandarin educator ready to make a meaningful impact on students' language development and cultural awareness, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your curriculum vitae, a cover letter outlining your teaching philosophy, and copies of relevant qualifications to Liuli Mandarin. Join our team in Serpong Utara Banten and contribute to our mission of excellence in language education.

jobs.title: Shift Supervisor of Manufacturing
jobs.description: Reporting to Manufacturing Manager Job Purpose We are seeking a highly motivated and results-oriented Shift Manufacturing Supervisor to lead our production operations and frontline teams during assigned shift. This role is responsible for ensuring safe, efficient, and high-quality manufacturing execution while driving continuous improvement and employee engagement. The ideal candidate is a strong people leader, with proven manufacturing experience, excellent problem-solving skills, and a passion for operational excellence. Key Responsibilities Monitor production operational activities, analyze performance, and recommend effective and efficient work methods to ensure targets are achieved on time, with the required quality standards and safety compliance. Optimize machine utilization, material consumption, and workforce resources to achieve optimal production performance. Collaborate with other departments to support and achieve company objectives. Ensure all production activities comply with Standard Operating Procedures (SOP), Work Instructions (WI), One-Point Lessons (OPL), and company policies. Ensure product quality standards are consistently maintained in accordance with specified requirements. Identify and resolve production issues promptly to minimize downtime and operational disruptions. Coordinate with the Quality, Engineering, PPIC, Warehouse, and Maintenance departments to ensure smooth production operations. Ensure implementation of Occupational Health and Safety (OHS/EHS), 5S/5R practices, and compliance with workplace environmental regulations. Authority Adjust production if materials, drawings, or Batch Cards do not meet the required standards, unless authorized recommendations or concessions have been granted by the appropriate authority. Issue warnings to Operators, Staff, Supervisors, Managers, and visitors within the work area who fail to wear the required safety equipment. Stop machinery that is considered hazardous or has the potential to endanger operators or damage materials. Issue verbal warnings or disciplinary notices to Operators and Team Leaders for violations of company rules or procedures. Assign Team Leaders and Operators to work overtime as required. Propose manpower requirements, overtime needs, training programs, and process improvement initiatives. Conduct performance evaluations and recommend coaching, development, or corrective actions for subordinates. Qualifications Minimum Diploma (D3) or Bachelor’s Degree (S1) in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. Minimum 6 to 8 years of experience in a manufacturing environment; experience as a Team Leader or Supervisor is an advantage. Strong understanding of production processes, Quality Control, Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, 5S/5R, and Occupational Health & Safety (OHS/EHS). Demonstrated leadership, communication, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications is an advantage. Willingness to work in shifts when required. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Production output achievement. Productivity level. Product defect rate. Raw material utilization efficiency. Machine downtime rate. On-Time Delivery (OTD) performance. Compliance with SOPs and Occupational Health & Safety requirements. Team attendance and discipline levels. Number of Continuous Improvement initiatives successfully implemented.

Manufacturing Manager


Job Purpose

We are seeking a highly motivated and results-oriented Shift Manufacturing Supervisor to lead our production operations and frontline teams during assigned shift. This role is responsible for ensuring safe, efficient, and high-quality manufacturing execution while driving continuous improvement and employee engagement.

The ideal candidate is a strong people leader, with proven manufacturing experience, excellent problem-solving skills, and a passion for operational excellence.


Key Responsibilities

  1. Monitor production operational activities, analyze performance, and recommend effective and efficient work methods to ensure targets are achieved on time, with the required quality standards and safety compliance.

  2. Optimize machine utilization, material consumption, and workforce resources to achieve optimal production performance.

  3. Collaborate with other departments to support and achieve company objectives.

  4. Ensure all production activities comply with Standard Operating Procedures (SOP), Work Instructions (WI), One-Point Lessons (OPL), and company policies.

  5. Ensure product quality standards are consistently maintained in accordance with specified requirements.

  6. Identify and resolve production issues promptly to minimize downtime and operational disruptions.

  7. Coordinate with the Quality, Engineering, PPIC, Warehouse, and Maintenance departments to ensure smooth production operations.

  8. Ensure implementation of Occupational Health and Safety (OHS/EHS), 5S/5R practices, and compliance with workplace environmental regulations.


Authority

  1. Adjust production if materials, drawings, or Batch Cards do not meet the required standards, unless authorized recommendations or concessions have been granted by the appropriate authority.

  2. Issue warnings to Operators, Staff, Supervisors, Managers, and visitors within the work area who fail to wear the required safety equipment.

  3. Stop machinery that is considered hazardous or has the potential to endanger operators or damage materials.

  4. Issue verbal warnings or disciplinary notices to Operators and Team Leaders for violations of company rules or procedures.

  5. Assign Team Leaders and Operators to work overtime as required.

  6. Propose manpower requirements, overtime needs, training programs, and process improvement initiatives.

  7. Conduct performance evaluations and recommend coaching, development, or corrective actions for subordinates.


Qualifications

  • Minimum Diploma (D3) or Bachelor’s Degree (S1) in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

  • Minimum 6 to 8 years of experience in a manufacturing environment; experience as a Team Leader or Supervisor is an advantage.

  • Strong understanding of production processes, Quality Control, Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, 5S/5R, and Occupational Health & Safety (OHS/EHS).

  • Demonstrated leadership, communication, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications is an advantage.

  • Willingness to work in shifts when required.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Production output achievement.

  • Productivity level.

  • Product defect rate.

  • Raw material utilization efficiency.

  • Machine downtime rate.

  • On-Time Delivery (OTD) performance.

  • Compliance with SOPs and Occupational Health & Safety requirements.

  • Team attendance and discipline levels.

  • Number of Continuous Improvement initiatives successfully implemented.

jobs.title: Marketing Manager (EduTech)
jobs.description: Job Description: Develop and implement comprehensive sales and marketing strategies. Lead, supervise, and motivate the sales & marketing team to achieve performance goals. Analyze market trends and competitor activities to identify business opportunities. Plan and execute promotional campaigns and branding strategies. Maintain strong relationships with existing clients and expand the customer base. Prepare and present sales performance reports to upper management. Collaborate with other departments to ensure alignment and effective execution of strategies. Manage the marketing budget efficiently and ensure cost-effective use of resources. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Management, Communications, or a related field. Minimum 3–5 years of experience in sales and marketing, with at least 2 years in a managerial role. Strong understanding of sales strategy, branding, and digital marketing. Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets. Excellent leadership skills and the ability to manage and develop a team. Outstanding communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills. Well-connected with a strong professional network. Familiarity with digital marketing tools (e.g., Google Ads, Meta Ads, CRM systems) is a plus. Proficient in both written and spoken English and Indonesian. Willing to be placed in the Gading Serpong, Tangerang.

jobs.description: DESKRIPSI PEKERJAAN 1. Inbound Admin Melakukan pengecekan Purchase Order (PO) dari supplier. Memastikan dan memeriksa barang yang masuk ke dan keluar dari hub . Helper Melakukan peletakan dan penataan barang/produk di lokasi penyimpanan. Memeriksa tanggal kedaluwarsa (expired date) produk. 2. Outbound Picker Mengambil barang sesuai dengan PO (Purchase Order) yang telah ditentukan. Packer Mengemas barang dan melakukan pengecekan ulang untuk memastikan: Barang sudah sesuai dengan SO (Sales Order) . Barang telah disesuaikan dengan rute pengiriman pada SO. 3. Inventory Memastikan barang sudah berada di lokasi yang sesuai . Melakukan pengecekan stok barang di sistem agar sesuai dengan kondisi fisik di lapangan. Melakukan dan memastikan hasil dari cycle count secara berkala.   • Admin

  • Picker

  • Melakukan pengecekan stok barang di sistem agar sesuai dengan kondisi fisik di lapangan.

  • Melakukan dan memastikan hasil dari cycle count secara berkala.

  • Bersedia ditempatkan di Gudang Pegangsaan, Jakarta Utara

  • Paham produk Fresh atau Frozen

  • Bersedia bekerja dalam sistem shift

  • Bersedia bekerja di hari libur dan libur nasional

jobs.title: MITRA HSE WAREHOUSE
jobs.description: HSE Training Center Melakukan marking kendaraan mitra driver dan pemeriksaan dokumen kendaraan. Melakukan inspeksi kondisi kendaraan roda dua. Melaksanakan inspeksi area Hub dan memastikan standar HSE terpenuhi. Memeriksa kelayakan peralatan kerja, kebersihan toilet, dan lingkungan kerja. Melakukan inspeksi kendaraan mitra driver secara berkala. HSE Warehouse Melaksanakan safety patrol di area warehouse. Melakukan inspeksi dan penilaian (scoring) HSE terkait potensi bahaya, material handling, dan kebersihan area kerja. Melakukan inspeksi program pest control di area warehouse dan kitchen. Memeriksa kondisi APAR, kotak P3K, dan box APD secara rutin. Melakukan assessment HIRADC (Hazard Identification, Risk Assessment and Determining Control). Menginput hasil monitoring serta menyusun laporan HSE. Menindaklanjuti dan memperbaiki temuan hasil inspeksi HSE. Berkoordinasi dengan PIC terkait tindak lanjut hasil scoring. Melakukan inspeksi kondisi genset secara berkala. Kualifikasi Pendidikan minimal SMA/sederajat. Wajib memiliki SKCK aktif. Sudah menerima vaksin Covid-19 minimal dosis kedua. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 1 tahun sebagai HSE Officer, Safety Officer, atau Safetyman menjadi nilai tambah. Memahami penggunaan Google Maps dan Microsoft Excel/Google Spreadsheet. Memiliki sepeda motor pribadi beserta SIM C dan STNK yang masih berlaku. Mampu melakukan inspeksi kendaraan. Memiliki handphone Android. Teliti, disiplin, bertanggung jawab, dan mampu bekerja secara mandiri. Bersedia bekerja secara mobile. Persyaratan Penempatan Bersedia bekerja 6 hari dalam seminggu, termasuk hari libur nasional atau tanggal merah. Bersedia ditempatkan di area Jakarta Barat.

", "content2": "

Office Administration & Accounting Manager / Assistant Manager / Supervisor

Location: West Jakarta, Indonesia
Industry: Japanese Food Manufacturing Company
Employment Type: Full-Time
Recruitment Partner: PERSOL Indonesia

About the Company

Our client is a well-established Japanese food manufacturing company currently expanding its business operations in Indonesia. To support its growth, the company is seeking a capable and hands-on professional to oversee accounting, office administration, general affairs, payroll, tax, and corporate administration functions while ensuring smooth and compliant business operations.

Position Summary

The Office Administration & Accounting Manager / Assistant Manager / Supervisor will be responsible for managing the company's accounting operations and overall office administration activities. This role requires a strong accounting background combined with the ability to oversee administrative, general affairs, payroll, taxation, and corporate support functions.

The successful candidate will act as a key liaison between local operations and management, including coordination with Japanese and headquarters when required. This position supervises one subordinate who also supports manufacturing administration activities.

Key Responsibilities

Accounting & Finance

  • Manage the full accounting cycle from transaction recording to financial reporting.

  • Perform and review:

    • Data entry and voucher processing

    • Journal entries

    • General ledger maintenance

    • Account reconciliations

    • Trial balance preparation

  • Prepare accurate monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements.

  • Conduct financial analysis and provide recommendations to management.

  • Monitor cash flow, operating expenses, and budget utilization.

  • Ensure compliance with company policies and Indonesian accounting standards.

  • Coordinate with external auditors and business consultants.

Tax Compliance

  • Prepare and submit monthly and annual tax reports.

  • Handle tax calculations and reporting, including:

    • PPh 21

    • PPh 23

    • PPh 25/29

    • VAT (PPN)

  • Ensure tax compliance and timely filing.

  • Coordinate with tax consultants and government authorities during audits or inquiries.

Payroll Administration

  • Process monthly payroll accurately and on schedule.

  • Manage employee compensation calculations.

  • Administer BPJS Kesehatan and BPJS Ketenagakerjaan.

  • Ensure compliance with Indonesian labor regulations and payroll requirements.

  • Maintain payroll and employee compensation records.

Office Administration & General Affairs

  • Oversee day-to-day office administration activities.

  • Ensure smooth office operations and administrative support for all departments.

  • Manage office supplies, facilities, company assets, and vendor services.

  • Handle administrative documentation, filing systems, and record management.

  • Maintain and renew company licenses, permits, and legal documentation.

  • Coordinate office maintenance, utilities, security, and housekeeping services.

  • Support business travel arrangements, company events, and administrative logistics.

  • Manage relationships with external service providers and government agencies.

Manufacturing Administration Support

  • Support administrative activities related to factory operations.

  • Coordinate documentation and reporting required by manufacturing departments.

  • Monitor administrative processes to ensure operational efficiency.

  • Collaborate with production and warehouse teams on administrative matters.

HR Administration (Preferred)

  • Support attendance management and employee records administration.

  • Assist with employee onboarding and offboarding processes.

  • Maintain personnel files and HR-related documentation.

  • Support employee welfare and company policy implementation.

Reporting & Communication

  • Prepare management reports and business performance updates.

  • Coordinate effectively with local management and Japanese stakeholders.

  • Support reporting requirements to Japanese headquarters.

  • Assist in company expansion projects, process improvements, and factory establishment activities.

Requirements

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.

Experience

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in Accounting, Finance, Office Administration, or General Affairs functions.

  • Experience working in a Japanese manufacturing company is highly preferred.

  • Experience managing both accounting and office administration responsibilities.

  • Strong understanding of manufacturing business processes.

Technical Competencies

  • Full accounting cycle management.

  • Financial reporting and analysis.

  • General ledger and closing process management.

  • Indonesian taxation regulations and reporting.

  • Payroll processing and BPJS administration.

  • Corporate administration and office management.

  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills.

  • Experience using Accurate Accounting Software is preferred.

Language Skills

  • Business-level English is required.

  • Japanese language proficiency will be a significant advantage.

Preferred Qualifications

Candidates with the following experience will be highly regarded:

  • Food manufacturing or food processing industry experience.

  • Experience supporting factory start-up or factory expansion projects.

  • Experience reporting to Japanese headquarters.

  • HR Administration and General Affairs exposure.

  • Japanese language capability (JLPT certification is a plus).

Leadership & Personal Attributes

  • Strong sense of responsibility and integrity.

  • Hands-on approach with excellent attention to detail.

  • Strong leadership and people management skills.

  • Analytical and problem-solving mindset.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Able to work independently and manage multiple priorities.

  • Adaptable and comfortable working in a Japanese corporate culture.

  • Proactive and committed to continuous improvement.

", "content2": "

Key responsibilities

  1. Oversee all front-of-house operations and coordinate with the kitchen and bar teams to ensure smooth service flow

  2. Greet guests warmly and manage table allocations to optimise dining experiences and restaurant capacity

  3. Train, supervise, and mentor waiting staff to maintain consistent service quality and professional standards

  4. Take orders accurately and provide expert recommendations on menu items and beverages

  5. Monitor guest satisfaction throughout their dining experience and address any concerns or complaints promptly and professionally

  6. Ensure tables are set correctly according to restaurant standards and maintain cleanliness of the dining area

  7. Manage reservations and walk-in guests efficiently to maximise revenue and minimise wait times

  8. Conduct pre-service briefings and communicate specials, menu changes, and service procedures to the team

  9. Handle payments, process transactions accurately, and manage point-of-sale systems

  10. Maintain knowledge of food and beverage offerings, including ingredients, preparation methods, and allergen information

  11. Uphold health, safety, and hygiene standards in accordance with regulatory requirements


What we're looking for

  1. Minimum 2 years of experience in a full-service restaurant or upscale dining establishment, with at least 2 years in a supervisory or captain role

  2. Proven expertise in fine dining service standards, etiquette, and guest management

  3. Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to interact professionally with guests and staff at all levels

  4. Strong leadership capabilities with the ability to motivate, train, and manage a team effectively

  5. Excellent organisational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously in a fast-paced environment

  6. Proficiency in point-of-sale systems and reservation management software

About the role

We are seeking a dedicated and detail-oriented Housekeeper to join the housekeeping team at CV. MURNA LOKA DEWATA (MURNA HOSPITALITY) in Badung, Bali. This is a full-time position that plays a crucial role in maintaining the cleanliness, comfort, and overall aesthetic of our hospitality facilities. As a Housekeeper, you will be responsible for ensuring that all guest areas and common spaces meet our high standards of cleanliness and hygiene, directly contributing to guest satisfaction and the reputation of our establishment. This role is essential to our operations and requires someone who takes pride in delivering exceptional service through meticulous attention to detail.

Key responsibilities

  1. Clean and maintain guest rooms, bathrooms, and common areas to the highest standards of cleanliness and hygiene

  2. Change bed linens, towels and other furnishings on a regular and as-needed basis

  3. Vacuum, sweep and mop floors in assigned areas

  4. Dust furniture, fixtures and décor items throughout the property

  5. Clean and sanitise bathroom facilities including toilets, sinks, showers and bathtubs

  6. Replenish guest amenities such as toiletries, towels and supplies

  7. Report any maintenance issues, damages or repairs needed to supervisors

  8. Follow all health and safety protocols and use cleaning products appropriately

  9. Dispose of waste and recycling materials properly

  10. Work efficiently to complete assigned areas within scheduled timeframes

  11. Respond promptly to guest requests and special cleaning needs

  12. Maintain inventory of cleaning supplies and report shortages to management


What we're looking for

  1. Proven experience working as a Housekeeper in a hospitality, hotel or similar environment

  2. Strong attention to detail and commitment to maintaining high cleanliness standards

  3. Physical ability to perform repetitive tasks and lift heavy items

  4. Excellent time management skills and ability to work efficiently

  5. Reliable and punctual with a professional demeanour

  6. Ability to work independently and as part of a team

  7. Good communication skills in Bahasa Indonesia and preferably basic English

  8. Knowledge of proper cleaning techniques and the safe use of cleaning chemicals

  9. Flexibility to work various shifts, including mornings, afternoons and weekends as required

  10. Physical stamina to handle the demands of the role

  11. Willingness to follow company policies and procedures


What we offer

At CV. MURNA LOKA DEWATA (MURNA HOSPITALITY), we value our team members and strive to provide a supportive working environment. We offer competitive remuneration, opportunities for professional development within the hospitality sector, and a workplace culture that respects and recognises hard work and dedication. We provide our staff with access to training programmes to enhance their skills, career advancement opportunities within the organisation, and a collaborative team atmosphere where your contributions are appreciated. We are committed to maintaining fair employment practices and providing a safe working environment for all our employees.

About us

CV. MURNA LOKA DEWATA (MURNA HOSPITALITY) is a villa management company based in Badung, Bali, dedicated to delivering exceptional guest experiences through quality accommodation and services. Our mission is to create welcoming and immaculate environments where guests feel comfortable and valued. With a focus on attention to detail and customer satisfaction, we maintain high standards across all aspects of our operations.

Apply now

If you are a dedicated and detail-oriented individual with housekeeping experience and a passion for maintaining exceptional cleanliness standards, we would like to hear from you. Please submit your CV outlining your relevant experience to CV. MURNA LOKA DEWATA (MURNA HOSPITALITY). We look forward to welcoming a new member to our housekeeping team.

Competitive salary, professional development, and healthy work-life balance.", "content2": "

About the role

We are seeking a talented and experienced Corporate Chef to join PT. Delta Wibawa Bersama in South Jakarta. This is a full-time position that plays a pivotal role in our hospitality and culinary operations. As Corporate Chef, you will be responsible for overseeing all culinary activities, menu development, and kitchen operations across our corporate facilities. This role is crucial to maintaining our reputation for excellence in food service and ensuring an exceptional dining experience for our guests and employees. You will work on-site at our Jakarta Selatan location, leading a dynamic kitchen team and driving culinary innovation.

What you'll be doing

  1. Develop, design and oversee the preparation of menus that align with corporate standards and guest preferences

  2. Supervise kitchen staff and manage daily kitchen operations to ensure consistency, quality and food safety compliance

  3. Maintain strict food hygiene and safety standards in accordance with Indonesian health and safety regulations

  4. Control food costs and manage inventory efficiently whilst maintaining the highest quality standards

  5. Train, mentor and develop kitchen team members to enhance their culinary skills and professional growth

  6. Source and select high-quality ingredients from reliable suppliers, negotiating competitive pricing where possible

  7. Collaborate with management on special events, catering requirements and corporate functions

  8. Monitor food trends and culinary innovations to continuously improve menu offerings and guest satisfaction

  9. Prepare quarterly reports on kitchen performance, food costs and operational metrics

  10. Ensure all kitchen equipment is properly maintained and replaced as needed


What we're looking for

  1. Minimum 7-10 years of professional culinary experience, with at least 3-5 years in a supervisory or head chef role

  2. Formal culinary training or certification from an accredited culinary school

  3. Comprehensive knowledge of Indonesian, Asian and international cuisines

  4. Strong understanding of food safety regulations, hygiene standards and HACCP protocols

  5. Proven expertise in menu planning, food costing and kitchen management

  6. Excellent leadership and team management capabilities with the ability to motivate and develop staff

  7. Strong communication skills in Indonesian and English, both written and verbal

  8. Proficiency in kitchen management software and Microsoft Office applications

  9. Exceptional organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and high-pressure environments

  10. Creativity and passion for culinary arts with a commitment to continuous innovation

  11. Experience in corporate or institutional catering environments is highly desirable
