jobs.title: Baker
jobs.description: Baker – Kongmi Kongmi adalah café dan dessert house yang menghadirkan Wholesome Treats from Nature , mulai dari homemade Korean fruit cheong, coffee, hingga berbagai bakery & dessert yang dibuat dengan bahan-bahan pilihan. Saat ini kami sedang mencari Baker yang bertanggung jawab, memiliki semangat belajar, dan senang bekerja dalam lingkungan yang hangat serta kolaboratif untuk bergabung bersama tim Kongmi. Deskripsi Pekerjaan Melakukan produksi harian bakery dan dessert sesuai resep serta standar yang telah ditetapkan. Menyiapkan bahan baku dan memastikan kebutuhan produksi tersedia dengan baik. Menjaga konsistensi kualitas, rasa, dan tampilan produk. Melakukan penimbangan, pengolahan, pemanggangan, dan finishing produk sesuai SOP. Membantu pengembangan dan evaluasi produk apabila diperlukan. Menjaga kebersihan area kerja, peralatan, dan lingkungan dapur sesuai standar kebersihan dan keamanan pangan. Melakukan pengecekan stok bahan baku serta melaporkan kebutuhan pembelian kepada atasan. Bekerja sama dengan tim kitchen dan divisi lain untuk mendukung kelancaran operasional harian. Kualifikasi Memiliki sikap kerja yang positif, jujur, bertanggung jawab, dan disiplin. Mampu bekerja secara individu maupun dalam tim. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik. Bersedia mengikuti SOP dan standar kerja yang berlaku. Bersedia bekerja dengan sistem operasional café dan bakery. Nilai Tambah (Preferred Qualifications) Memiliki pengalaman di bidang bakery, pastry, kitchen, atau F&B (Terkhusus produksi Salt Bread, Sourdough, Focaccia, Croissant dan sejenisnya). Memiliki pengalaman bekerja di café, bakery, atau restoran. Berdomisili di Kabupaten Tangerang, Tangerang Selatan, atau area sekitarnya. Memiliki kemampuan Bahasa Inggris dasar untuk percakapan sehari-hari. Memiliki ketertarikan terhadap dunia bakery, dessert, dan produk artisan. Benefit Upah Bulanan Uang makan Staff meal THR Cuti tahunan Staff discount Bonus pencapaian 📍 Penempatan: Gading Serpong, Tangerang

jobs.title: Sous Chef Pastry - Amandari
jobs.description: Location Overview Join our team in Amandari. Presided over by a sacred stone tiger, Amandari was designed after a traditional Balinese village on the verdant lip of the Ayung River Gorge. Free-standing guest suites are reached via winding pathways, while the curving swimming pool mimics the rice paddies below. Close to the artistic centre of Ubud, this place of peace invites both reflection and the exploration of Bali’s cultural heart. Position Summary Lead the daily operations of the pastry kitchen, ensuring all pastry and bakery items are prepared to Aman’s quality standards. Support the Executive Chef by supervising the team, maintaining food safety and hygiene, and delivering an excellent guest experience. Responsibilities Supervise the daily operations of the pastry kitchen. Ensure all pastry and bakery products meet quality and presentation standards. Plan daily production to reduce waste and control food costs. Maintain cleanliness, hygiene, and food safety standards (HACCP). Train, coach, and support the pastry team. Assist in creating new pastry and bakery items. Manage stock, storage, and proper use of ingredients. Support guest requests and other duties assigned by the Executive Chef. Qualifications Culinary qualification in Pastry or Bakery. Minimum 3 years' experience in a luxury hotel or resort, preferably in a five-star property. Good knowledge of pastry production, food safety, and food cost control. Leadership and team training experience. Good English communication skills. Able to work under pressure, pay attention to detail, and work well in a team. Positive attitude with a strong focus on quality and guest satisfaction.

jobs.title: IT QA Manager
jobs.description: Quality Assurance Manager PT Fata Organa Solusi — in partnership with CAC Holding Japan About the Role We are seeking a QA Manager to define and drive our quality assurance strategy across our full product range — from sophisticated AI/ML models to user-friendly web applications — ensuring everything we ship meets the highest standards of quality and reliability. This is a leadership role, not a hands-on testing role. You will spend the majority of your time on strategy, team development, quality gates, and stakeholder communication — not executing tests yourself. We need someone who can raise the entire team's bar, not be the team's best tester. You will lead and grow a team of QA engineers, partner closely with product, development, and project teams, and serve as a key quality partner to our Japanese clients. What You'll Be Doing Develop and implement comprehensive QA strategies, policies, and procedures for our web applications and AI/ML projects. Lead, mentor, and manage a team of QA engineers, fostering a culture of quality, ownership, and continuous improvement. Act as a genuine quality gate — reviewing your team's test plans and cases to catch gaps and raise standards, not to approve them as a formality. Act as the primary point of contact for all QA matters, communicating test status, risks, and quality reports to stakeholders, including clients and senior management. Collaborate closely with development, product, and project management teams to embed QA best practices throughout the software development lifecycle. Oversee the creation and execution of test plans, test cases, and test scripts for both manual and automated testing. Communicate directly with our Japanese clients to understand their quality requirements and feedback, ensuring all deliverables align with their standards and expectations. Drive the adoption of new testing technologies and methodologies, particularly in AI and web application performance. Define, monitor, and report on key QA metrics, using data to drive continuous improvement. Requirements Minimum 5 years of experience in software quality assurance, including proven experience as a QA Manager, QA Lead, or in a similar quality leadership role. A leader who operates at strategic altitude and resists the pull to solve problems by doing the individual-contributor work themselves. You make decisions. When your team brings you a problem, they leave with direction — not just discussion. You review test plans and cases as a real quality gate: catching gaps, raising standards, and pushing back where needed. You are self-correcting and reliable — peers and leadership can trust your work without having to check it. Demonstrated experience testing web applications, with a solid understanding of modern web technologies. Strong knowledge of QA methodologies, tools, and processes across the full testing lifecycle. Proven experience leading, mentoring, and managing a team of QA professionals. Experience defining and driving QA strategy and process improvement. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to articulate complex technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Fluent in English at a professional/business level, able to communicate confidently with international clients and stakeholders — verbally and in writing. Advantageous If You have experience working with Japanese clients, or a strong understanding of Japanese business culture and communication styles. You have N3 or higher Japanese language proficiency. You have experience testing AI/ML models and pipelines. You are familiar with test automation frameworks and CI/CD integration. You have experience in IT project management. You hold relevant professional certifications (e.g., ISTQB). Benefits Competitive salary and benefits package. Tax and BPJS + BPJSTK fully paid by company, including full BPJSTK coverage (4 items). Yearly performance bonus (up to 2x). Flexible work arrangements and access to continuous learning and development. Opportunity to work on challenging, innovative AI and web projects for international clients. The chance to lead, grow, and shape the quality culture of a growing technology company. About Us PT Fata Organa Solusi, in partnership with CAC Holding Japan, is a forward-thinking organization specializing in innovative business and data-science solutions. If you're a quality-driven leader ready to shape and elevate our QA function, we encourage you to apply now!

Strategic leadership role, professional English required.", "content2": "

Quality Assurance Manager

PT Fata Organa Solusi — in partnership with CAC Holding Japan

About the Role

We are seeking a QA Manager to define and drive our quality assurance strategy across our full product range — from sophisticated AI/ML models to user-friendly web applications — ensuring everything we ship meets the highest standards of quality and reliability.

This is a leadership role, not a hands-on testing role. You will spend the majority of your time on strategy, team development, quality gates, and stakeholder communication — not executing tests yourself. We need someone who can raise the entire team's bar, not be the team's best tester. You will lead and grow a team of QA engineers, partner closely with product, development, and project teams, and serve as a key quality partner to our Japanese clients.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Develop and implement comprehensive QA strategies, policies, and procedures for our web applications and AI/ML projects.

  • Lead, mentor, and manage a team of QA engineers, fostering a culture of quality, ownership, and continuous improvement.

  • Act as a genuine quality gate — reviewing your team's test plans and cases to catch gaps and raise standards, not to approve them as a formality.

  • Act as the primary point of contact for all QA matters, communicating test status, risks, and quality reports to stakeholders, including clients and senior management.

  • Collaborate closely with development, product, and project management teams to embed QA best practices throughout the software development lifecycle.

  • Oversee the creation and execution of test plans, test cases, and test scripts for both manual and automated testing.

  • Communicate directly with our Japanese clients to understand their quality requirements and feedback, ensuring all deliverables align with their standards and expectations.

  • Drive the adoption of new testing technologies and methodologies, particularly in AI and web application performance.

  • Define, monitor, and report on key QA metrics, using data to drive continuous improvement.

Requirements

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in software quality assurance, including proven experience as a QA Manager, QA Lead, or in a similar quality leadership role.

  • A leader who operates at strategic altitude and resists the pull to solve problems by doing the individual-contributor work themselves.

  • You make decisions. When your team brings you a problem, they leave with direction — not just discussion.

  • You review test plans and cases as a real quality gate: catching gaps, raising standards, and pushing back where needed.

  • You are self-correcting and reliable — peers and leadership can trust your work without having to check it.

  • Demonstrated experience testing web applications, with a solid understanding of modern web technologies.

  • Strong knowledge of QA methodologies, tools, and processes across the full testing lifecycle.

  • Proven experience leading, mentoring, and managing a team of QA professionals.

  • Experience defining and driving QA strategy and process improvement.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to articulate complex technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Fluent in English at a professional/business level, able to communicate confidently with international clients and stakeholders — verbally and in writing.

Advantageous If

  • You have experience working with Japanese clients, or a strong understanding of Japanese business culture and communication styles.

  • You have N3 or higher Japanese language proficiency.

  • You have experience testing AI/ML models and pipelines.

  • You are familiar with test automation frameworks and CI/CD integration.

  • You have experience in IT project management.

  • You hold relevant professional certifications (e.g., ISTQB).

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.

  • Tax and BPJS + BPJSTK fully paid by company, including full BPJSTK coverage (4 items).

  • Yearly performance bonus (up to 2x).

  • Flexible work arrangements and access to continuous learning and development.

  • Opportunity to work on challenging, innovative AI and web projects for international clients.

  • The chance to lead, grow, and shape the quality culture of a growing technology company.

About Us

PT Fata Organa Solusi, in partnership with CAC Holding Japan, is a forward-thinking organization specializing in innovative business and data-science solutions. If you're a quality-driven leader ready to shape and elevate our QA function, we encourage you to apply now!

jobs.title: Purchasing Officer
jobs.description: TANGGUNG JAWAB: Mengelola proses pengadaan barang dan jasa sesuai kebutuhan perusahaan. Mencari, membandingkan, dan melakukan negosiasi dengan supplier/vendor untuk mendapatkan penawaran terbaik. Membuat dan mengelola Purchase Order (PO) serta dokumen pembelian lainnya. Memastikan barang/jasa yang dibeli sesuai spesifikasi, kualitas, dan jadwal yang ditentukan. Berkoordinasi dengan departemen terkait dalam proses pembelian, penerimaan barang, dan pembayaran. jobs.title: Admin Sales
jobs.description: Kualifikasi: Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik, percaya diri, dan mampu membangun hubungan yang positif dengan pelanggan. Mampu menawarkan produk secara persuasif serta memahami kebutuhan customer. Berpengalaman di bidang penjualan atau customer service menjadi nilai tambah. Teliti, rapi dalam administrasi, dan terbiasa bekerja dengan target. Mampu bekerja secara cepat, responsif, dan memiliki problem-solving yang baik. Job Description: Menginput fee konsumen secara akurat serta mengurus seluruh proses pembatalan dan refund dana sesuai prosedur perusahaan. Mengecek, memvalidasi, dan menetapkan kepemilikan chat konsumen (leads) yang masuk kepada tim sales secara adil agar tidak terjadi bentrokan. Memeriksa bukti digital (log sistem/chat) dan memutuskan sengketa atau aju banding antar sales terkait klaim konsumen atau komisi secara objektif. Membuat dan melakukan follow-up penawaran harga yang akan digunakan oleh tim Sales di Betwice. Memantau dan memastikan seluruh chat konsumen yang masuk dibalas dengan cepat, tepat waktu, dan tidak ada yang terlewat. Membantu meminta ulasan (review) positif dari konsumen setelah transaksi selesai untuk menjaga reputasi bisnis.

Job Description

1. Dashboard Creation and Maintenance

Design and develop interactive dashboards using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Google Data Studio.

Create relevant dashboards for Sales, Marketing, SCM, Finance, and Store Operations functions.

2. Data Collection and Integration

Collect data from various sources (POS, ERP, Google Sheets, Excel, internal APIs).

Process clean, structured, and consistent data before processing.

Job Requirements

This role requires strong analytical skills, proficiency in data tools, and the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, or Computer Science
  • 4 years of experience in data analysis, preferably in a marketing or campaign-related role.
  • Proficiency in SQL, Python, R, or other data analysis tools.
  • Experience with data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, Google Data Studio, etc.).
  • Detail-oriented with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines

Monitor and control store operational excellence to ensure that day-to-day operational activity supports the achievement of store goals. Have a good interpersonal skill, good in problem-solving, & good in communication. Willing to work in shifts (including weekends) Ready to work 6 days in a week Willing to be placed in Banjarmasin (South Kalimantan)

jobs.title: Learning Partner Supervisor (Talent Pool) - Supervisor
jobs.description: Job Description Collaborate with business partners to identify organizational and individual training needs. Conduct comprehensive Training Needs Analysis (TNA) to align learning priorities with business objectives. Facilitate training programs for both operational and head office employees. Design and develop training materials, syllabi, and curriculum tailored to organizational requirements. Execute on-the-job training and field observations to reinforce knowledge application. Evaluate training effectiveness up to Level 3 (behavioral change) to ensure measurable impact. Drive talent development initiatives to build a strong internal pipeline of future leaders. Job Requirements Bachelor’s Degree in any major. Minimum 3 years of experience as a Trainer; exposure to Gadget, Electronics, or Fashion industries is an advantage. Strong analytical skills to measure training effectiveness. Proficient in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Canva. Strong knowledge of iOS and Android operating systems or gadget Freak will be advantage. Highly communicative, proactive, and dependable with strong initiative. Adaptable to a fast-paced and dynamic business environment. Willing to travel and conduct mobile training sessions. Fluent in English, both spoken and written.

jobs.title: Sr. IT Business Analyst (Talent Pool) - Manager
jobs.description: Job Description Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document both functional and non-functional requirements. Review existing business processes, identify gaps, and recommend system improvements to enhance efficiency and performance. Work closely with IT teams to ensure solutions meet business needs and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) before deployment. Act as a liaison between business units and IT, ensuring clear communication and alignment on project goals, timelines, and deliverables. Lead and coordinate business analysis activities across projects, ensuring timely and successful implementation. Job Requirements Educational background in Information Technology, Information Systems, Business Administration, or related fields. Minimum 5 years of experience as a System Analyst, Functional Consultant, or Business Analyst, preferably in a technology-driven environment. Experience in ERP, B2C POS, Supply Chain Management (SCM), or Logistics modules. Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills with hands-on experience in documentation and process mapping. Familiar with the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and project collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, or Asana. Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to manage stakeholder expectations and work effectively in cross-functional teams.

jobs.title: Service Head Xpeng (Talent Pool) - Supervisor
jobs.description: Job Description Lead daily operations of the service department, ensuring smooth workflow and timely vehicle service. Supervise and develop the service advisor, technician, and workshop support teams. Monitor and improve service KPIs: customer satisfaction, service lead time, workshop productivity, and revenue. Handle customer escalations professionally and ensure timely resolution. Coordinate with Parts and Sales departments to ensure seamless after-sales support. Ensure all service processes comply with brand standards and local regulations. Monitor inventory, tools, and equipment required for workshop operations. Prepare regular reports on service performance and propose improvements. Provide coaching and performance evaluations to team members. Job Requirements Minimum 5 years of experience in automotive service, with at least 2 years in a managerial/supervisory role. Strong knowledge of EV systems and diagnostics is a plus. Proven leadership and people management skills. Customer-focused with strong communication and problem-solving abilities. Familiar with dealer management systems (DMS) and workshop operations. Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Willing to be placed at IDD PIK2.

jobs.title: Assistant Store Manager F&B - Makassar - Supervisor
jobs.description: Job Description Oversee daily store operations including sales, service, inventory, and cleanliness. Lead, coach, and motivate the store team to achieve sales targets and performance KPIs. Monitor and analyze store performance, taking corrective action when necessary. Ensure compliance with SOPs, food safety, and hygiene standards. Manage staff scheduling, training, and performance appraisals. Control store-level costs and optimize productivity and efficiency. Maintain high standards of customer satisfaction and handle customer feedback professionally. Execute marketing programs and promotional activities in-store. Ensure stock accuracy, inventory turnover, and proper product display. Collaborate with Area Manager and support departments for store needs and initiatives. Job Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Business, Hospitality, or related field. Minimum 3–5 years of experience in a supervisory or managerial role within the F&B or retail industry. Strong leadership, team management, and interpersonal skills. Proven ability to drive sales and manage store-level operations effectively. Excellent customer service orientation and communication skills. Able to work under pressure, multitask, and solve problems independently. Proficient in Microsoft Office and retail POS systems. Willing to work on weekends, holidays, or in shifts based on business needs.

  • Oversee daily store operations including sales, service, inventory, and cleanliness.

  • Proven ability to drive sales and manage store-level operations effectively.
  • Excellent customer service orientation and communication skills.
  • Able to work under pressure, multitask, and solve problems independently.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and retail POS systems.
  • Willing to work on weekends, holidays, or in shifts based on business needs.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Manager - Furniture Manufacturing
jobs.description: Client details: Furniture Manufacturing Key Responsibilities Develop and implement manufacturing strategies to achieve production targets, quality standards, efficiency, and workplace safety. Lead manufacturing teams to foster a culture of safety, housekeeping programs, continuous improvement, and GMP implementation. Manage manufacturing budgets and investments to enhance production capacity, technology, and manufacturing systems. Analyse production metrics and key performance indicators to identify areas for improvement and cost reduction Ensure compliance with health, safety, and environmental regulations within the manufacturing facility Manage inventory levels of raw materials and finished goods to support production requirements Implement lean manufacturing principles and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency Liaise with procurement, sales, and logistics teams to ensure seamless coordination across departments Conduct regular maintenance and equipment management to minimise downtime and maximise productivity Job Requirements Minimum 8 years of experience in manufacturing management, preferably in the furniture or related manufacturing industry Strong leadership, strategic thinking, analytical skills, and ability to manage manufacturing complexity Strong knowledge of production planning, scheduling, and inventory management system Experience with lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies Proficiency in manufacturing software and ERP systems Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret production data and metrics Knowledge of health, safety, and environmental compliance requirements in manufacturing Excellent communication and interpersonal skills in both English and Indonesian Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Manufacturing Management, or a related field is preferred Work Location : Kawasan Industri Terboyo Timur, Semarang

Competitive pay, training & work-life balance in beautiful Lombok.", "content2": "

About the role

We are seeking a compassionate and experienced Nanny to join the Step Forward Lombok team. This is a full-time position based in Lombok Tengah, Nusa Tenggara Barat, offering an exceptional opportunity to make a meaningful difference in the lives of children and families. As a Nanny, you will be responsible for providing high-quality childcare, fostering development, and creating a safe, nurturing environment for the children in your care. This role is fundamental to our commitment to supporting families and ensuring every child receives the attention, care, and guidance they deserve.

Key responsibilities

  1. Providing daily childcare and supervision for children of various ages, ensuring their safety, health, and wellbeing at all times

  2. Developing and implementing age-appropriate activities and educational programmes that support children's physical, cognitive, and emotional development

  3. Preparing nutritious meals and snacks tailored to dietary requirements and preferences, maintaining proper food safety and hygiene standards

  4. Assisting with personal care routines including bathing, dressing, toilet training, and grooming in a gentle and patient manner

  5. Maintaining a clean, organised, and safe living environment for the children, including tidying play areas and managing household tasks related to childcare

  6. Communicating regularly with parents regarding their child's progress, activities, behaviour, and any concerns or milestones achieved

  7. Transporting children to appointments, school, or activities as required, ensuring appropriate safety measures during travel

  8. Responding promptly to children's emotional and physical needs, providing comfort and reassurance when necessary

  9. Following established routines and schedules whilst remaining flexible to adapt to children's individual needs and circumstances


What we're looking for

  1. Proven experience working as a nanny, childcare provider, or in a related childcare role, ideally with children of multiple age groups

  2. Strong knowledge of child development milestones and age-appropriate activities and learning techniques

  3. Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage positively with both children and parents

  4. Demonstrated commitment to child safety, including knowledge of first aid and basic health protocols

  5. Ability to manage multiple tasks effectively whilst maintaining a calm, patient, and nurturing demeanour

  6. Reliability, punctuality, and a strong sense of responsibility towards the families and children you support

  7. Physical fitness and energy to keep up with children's activities throughout the day

  8. Flexibility and adaptability in responding to changing needs and circumstances

  9. Preferably, formal qualifications or certifications in childcare, early childhood education, or first aid

  10. Understanding of local culture, values, and parenting practices in Lombok


What we offer

At Step Forward Lombok, we are committed to supporting our team members and creating a workplace where you can thrive. We offer competitive remuneration reflective of your experience and qualifications. You will receive comprehensive support and mentoring to develop your professional skills and knowledge in childcare. We foster a collaborative, family-oriented environment where your contributions are valued and recognised. As part of our team, you will have opportunities to expand your expertise and grow within the organisation. We prioritise your wellbeing and work-life balance, offering flexibility where possible to accommodate personal needs. Additionally, you will benefit from ongoing training and professional development opportunities to enhance your capabilities as a childcare professional.

About us

Step Forward Lombok is dedicated to providing exceptional care and support services to families across Lombok Tengah, Nusa Tenggara Barat. We are passionate about nurturing children's growth and development whilst supporting families in achieving their goals and aspirations. Our mission is to create safe, loving, and enriching environments where children can flourish and families can thrive. We are committed to maintaining the highest standards of care, professionalism, and integrity in everything we do. As a values-driven organisation, we believe in making a positive impact on the community we serve and investing in the development of our dedicated team members.

Apply now

If you are a dedicated and compassionate childcare professional ready to make a positive impact on children's lives, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your application, including your CV, references, and a cover letter outlining your relevant experience and passion for childcare. Join the Step Forward Lombok family and be part of something meaningful.

jobs.title: ADMIN
jobs.description: Gambaran Umum Pekerjaan Kami mencari seorang Admin yang profesional dan terorganisir untuk bergabung dengan tim CV Indo Jaya Putra di Denpasar, Bali. Sebagai seorang Admin, Anda akan memainkan peran penting dalam mendukung kelancaran operasional harian perusahaan. Posisi ini bersifat kontrak dan memerlukan individu yang detail-oriented, responsif, dan mampu menangani berbagai tugas administratif dengan efisien. Anda akan bekerja di lokasi kami di Denpasar, Bali, dan menjadi bagian integral dari tim dukungan perkantoran kami. Tanggung Jawab Utama Mengelola administrasi harian, termasuk pengorganisasian dokumen, pengarsipan, dan pemeliharaan catatan perusahaan serta membuat surat dan dokumen seperti DO, Surat jalan dan Faktur. Menjawab telepon, email, dan pertanyaan klien dengan profesional dan responsif Mempersiapkan dan mendistribusikan surat, dokumen, dan laporan internal Mengatur jadwal rapat, acara, dan appointment untuk manajemen dan staf Mengelola inventaris kantor dan memesan perlengkapan yang diperlukan Mendukung proses administrasi dan koordinasi antar departemen Menginput data dan memelihara database perusahaan dengan akurat Melaksanakan tugas-tugas khusus sesuai permintaan manajemen Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Pendidikan minimal SMA atau sederajat; Diploma atau gelar dalam Administrasi, Manajemen Perkantoran, atau bidang terkait akan menjadi nilai tambah Pengalaman minimal 1-2 tahun di bidang administrasi perkantoran atau posisi dukungan klerikal yang serupa Kemampuan komunikasi tertulis dan lisan yang kuat dalam bahasa Indonesia dan bahasa Inggris Penguasaan aplikasi Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) dan perangkat lunak administrasi lainnya Kemampuan manajemen waktu yang baik dengan perhatian tinggi terhadap detail Sikap profesional, disiplin, dan dapat bekerja dalam tim Kemampuan multitasking dalam lingkungan yang dinamis dan penuh tekanan Pengalaman menggunakan sistem manajemen dokumen digital dianggap sebagai keuntungan Manfaat Utama Perusahaan Kompensasi yang kompetitif sesuai dengan standar industri regional Posisi kontrak yang jelas dengan kemungkinan perpanjangan berdasarkan kinerja Lingkungan kerja yang profesional dan mendukung di lokasi strategis Denpasar, Bali Kesempatan untuk mengembangkan keterampilan administrasi dan mengalami pertumbuhan profesional Tim yang kolaboratif dan budaya kerja yang positif Fasilitas kantor yang memadai untuk mendukung produktivitas kerja Anda Tentang Kami CV Indo Jaya Putra adalah perusahaan yang berkomitmen untuk memberikan layanan dan solusi bisnis berkualitas tinggi. Dengan kantor yang berlokasi di Denpasar, Bali, kami melayani berbagai klien dengan profesionalisme dan integritas. Kami percaya pada pentingnya tim yang solid dan didukung oleh administrasi yang efisien untuk mencapai tujuan bisnis kami. Perusahaan kami menghargai dedikasi, kerja keras, dan kontribusi setiap anggota tim dalam menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang produktif dan harmonis. Cara Melamar Jika Anda memenuhi kualifikasi di atas dan tertarik untuk bergabung dengan CV Indo Jaya Putra, kami mengundang Anda untuk lamar sekarang . Harap siapkan CV, surat lamaran, dan referensi profesional Anda. Kami menantikan untuk mengenal Anda dan mempertimbangkan kandidat yang paling sesuai untuk posisi ini.

Kami mencari seorang Admin yang profesional dan terorganisir untuk bergabung dengan tim CV Indo Jaya Putra di Denpasar, Bali. Sebagai seorang Admin, Anda akan memainkan peran penting dalam mendukung kelancaran operasional harian perusahaan. Posisi ini bersifat kontrak dan memerlukan individu yang detail-oriented, responsif, dan mampu menangani berbagai tugas administratif dengan efisien. Anda akan bekerja di lokasi kami di Denpasar, Bali, dan menjadi bagian integral dari tim dukungan perkantoran kami.

Tanggung Jawab Utama

  1. Mengelola administrasi harian, termasuk pengorganisasian dokumen, pengarsipan, dan pemeliharaan catatan perusahaan serta membuat surat dan dokumen seperti DO, Surat jalan dan Faktur.

  2. Menjawab telepon, email, dan pertanyaan klien dengan profesional dan responsif

  3. Mempersiapkan dan mendistribusikan surat, dokumen, dan laporan internal

  4. Mengatur jadwal rapat, acara, dan appointment untuk manajemen dan staf

  5. Mengelola inventaris kantor dan memesan perlengkapan yang diperlukan

  6. Mendukung proses administrasi dan koordinasi antar departemen

  7. Menginput data dan memelihara database perusahaan dengan akurat

  8. Melaksanakan tugas-tugas khusus sesuai permintaan manajemen


Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan

  1. Pendidikan minimal SMA atau sederajat; Diploma atau gelar dalam Administrasi, Manajemen Perkantoran, atau bidang terkait akan menjadi nilai tambah

  2. Pengalaman minimal 1-2 tahun di bidang administrasi perkantoran atau posisi dukungan klerikal yang serupa

  3. Kemampuan komunikasi tertulis dan lisan yang kuat dalam bahasa Indonesia dan bahasa Inggris

  4. Penguasaan aplikasi Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) dan perangkat lunak administrasi lainnya

  5. Kemampuan manajemen waktu yang baik dengan perhatian tinggi terhadap detail

  6. Sikap profesional, disiplin, dan dapat bekerja dalam tim

  7. Kemampuan multitasking dalam lingkungan yang dinamis dan penuh tekanan

  8. Pengalaman menggunakan sistem manajemen dokumen digital dianggap sebagai keuntungan


Manfaat Utama Perusahaan

  1. Kompensasi yang kompetitif sesuai dengan standar industri regional

  2. Posisi kontrak yang jelas dengan kemungkinan perpanjangan berdasarkan kinerja

  3. Lingkungan kerja yang profesional dan mendukung di lokasi strategis Denpasar, Bali

  4. Kesempatan untuk mengembangkan keterampilan administrasi dan mengalami pertumbuhan profesional

  5. Tim yang kolaboratif dan budaya kerja yang positif

  6. Fasilitas kantor yang memadai untuk mendukung produktivitas kerja Anda


Tentang Kami
CV Indo Jaya Putra adalah perusahaan yang berkomitmen untuk memberikan layanan dan solusi bisnis berkualitas tinggi. Dengan kantor yang berlokasi di Denpasar, Bali, kami melayani berbagai klien dengan profesionalisme dan integritas. Kami percaya pada pentingnya tim yang solid dan didukung oleh administrasi yang efisien untuk mencapai tujuan bisnis kami. Perusahaan kami menghargai dedikasi, kerja keras, dan kontribusi setiap anggota tim dalam menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang produktif dan harmonis.

Cara Melamar
Jika Anda memenuhi kualifikasi di atas dan tertarik untuk bergabung dengan CV Indo Jaya Putra, kami mengundang Anda untuk lamar sekarang. Harap siapkan CV, surat lamaran, dan referensi profesional Anda. Kami menantikan untuk mengenal Anda dan mempertimbangkan kandidat yang paling sesuai untuk posisi ini.

Tri Express is seeking a Field Sales Representative to join our dynamic sales team in West Jakarta. This is a full-time position where you will be responsible for driving sales growth through direct customer engagement and relationship building. As a Field Sales Representative, you will be the face of Tri Express in the market, working to identify new business opportunities, close sales deals, and maintain strong relationships with our existing customer base. With a commitment to reliability, efficiency, and customer satisfaction, we have established ourselves as a trusted partner for businesses and individuals seeking timely and secure delivery solutions. Our company values integrity, innovation, and excellence in everything we do. We are passionate about connecting people and businesses through our comprehensive service offerings and dedicated team. At Tri Express, we foster a dynamic and inclusive workplace where talented individuals can grow their careers whilst contributing to our mission of delivering exceptional service to our customers.

jobs.title: (DPK) Native Science Teacher
jobs.description: Odysee Education is one of Indonesia’s leading education consultants that specializes in recruiting English-speaking teachers with a network of schools and education institutions which serves over 30,000 students nationwide. We believe great education starts with teachers who feel supported, respected, and inspired and that’s exactly the kind of environment we strive to create. Responsibilities: Teaching Science to students across different grade levels. Creating fun and engaging lesson plans. Supporting student progress and providing constructive feedback. Working alongside a friendly and collaborative teaching community. Qualifications: English speaker. Minimum 1 year of Science teaching experience in a school environment (any level). Bachelor’s degree in Science, Education, or a related field. Proven experience teaching Cambridge IGCSE and/or A-Level Science subjects is preferred, with a strong focus on exam preparation and assessment objectives. Able to adjust teaching methods based on student age and learning needs. Communicative, patient, and passionate about education. Benefits: 1. Competitive Salary Our salary is typically higher than other language institutions in Indonesia. The average salary of our teachers is equivalent to managerial positions in banks, with half the working period. 2. Accommodation Allowance On top of salary, we also provide monthly housing & transport allowance that is enough to afford a full-furnished apartment in prime locations. We have a team to help facilitate your relocation. 3. Company-Sponsored Working Permits Work without worry by getting all the necessary legal working permits sponsored by the company! 4. Paid Holidays Approximately 20 days of paid holiday (December and January) + 15 observed Indonesian public holidays. 5. Bonus Upon the completion of an academic year, one month's salary will be given as a bonus. Extra bonuses will be offered if certain criteria have been achieved. 6. Travel Opportunity Want to explore the beautiful country? We offer opportunities to be placed in different areas in Indonesia. 7. Self-Development Opportunities (Classroom Observations) To help you become a better educator, we do 4 classroom observations in a year. 8. Sponsorship for Further Study Possess every qualification but not the ESL teaching certificate? Don’t worry, we believe in developing people. That is why we will consider sponsoring your certification and training if you pass our selection process. 9. All-Around Support Team Our team will assist you to make your transition as smooth as possible! We can help you to find accomodations, transportations, and anything else you'll need to help you with your duties. 10. Community We're 40+ teachers strong! Join our community of teachers that helps each other to grow to be the best educators.

jobs.title: Content Creator
jobs.description: Job Requirements Minimum 2 years of experience in Content Creation, Social Media, Digital Marketing, or a related field. Highly proficient in using Canva and CapCut. Possess strong photography and videography skills using an iPhone. In-depth understanding of Instagram, TikTok, and Threads strategies. Stay up-to-date with social media trends, especially short-form video content. Strong copywriting skills in both Indonesian and English. Creative, proactive, detail-oriented, and able to thrive in a fast-paced environment. Capable of managing multiple brands and projects simultaneously. Job Description Execute content planning, content shooting (using an iPhone), editing, copywriting, scheduling, and posting. Proficiently use Canva for daily content design needs and CapCut for editing short-form video content. Develop content ideas that are relevant to current trends, target audiences, and brand objectives. Create and manage the Social Media Master Plan (Content Calendar & Editorial Plan) aligned with each brand's strategy, business goals, and content pillars. Create activation campaigns, social media campaigns, and engagement ideas tailored to client needs. Responsible for the end-to-end management of all client social media accounts, including Instagram, TikTok, Threads, and other relevant platforms. Understand growth strategies and content optimization on Instagram, TikTok, and Threads, including analyzing content performance and developing data-driven strategies. Proficient in TikTok Analytics, Instagram Insights, and other analytics tools to evaluate content performance and provide actionable recommendations. Prepare monthly performance reports along with insights and strategy recommendations for each client. Ensure all projects and content run according to the established timeline, KPIs, and targets. Manage and archive all content assets and project files in a neat and organized manner. Produce articles, captions, and copywriting based on client requirements. Willing to act as talent for beauty, lifestyle, wellness, and social media content needs when required.

jobs.title: (CKR) Native Science Teacher
jobs.description: Odysee Education is one of Indonesia’s leading education consultants that specializes in recruiting English-speaking teachers with a network of schools and education institutions which serves over 30,000 students nationwide. We believe great education starts with teachers who feel supported, respected, and inspired and that’s exactly the kind of environment we strive to create. Responsibilities: Teaching Science to students across different grade levels. Creating fun and engaging lesson plans. Supporting student progress and providing constructive feedback. Working alongside a friendly and collaborative teaching community. Qualifications: English speaker. Minimum 1 year of Science teaching experience in a school environment (any level). Bachelor’s degree in Science, Education, or a related field. Proven experience teaching Cambridge IGCSE and/or A-Level Science subjects is preferred, with a strong focus on exam preparation and assessment objectives. Able to adjust teaching methods based on student age and learning needs. Communicative, patient, and passionate about education. Benefits: 1. Competitive Salary Our salary is typically higher than other language institutions in Indonesia. The average salary of our teachers is equivalent to managerial positions in banks, with half the working period. 2. Accommodation Allowance On top of salary, we also provide monthly housing & transport allowance that is enough to afford a full-furnished apartment in prime locations. We have a team to help facilitate your relocation. 3. Company-Sponsored Working Permits Work without worry by getting all the necessary legal working permits sponsored by the company! 4. Paid Holidays Approximately 20 days of paid holiday (December and January) + 15 observed Indonesian public holidays. 5. Bonus Upon the completion of an academic year, one month's salary will be given as a bonus. Extra bonuses will be offered if certain criteria have been achieved. 6. Travel Opportunity Want to explore the beautiful country? We offer opportunities to be placed in different areas in Indonesia. 7. Self-Development Opportunities (Classroom Observations) To help you become a better educator, we do 4 classroom observations in a year. 8. Sponsorship for Further Study Possess every qualification but not the ESL teaching certificate? Don’t worry, we believe in developing people. That is why we will consider sponsoring your certification and training if you pass our selection process. 9. All-Around Support Team Our team will assist you to make your transition as smooth as possible! We can help you to find accomodations, transportations, and anything else you'll need to help you with your duties. 10. Community We're 40+ teachers strong! Join our community of teachers that helps each other to grow to be the best educators.

jobs.title: Sales Project Executive (Mandarin Speaker)
jobs.description: Position Title: Sales Project Executive (Mandarin Speaker) Location: South Jakarta, DKI Jakarta Employment Type: Full-Time Job Summary : Responsible for developing and managing project sales opportunities for sanitary ware products, including faucets, toilets, showers, sinks, and related bathroom accessories. The role focuses on building strong relationships with developers, contractors, architects, interior designers, dealers, and other business partners while achieving sales targets and expanding market share. Mandarin proficiency is required to communicate effectively with Chinese-speaking clients, suppliers, and internal stakeholders. Key Responsibilities : Develop and maintain relationships with developers, contractors, architects, interior designers, dealers, and key accounts. Identify new business opportunities and generate project sales leads for sanitary products and related building materials. Conduct product presentations, client meetings, and site visits to understand customer requirements. Prepare quotations, negotiate pricing and commercial terms, and follow up on project opportunities until closing. Handle project tenders and coordinate with internal teams regarding product specifications, delivery schedules, and customer requirements. Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and customer feedback to support business development strategies. Coordinate with the warehouse, logistics, finance, and marketing teams to ensure smooth sales operations and customer satisfaction. Achieve individual sales targets and contribute to the overall growth of the company. Prepare regular sales reports, sales forecasts, and pipeline updates for management. Requirements : Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Engineering, Architecture, or a related field. Minimum 3 years of experience in project sales, preferably in the sanitary ware, building materials, bathroom fittings, ceramic, or home improvement industry. Fluent in Mandarin (spoken and written); English proficiency is an advantage. Strong network with developers, contractors, architects, interior designers, and dealers is highly preferred. Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills. Target-oriented, proactive, and able to work independently. Willing to travel for client visits, project follow-ups, and business meetings. Proficient in Microsoft Office; experience with CRM systems is a plus. NOTED : Please submit your CV in English.

jobs.title: Sales Canvassing Suku Cadang Mobil
jobs.description: Gambaran Umum Pekerjaan Kami mencari Sales Canvassing Suku Cadang Mobil yang energik dan berdedikasi untuk bergabung dengan tim penjualan PT. Yokomitsu Auto Parts di Kalimantan Timur. Sebagai Sales Canvassing, Anda akan menjadi garis depan dalam memperluas jangkauan pasar dan membangun hubungan pelanggan yang kuat di wilayah ini. Posisi ini memainkan peran strategis dalam meningkatkan penetrasi pasar dan volume penjualan suku cadang mobil berkualitas tinggi kami kepada bengkel, dealer, dan pelanggan retail. Ini adalah pekerjaan fulltime yang memerlukan aktivitas lapangan, dengan fokus pada prospecting, presentasi produk, dan penyelesaian penjualan. Lokasi kerja berada di Kalimantan Timur dengan mobilitas tinggi ke berbagai lokasi pelanggan. Tanggung Jawab Utama Melakukan canvassing dan prospecting secara aktif untuk mengidentifikasi potensi pelanggan baru di wilayah yang ditugaskan, termasuk bengkel, dealer, dan pengguna akhir Mempresentasikan dan mendemonstrasikan produk suku cadang mobil dengan cara yang menarik dan informatif untuk membangun minat pelanggan Membangun dan mempertahankan hubungan pelanggan yang kuat melalui komunikasi yang konsisten, layanan pelanggan yang responsif, dan follow-up yang berkualitas Mencapai target penjualan yang telah ditetapkan melalui penutupan penjualan yang efektif dan penawaran yang disesuaikan dengan kebutuhan pelanggan Melakukan survey pasar dan analisis kompetitor untuk memberikan insights yang berharga kepada manajemen tentang tren industri dan positioning produk Mengelola database pelanggan dan catatan transaksi dengan akurat serta menyiapkan laporan penjualan berkala Memberikan feedback pelanggan kepada tim internal untuk membantu pengembangan produk dan peningkatan layanan Menghadiri training dan workshop untuk meningkatkan pengetahuan produk dan keterampilan penjualan Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Pendidikan minimal SMA atau sederajat; lulusan SMK Otomotif atau Diploma dalam bidang terkait menjadi nilai tambah Pengalaman minimal 2 tahun di bidang penjualan, khususnya dalam industri suku cadang, automotive, atau distribusi Kemampuan komunikasi dan presentasi yang baik, dengan kemampuan untuk mempengaruhi dan membujuk calon pelanggan Keterampilan negosiasi yang kuat untuk mencapai kesepakatan yang menguntungkan kedua belah pihak Pengetahuan tentang produk suku cadang mobil atau willingness untuk mempelajari spesifikasi produk dengan cepat Kemampuan manajemen waktu yang baik dan orientasi terhadap hasil dengan fokus pada pencapaian target Integritas tinggi, profesionalisme, dan etika kerja yang kuat dalam setiap interaksi pelanggan Kemampuan beradaptasi dalam lingkungan yang dinamis dan menghadapi rejection dengan sikap positif Memiliki transportasi pribadi atau bersedia menggunakan kendaraan perusahaan untuk mobilitas lapangan Kemauan untuk bekerja di area geografis Kalimantan Timur dengan fleksibilitas untuk perjalanan dinas Manfaat Utama Perusahaan Gaji pokok yang kompetitif disesuaikan dengan pengalaman dan kinerja Insentif dan bonus berdasarkan pencapaian target penjualan Tunjangan transportasi dan tunjangan lapangan untuk mendukung aktivitas canvassing Asuransi kesehatan untuk karyawan dan keluarga Program pengembangan karier dengan kesempatan untuk promosi ke posisi supervisor atau management Training berkelanjutan tentang produk, teknik penjualan, dan pengembangan soft skills Lingkungan kerja yang suportif dengan tim yang solid dan managemen yang terbuka Fleksibilitas dalam metode kerja dengan otonomi untuk mengelola wilayah penjualan Anda Tentang Kami PT. Yokomitsu Auto Parts adalah distributor terkemuka suku cadang mobil berkualitas tinggi di Indonesia dengan komitmen untuk menyediakan produk original dan aftermarket terbaik. Dengan pengalaman bertahun-tahun di industri otomotif, kami telah membangun reputasi solid sebagai supplier yang dapat diandalkan oleh bengkel, dealer, dan pengguna akhir. Visi kami adalah menjadi mitra utama dalam memenuhi kebutuhan suku cadang otomotif dengan standar kualitas internasional dan layanan pelanggan yang exceptional. Kami percaya pada pengembangan karyawan dan menciptakan budaya kerja yang menghargai inovasi, integritas, dan hasil yang terukur. Bergabung dengan PT. Yokomitsu Auto Parts berarti menjadi bagian dari tim yang passionate tentang industri otomotif dan berkomitmen terhadap kesuksesan bersama. Lamar Sekarang

Kembangkan karir di industri otomotif bersama distributor terkemuka.", "content2": "

Gambaran Umum Pekerjaan
Kami mencari Sales Canvassing Suku Cadang Mobil yang energik dan berdedikasi untuk bergabung dengan tim penjualan PT. Yokomitsu Auto Parts di Kalimantan Timur. Sebagai Sales Canvassing, Anda akan menjadi garis depan dalam memperluas jangkauan pasar dan membangun hubungan pelanggan yang kuat di wilayah ini. Posisi ini memainkan peran strategis dalam meningkatkan penetrasi pasar dan volume penjualan suku cadang mobil berkualitas tinggi kami kepada bengkel, dealer, dan pelanggan retail. Ini adalah pekerjaan fulltime yang memerlukan aktivitas lapangan, dengan fokus pada prospecting, presentasi produk, dan penyelesaian penjualan. Lokasi kerja berada di Kalimantan Timur dengan mobilitas tinggi ke berbagai lokasi pelanggan.

Tanggung Jawab Utama

  1. Melakukan canvassing dan prospecting secara aktif untuk mengidentifikasi potensi pelanggan baru di wilayah yang ditugaskan, termasuk bengkel, dealer, dan pengguna akhir

  2. Mempresentasikan dan mendemonstrasikan produk suku cadang mobil dengan cara yang menarik dan informatif untuk membangun minat pelanggan

  3. Membangun dan mempertahankan hubungan pelanggan yang kuat melalui komunikasi yang konsisten, layanan pelanggan yang responsif, dan follow-up yang berkualitas

  4. Mencapai target penjualan yang telah ditetapkan melalui penutupan penjualan yang efektif dan penawaran yang disesuaikan dengan kebutuhan pelanggan

  5. Melakukan survey pasar dan analisis kompetitor untuk memberikan insights yang berharga kepada manajemen tentang tren industri dan positioning produk

  6. Mengelola database pelanggan dan catatan transaksi dengan akurat serta menyiapkan laporan penjualan berkala

  7. Memberikan feedback pelanggan kepada tim internal untuk membantu pengembangan produk dan peningkatan layanan

  8. Menghadiri training dan workshop untuk meningkatkan pengetahuan produk dan keterampilan penjualan


Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan

  1. Pendidikan minimal SMA atau sederajat; lulusan SMK Otomotif atau Diploma dalam bidang terkait menjadi nilai tambah

  2. Pengalaman minimal 2 tahun di bidang penjualan, khususnya dalam industri suku cadang, automotive, atau distribusi

  3. Kemampuan komunikasi dan presentasi yang baik, dengan kemampuan untuk mempengaruhi dan membujuk calon pelanggan

  4. Keterampilan negosiasi yang kuat untuk mencapai kesepakatan yang menguntungkan kedua belah pihak

  5. Pengetahuan tentang produk suku cadang mobil atau willingness untuk mempelajari spesifikasi produk dengan cepat

  6. Kemampuan manajemen waktu yang baik dan orientasi terhadap hasil dengan fokus pada pencapaian target

  7. Integritas tinggi, profesionalisme, dan etika kerja yang kuat dalam setiap interaksi pelanggan

  8. Kemampuan beradaptasi dalam lingkungan yang dinamis dan menghadapi rejection dengan sikap positif

  9. Memiliki transportasi pribadi atau bersedia menggunakan kendaraan perusahaan untuk mobilitas lapangan

  10. Kemauan untuk bekerja di area geografis Kalimantan Timur dengan fleksibilitas untuk perjalanan dinas


Manfaat Utama Perusahaan

  1. Gaji pokok yang kompetitif disesuaikan dengan pengalaman dan kinerja

  2. Insentif dan bonus berdasarkan pencapaian target penjualan

  3. Tunjangan transportasi dan tunjangan lapangan untuk mendukung aktivitas canvassing

  4. Asuransi kesehatan untuk karyawan dan keluarga

  5. Program pengembangan karier dengan kesempatan untuk promosi ke posisi supervisor atau management

  6. Training berkelanjutan tentang produk, teknik penjualan, dan pengembangan soft skills

  7. Lingkungan kerja yang suportif dengan tim yang solid dan managemen yang terbuka

  8. Fleksibilitas dalam metode kerja dengan otonomi untuk mengelola wilayah penjualan Anda


Tentang Kami
PT. Yokomitsu Auto Parts adalah distributor terkemuka suku cadang mobil berkualitas tinggi di Indonesia dengan komitmen untuk menyediakan produk original dan aftermarket terbaik. Dengan pengalaman bertahun-tahun di industri otomotif, kami telah membangun reputasi solid sebagai supplier yang dapat diandalkan oleh bengkel, dealer, dan pengguna akhir. Visi kami adalah menjadi mitra utama dalam memenuhi kebutuhan suku cadang otomotif dengan standar kualitas internasional dan layanan pelanggan yang exceptional. Kami percaya pada pengembangan karyawan dan menciptakan budaya kerja yang menghargai inovasi, integritas, dan hasil yang terukur. Bergabung dengan PT. Yokomitsu Auto Parts berarti menjadi bagian dari tim yang passionate tentang industri otomotif dan berkomitmen terhadap kesuksesan bersama.

jobs.title: Business Expansion Strategy
jobs.description: Deskripsi Pekerjaan Melakukan analisis potensi kota dan wilayah. Melakukan feasibility analysis pembukaan cabang. Menyusun strategi ekspansi wilayah perusahaan. Membuat market mapping dan coverage area analysis. Menentukan kebutuhan dan pembagian cabang dalam suatu kota. Membuat simulasi kebutuhan resource dan operasional cabang. Menyusun roadmap pembukaan cabang baru. Membantu implementasi pembukaan cabang. Monitoring perkembangan cabang baru. Membantu evaluasi efektivitas ekspansi wilayah. Berkolaborasi dengan lintas direktorat terkait open branch untuk menyelaraskan proses open branch Melakukan analisis kompetitor dan identifikasi celah pasar (scarcity analysis) sebagai dasar pengembangan strategi open branch (termasuk koord dg commercial - S&M) untuk akuisisi customer Kualifikasi Diutamakan S1 Manajemen, Business Management, Marketing, Teknik Industri, Ekonomi, Business Development, atau Strategic Management. Pengalaman 2–5 tahun di bidang Business Development, Strategic Planning, Market Expansion, Market Research, atau Operational Expansion. Berpengalaman dalam analisis market/wilayah, strategi ekspansi, feasibility study, business projection, dan project pertumbuhan bisnis. Nilai tambah jika pernah handling ekspansi multi cabang, memahami territory strategy & market penetration, serta berpengalaman di industri ISP, telekomunikasi, retail chain, atau FMCG. Nilai tambah jika memiliki sertifikasi Business Development, Strategic Planning, Market Research, Feasibility Study, atau Project Management. Memahami business expansion strategy, market mapping, dan territory analysis. Mampu membuat market feasibility analysis, simulasi, dan proyeksi bisnis. Memiliki kemampuan analisis data market, reporting, dan presentasi. Strategic thinking, problem solving, dan growth mindset. jobs.title: Sales B2B Account Manager
jobs.description: Tanggung Jawab Utama Mengelola portofolio akun B2B yang sudah ada dan mengidentifikasi peluang cross-selling serta upselling untuk meningkatkan nilai akun. Membangun dan memelihara hubungan bisnis yang kuat dengan pengambil keputusan di perusahaan klien melalui komunikasi regular dan layanan pelanggan yang responsif. Mengembangkan strategi penjualan yang disesuaikan untuk setiap akun klien guna mencapai target revenue dan pertumbuhan bisnis. Melakukan presentasi solusi telekomunikasi Indosat kepada klien potensial dan yang sudah ada, menerangkan manfaat dan ROI dari setiap penawaran. Mengelola proses tender dan negosiasi kontrak dengan klien korporat untuk memastikan kesuksesan deal dan kepuasan kedua belah pihak. Memantau kepuasan pelanggan dan mengatasi keluhan atau masalah dengan cepat dan profesional untuk mempertahankan loyalitas klien. Melaporkan progress penjualan, metrik kinerja akun, dan forecast revenue secara berkala kepada manajemen. Berkolaborasi dengan tim internal lainnya, seperti tim teknis dan customer success, untuk memastikan implementasi solusi yang lancar. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Minimal 3-5 tahun pengalaman sebagai Account Manager B2B atau posisi sales B2B yang serupa, sebaiknya di industri telekomunikasi atau ISP. Pemahaman mendalam tentang produk dan layanan telekomunikasi, termasuk solusi korporat dan enterprise. Kemampuan komunikasi yang sangat baik, baik secara lisan maupun tertulis, dalam Bahasa Indonesia dan Bahasa Inggris. Keterampilan negosiasi yang kuat dan kemampuan untuk menutup deal dalam lingkungan yang kompetitif. Pengetahuan tentang proses penjualan B2B dan customer relationship management (CRM). Kemampuan analitik yang baik untuk mengidentifikasi trend pasar dan peluang pertumbuhan. Keahlian dalam manajemen waktu dan prioritas untuk menangani multiple akun secara simultan. Pengalaman dengan platform CRM modern dan tools sales analytics adalah nilai tambah. Gelar minimal sarjana dalam bidang Bisnis, Penjualan, atau Marketing diutamakan. Orientasi hasil yang kuat dengan track record mencapai atau melampaui target penjualan. Sikap proaktif, inisiatif, dan kemampuan untuk bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim.

jobs.title: Design Engineer Steel Bridge
jobs.description: Job Description : In offer/tender phase preparation of: Prepare preliminary design for steel and composite structures based on technical specifications, standards and codes. Prepare the design documentation for approval if required. Prepare technical specification and quantities for purchasing department to obtain offer price. Supporting purchasing department in offer evaluation. Prepare and guide drafters to prepare general drawing. Prepare technical specification, bridge description and other technical documentation for offer. Prepare PowerPoint presentation of design for clients if required. In project phase preparation of: Prepare detailed design analysis within the bill of quantity frame set up in tender phase according local and international standards. Prepare detailed design of welded and bolted connections, and detailed analysis of joint intersections. Prepare camber calculation. Prepare summary of design results for drafters to guide them in Prepare structural details including connection detail, weld joint detail for drafters. Prepare structural details including connection detail, weld joint detail for drafters. Prepare summary of design to prepare cutting plan and raw material order. Prepare specification and quantities of components for purchasing of components = technical evaluation of offers. Manage Lead team of drafters depending on scale of project, distributing work between drafter, controlling their work progress, controlling spent manhours and reporting these to Head of Engineering and Project Manager. Prepare and present all required reporting data such as weekly hours, monthly hours, performance report, etc. Requirements : Education Minimum graduated from University or Academy Technical/ Civil/ Mechanical/ Structure Bachelor Degree (D4). Posses a Certificate of National or International Certificate Degree of Technical/ Civil/ Structure/ Mechanical Engineer Certificate. Experience Minimum 2 (two) years experience as Design Engineer at a Design Company, Consultant or Steel Structural Fabricator. Have experience of design structural steel (bridge or building) with static and dynamic calculation software minimum 1 (one) years. Familiar with design of bridges, towers or other steel structural products Understand relevant National and International Standards and Code relating to steel structural design. Proficient using Midas software for computer supported design analysis Language Written and spoke with English and Bahasa Indonesia Computer Literate Able to operate static and dynamic calculation software (MIDAS, etc), CAD Software (AutoCAD 2000 or latest version), Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook), etc

  • Prepare specification and quantities of components for purchasing of components = technical evaluation of offers.

  • Manage Lead team of drafters depending on scale of project, distributing work between drafter, controlling their work progress, controlling spent manhours and reporting these to Head of Engineering and Project Manager.

  • Prepare and present all required reporting data such as weekly hours, monthly hours, performance report, etc.


Requirements :

Education

  • Minimum graduated from University or Academy Technical/ Civil/ Mechanical/ Structure Bachelor Degree (D4).

  • Posses a Certificate of National or International Certificate Degree of Technical/ Civil/ Structure/ Mechanical Engineer Certificate.

Experience

  • Minimum 2 (two) years experience as Design Engineer at a Design Company, Consultant or Steel Structural Fabricator.

  • Have experience of design structural steel (bridge or building) with static and dynamic calculation software minimum 1 (one) years.

  • Familiar with design of bridges, towers or other steel structural products

  • Understand relevant National and International Standards and Code relating to steel structural design.

  • Proficient using Midas software for computer supported design analysis

Language

  • Written and spoke with English and Bahasa Indonesia

Computer Literate

  • Able to operate static and dynamic calculation software (MIDAS, etc), CAD Software (AutoCAD 2000 or latest version), Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook), etc

jobs.title: Head of Sales Marketing
jobs.description: Persyaratan umum: • Minimal tamatan S1 • Pengalaman minimal 4 tahun di bidang Sales Marketing dengan minimal 2 tahun sebagai Head • Memiliki kemampuan memimpin dan manajerial dalam mengelola tim • Teliti, jujur, cekatan, bertanggung jawab, detail – oriented, komunikatif, mampu bekerja dengan deadline dan dapat dipercaya • Memiliki pengetahuan dasar mengenai penjualan dan ruang lingkup cakupannya serta sistem dan prosedur administrasi. • Dapat mengambil keputusan dengan cepat dan tepat. Uraian pekerjaan: • Mempertanggungjawabkan dan memastikan seluruh administrasi pemasaran & penjualan telah berjalan dengan baik dan benar sesuai SOP • Memastikan kepuasan pelanggan dengan menindaklanjuti keluhan atau umpan balik pelanggan untuk perbaikan layanan. • Bekerja sama dengan Direktur dalam menentukan strategi harga, diskon, dan promosi produk agar tetap kompetitif di pasar • Memantau dan mengevaluasi kinerja tim sales berdasarkan KPI yang telah ditetapkan, serta memberikan arahan dan pelatihan untuk meningkatkan performa penjualan. • Menganalisis tren pasar dan kebutuhan pelanggan di sektor autoparts & industrial untuk mengembangkan strategi ekspansi bisnis. • Mengidentifikasi peluang bisnis baru dan melakukan pengembangan pelanggan potensial di sektor industri dan autoparts. • Memiliki kemampuan dalam analisis tren pasar dan strategi pemasaran • Menguasai penggunaan CRM (Customer Relationship Management) untuk meningkatkan loyalitas pelanggan dan efektivitas penjualan. • Menjalin koordinasi dan hubungan baik dengan pihak principal; • Mempertanggungjawabkan pencapaian target penjualan tim sales yang telah ditetapkan; • Mendampingi sales dalam setiap kunjungan pertama ke customer baru ( selektif ) dan secara berkala

jobs.title: Leader Host Live Streaming
jobs.description: Kualifikasi: Minimal 2 tahun pengalaman di bidang yang sama (operator/koordinator live streaming/shift leader) Memiliki Keterampilan kepemimpinan, komunikasi, dan berpikir kreatif yang kuat Siap bekerja dalam lingkungan yang cepat berubah dan menuntut target Berdomisili atau bersedia ditempatkan di Cengkareng – Jakarta Barat Jobdesc: Mengelola dan menyusun jadwal untuk host Membuat laporan kinerja live streaming (harian, mingguan, bulanan) termasuk metrik viewers, engagement, checkout rate, dan GMV. Melatih host, membimbing gimmick dan skrip yang sesuai tema campaign. Mengontrol kedisiplinan, performa, dan kualitas interaksi semua host dan asisten. Menerjemahkan instruksi manajer ke dalam eksekusi lapangan, termasuk saat Flash Sale, promo campaign, atau launching produk. Briefing host harian mengenai kampanye, tema, produk prioritas, & info promosi yang sedang berjalan. Riset tren TikTok/Shopee serta kompetitor, untuk meningkatkan kualitas konten dan jumlah penonton live. Mengatur kondisi studio: memastikan produk ditata dengan baik, studio bersih, dan perangkat dimatikan setelah live. jobs.title: (BKS) Native Science Teacher
jobs.description: Odysee Education is one of Indonesia’s leading education consultants that specializes in recruiting English-speaking teachers with a network of schools and education institutions which serves over 30,000 students nationwide. We believe great education starts with teachers who feel supported, respected, and inspired and that’s exactly the kind of environment we strive to create. Responsibilities: Teaching Science to students across different grade levels. Creating fun and engaging lesson plans. Supporting student progress and providing constructive feedback. Working alongside a friendly and collaborative teaching community. Qualifications: English speaker. Minimum 1 year of Science teaching experience in a school environment (any level). Bachelor’s degree in Science, Education, or a related field. Proven experience teaching Cambridge IGCSE and/or A-Level Science subjects is preferred, with a strong focus on exam preparation and assessment objectives. Able to adjust teaching methods based on student age and learning needs. Communicative, patient, and passionate about education. Benefits: 1. Competitive Salary Our salary is typically higher than other language institutions in Indonesia. The average salary of our teachers is equivalent to managerial positions in banks, with half the working period. 2. Accommodation Allowance On top of salary, we also provide monthly housing & transport allowance that is enough to afford a full-furnished apartment in prime locations. We have a team to help facilitate your relocation. 3. Company-Sponsored Working Permits Work without worry by getting all the necessary legal working permits sponsored by the company! 4. Paid Holidays Approximately 20 days of paid holiday (December and January) + 15 observed Indonesian public holidays. 5. Bonus Upon the completion of an academic year, one month's salary will be given as a bonus. Extra bonuses will be offered if certain criteria have been achieved. 6. Travel Opportunity Want to explore the beautiful country? We offer opportunities to be placed in different areas in Indonesia. 7. Self-Development Opportunities (Classroom Observations) To help you become a better educator, we do 4 classroom observations in a year. 8. Sponsorship for Further Study Possess every qualification but not the ESL teaching certificate? Don’t worry, we believe in developing people. That is why we will consider sponsoring your certification and training if you pass our selection process. 9. All-Around Support Team Our team will assist you to make your transition as smooth as possible! We can help you to find accomodations, transportations, and anything else you'll need to help you with your duties. 10. Community We're 40+ teachers strong! Join our community of teachers that helps each other to grow to be the best educators.

  • Creating fun and engaging lesson plans.

Approximately 20 days of paid holiday (December and January) + 15 observed Indonesian public holidays.

To help you become a better educator, we do 4 classroom observations in a year.

Possess every qualification but not the ESL teaching certificate? Don’t worry, we believe in developing people. That is why we will consider sponsoring your certification and training if you pass our selection process.

jobs.title: Sales Industrial
jobs.description: Deskripsi Pekerjaan : - Mengidentifikasi dan mengejar peluang bisnis baru di sektor industri, konstruksi, dan distribusi untuk produk cat. - Mengembangkan strategi penjualan yang efektif untuk mencapai target penjualan bulanan dan tahunan. - Mengelola dan memperluas basis klien yang ada, serta mencari peluang untuk penjualan tambahan atau cross-selling. - Mempresentasikan produk cat dan solusi terkait kepada calon klien, menjelaskan manfaat dan fitur teknis produk. - Menyusun penawaran harga, melakukan negosiasi kontrak, dan menutup penjualan dengan efektif. - Mengelola proses penjualan dari pembuatan proposal hingga penutupan transaksi dan purna jual. - Mengumpulkan dan menganalisis data pasar untuk mengidentifikasi tren industri dan kebutuhan klien. - Menyusun laporan penjualan dan memberikan umpan balik kepada tim manajemen mengenai strategi pasar dan kinerja penjualan. - Menyediakan dukungan teknis dan konsultasi terkait produk cat, termasuk aplikasi, spesifikasi teknis, dan pemecahan masalah. - Menangani keluhan atau masalah klien secara cepat dan efektif untuk menjaga kepuasan klien. - Bekerja sama dengan tim pemasaran untuk merancang kampanye promosi yang sesuai dengan kebutuhan industri cat. - Berkoordinasi dengan tim produk untuk memahami fitur terbaru dan pembaruan produk cat. Kualifikasi : - Gelar Sarjana dalam bidang Pemasaran, Manajemen Bisnis, Teknik Kimia, atau bidang terkait. - Pengalaman kerja minimal 2-3 tahun dalam penjualan B2B, terutama dalam industri cat atau produk industri lainnya, diutamakan. - Keterampilan komunikasi verbal dan tertulis yang sangat baik, dengan kemampuan untuk menjelaskan aspek teknis produk cat secara jelas. - Kemampuan negosiasi dan penutupan penjualan yang terbukti. - Kemampuan presentasi yang efektif dan percaya diri dalam berinteraksi dengan klien tingkat eksekutif. - Proaktif, mandiri, dan berorientasi pada hasil dengan motivasi tinggi untuk mencapai target penjualan. - Kemampuan untuk bekerja di bawah tekanan dan menangani beberapa tugas sekaligus. - Kemampuan untuk membangun dan memelihara hubungan yang kuat dengan klien dan mitra bisnis. - Pengalaman dengan perangkat lunak CRM (Customer Relationship Management) seperti Salesforce, HubSpot, atau sistem serupa. - Kemampuan menggunakan alat analisis data dan aplikasi kantor (misalnya, Microsoft Office Suite). - Dapat mengendarai sepeda motor atau mobil - Memiliki SIM A dan SIM C

- Pengalaman kerja minimal 2-3 tahun dalam penjualan B2B, terutama dalam industri cat atau produk industri lainnya, diutamakan.

- Keterampilan komunikasi verbal dan tertulis yang sangat baik, dengan kemampuan untuk menjelaskan aspek teknis produk cat secara jelas.

- Kemampuan negosiasi dan penutupan penjualan yang terbukti.

- Kemampuan presentasi yang efektif dan percaya diri dalam berinteraksi dengan klien tingkat eksekutif.

- Proaktif, mandiri, dan berorientasi pada hasil dengan motivasi tinggi untuk mencapai target penjualan.

- Kemampuan untuk bekerja di bawah tekanan dan menangani beberapa tugas sekaligus.

- Kemampuan untuk membangun dan memelihara hubungan yang kuat dengan klien dan mitra bisnis.

- Pengalaman dengan perangkat lunak CRM (Customer Relationship Management) seperti Salesforce, HubSpot, atau sistem serupa.

- Kemampuan menggunakan alat analisis data dan aplikasi kantor (misalnya, Microsoft Office Suite).

- Dapat mengendarai sepeda motor atau mobil

- Memiliki SIM A dan SIM C

jobs.title: Site Manager
jobs.description: Kualifikasi: Pendidikan minimal S1 Teknik Sipil. Pengalaman minimal 2 tahun. Memiliki kepribadian yang bertanggung jawab, leadership tinggi, tegas, berkomitmen, jujur, berani, dan mampu bekerja di bawah tekanan. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik. Deskripsi Pekerjaan: Merencanakan dan melaksanakan proyek konstruksi sesuai dengan jadwal, kualitas, dan budget yang ditetapkan perusahaan. Mengawasi arah proyek, memastikan bahwa spesifikasi dan persyaratan klien terpenuhi, meninjau kemajuan dan berhubungan dengan surveyor kuantitas untuk memantau biaya. Terhubung klien, profesional konstruksi dan anggota masyarakat yang berkaitan dengan koordinasi dan mengawasi pekerja bangunan. Terlibat dalam pemilihan alat dan bahan. Membuat inspeksi keselamatan dan memastikan keamanan konstruksi dan lokasi. Memeriksa dan menyiapkan laporan situs, desain dan gambar. Menjaga prosedur kontrol kualitas. Menemukan cara untuk mencegah terjadinya masalah dan memecahkan masalah. Menilai dan meminimalkan risiko.

Meningkatkan engagement selama live streaming dengan berinteraksi secara aktif melalui komentar dan pertanyaan dari penonton. Mendorong peningkatan penjualan (sales conversion) selama sesi live berlangsung. Menyampaikan informasi mengenai promo, voucher, diskon, dan campaign yang sedang berjalan. Memastikan seluruh produk yang ditampilkan sesuai dengan standar dan informasi yang telah ditetapkan perusahaan. Berkoordinasi dengan tim Marketing, Creative, dan E-Commerce terkait tema, script, serta jadwal live streaming. Melakukan briefing sebelum live streaming dan evaluasi setelah live streaming.
