jobs.title: Store Head - Sumatera Utara
jobs.description: Job Description: Manage and supervise daily store operations to ensure smooth business activities and compliance with company standards. Responsible for achieving store sales targets through effective sales strategies, promotions, and team execution. Monitor, analyze, and report store sales performance, customer trends, and promotional effectiveness. Develop local sales opportunities, including partnerships, collaborations, promotions, and market expansion initiatives. Manage store manpower planning, including recruitment, staffing needs, team productivity, and employee performance. Train, coach, and supervise store team members to improve selling skills, service quality, and operational effectiveness. Analyze product performance, market demand, and manage SKU ordering to ensure product availability. Coordinate product shipment and stock replenishment from warehouse to store. Manage store operational expenses, including petty cash usage and accountability. Handle store-specific promotional activities and submit LOA approval for special transactions, promotions, and manpower additions. Coordinate with internal departments (Warehouse, HR, Creative, Finance, and Management) to support store operations. Maintain store performance, customer experience, and operational standards. Qualifications: Education: Minimum Bachelor's Degree (S1) Experience: Minimum 2–3 years as a Store Manager or Supervisor in retail fashion Able to communicate politely and effectively in both Bahasa Indonesia and English Strong leadership skills and team management capabilities Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with diverse customers and staff Able to work under pressure and maintain emotional balance Well-organized and experienced in scheduling work shifts Willing to be placed in Sumatera Utra area and rotate locations from time to time Honest and with high integrity Placement: Kisaran, Rantauprapat, Padang Sidempuan

About the role

PT SINO INDONESIA TCM COOPERATION CENTRE is seeking an experienced and dedicated Dokter (TCM, Traditional Chinese Medicine) to join our healthcare team in South Jakarta, Jakarta. This is a full-time position that offers a unique opportunity to practise and advance your expertise in Traditional Chinese Medicine within a progressive healthcare setting. As a TCM Doctor, you will play a vital role in delivering authentic and evidence-based traditional Chinese medical services to our diverse patient population, whilst contributing to the growing recognition and integration of TCM within modern healthcare in Indonesia.

Key responsibilities

  1. Conduct comprehensive patient consultations and assessments utilising TCM diagnostic techniques, including pulse diagnosis, tongue diagnosis, and detailed medical history taking

  2. Develop and implement individualised treatment plans based on TCM principles and each patient's unique condition and constitution

  3. Administer a range of TCM treatments including acupuncture, moxibustion, cupping, guasha, and herbal medicine prescriptions

  4. Maintain accurate and detailed patient medical records and treatment documentation in compliance with healthcare regulations

  5. Educate and counsel patients on TCM theories, lifestyle modifications, dietary recommendations, and preventative health measures

  6. Collaborate with other healthcare professionals to ensure comprehensive and integrated patient care

  7. Stay current with advancements in TCM practice and participate in ongoing professional development and training

  8. Monitor patient progress and treatment outcomes, adjusting treatment protocols as necessary

  9. Ensure all clinical practice adheres to relevant healthcare standards, regulations, and professional ethical guidelines


What we're looking for

  1. Valid licence to practise as a Traditional Chinese Medicine Doctor in Indonesia

  2. Minimum of 2-3 years of clinical experience in TCM practice

  3. Comprehensive knowledge and proficiency in TCM diagnostic methods and treatment modalities

  4. Expertise in acupuncture, herbal medicine, moxibustion, and other traditional Chinese therapeutic techniques

  5. Strong understanding of TCM theory and its application to various acute and chronic conditions

  6. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain complex TCM concepts to patients from diverse backgrounds

  7. Commitment to maintaining detailed patient records and adhering to healthcare documentation standards

  8. Patient-centred approach with empathy and cultural sensitivity

  9. Professional demeanour and adherence to medical ethics and confidentiality standards

  10. Willingness to engage in continued professional development and stay informed of evidence-based practices in TCM

  11. Preferred: Experience in working within a multi-disciplinary healthcare environment or clinic setting


About us

PT SINO INDONESIA TCM COOPERATION CENTRE is a dedicated healthcare provider committed to delivering authentic Traditional Chinese Medicine services to the people of Indonesia. We are passionate about bridging the gap between ancient TCM wisdom and contemporary healthcare needs. Our centre operates with a mission to promote holistic health and wellness through time-tested TCM practices, whilst maintaining the highest standards of clinical excellence and patient care. We foster an environment of mutual respect, cultural appreciation, and continuous learning, where practitioners can advance their expertise and make a meaningful impact on patient wellbeing.

What we offer

  1. Full-time employment with competitive remuneration and benefits package

  2. Professional work environment with modern clinical facilities and equipment

  3. Opportunity to practise authentic TCM and develop your clinical expertise

  4. Supportive team culture and collaboration with like-minded healthcare professionals

  5. Access to professional development and continuing education opportunities

  6. Flexible scheduling options to maintain a healthy work-life balance

  7. The satisfaction of making a meaningful difference in patients' lives through holistic healthcare


Apply now

If you are a qualified and passionate TCM Doctor seeking to join a forward-thinking healthcare centre, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your CV, professional licence documentation, and a brief cover letter outlining your clinical experience and interest in joining PT SINO INDONESIA TCM COOPERATION CENTRE to our recruitment team. We look forward to welcoming you to our team.

jobs.title: Sales & Marketing Lampung
jobs.description: Tentang Peran PT Intergastra Nusantara, perusahaan terkemuka di industri Distributor Alat Kesehatan di Indonesia, sedang mencari Area Sales Representative Lampung yang berpengalaman untuk wilayah Kota Lampung. Anda akan memainkan peran kunci dalam mengembangkan dan mempertahankan hubungan pelanggan yang kuat, serta memperluas jangkauan penjualan produk-produk berkualitas kami di pasar yang kompetitif. Tanggung Jawab Mengikuti acara seminar, conference dan lainnya yang diinformasikan dari kantor / anda dapatkan informasi dari customer Mengunjungi RS/Customer sesuai pembahasan dengan direct supervisor anda Menawarkan produk di assign oleh direct supervisor anda (anda harus mengetahui produk tersebut dan menjelaskan ke customer) Melakukan presentasi apabila sudah memungkinkan Menjadikan potensial lead sebagai Sales Order Kordinasi dengan admin support mengenai brosur, penawaran, surat-surat, stock, dan delivery Kordinasi denga keuangan mengenai penagihan Kordinasi dengan after sales mengenai kebutuhan instalasi, maintenance dan troubleshooting Membantu informasi dan kordinasi kondisi unit mesin dan status service mesin di RS yang menggunakan mesin dari Intergastra Berkordinasi dengan Supervisor Kualifikasi : Pendidikan minimal Diploma semua jurusan (Lebih diutamakan bidang kesehatan) Pengalaman minimal 1 tahun di bidang yang sama Menguasai Microsoft Office Menguasai B.Inggris Komunikatif, Inisiatif, Bekerja Keras, Detail, Target Oriented, Mampu bekerjasama ataupun individu Diutamakan domisili Kota Lampung Manfaat Gaji yang kompetitif dan paket bonus menarik berdasarkan kinerja. Pelatihan dan pengembangan profesional yang berkelanjutan. Kesempatan untuk berkembang dan berkarir di perusahaan terkemuka. Lingkungan kerja yang kolaboratif dan mendukung. Fasilitas kantor modern dan tunjangan perjalanan dinas. Tentang Kami PT Intergastra Nusantara adalah pemain terkemuka di industri Distributor Alat Kesehatan di Indonesia. Dengan pengalaman lebih dari 20 tahun, kami telah membangun reputasi kuat sebagai penyedia produk berkualitas tinggi dan inovatif. Tim kami yang beragam dan berdedikasi merupakan aset utama kami. Kami menawarkan lingkungan kerja yang inklusif, kolaboratif, dan mendukung untuk memungkinkan karyawan kami mencapai potensi penuh mereka. Jika Anda tertarik untuk bergabung dengan kami dan menjadi bagian dari perjalanan pertumbuhan kami, lamar sekarang!

jobs.title: Supervisor Mine Plan / Engineering
jobs.description: Kualifikasi Pendidikan minimal S1 Teknik Pertambangan . Memiliki pengalaman minimal 5 tahun di bidang Mine Planning/Engineering pada perusahaan pertambangan nikel atau pertambangan mineral lainnya, dengan pengalaman minimal 2 tahun sebagai Supervisor Mine Plan/Engineering . Memiliki sertifikat Pengawas Operasional Pertama (POP) yang masih berlaku (wajib). Memahami peraturan pertambangan dan kaidah Good Mining Practice (GMP) serta keselamatan kerja pertambangan. Menguasai penyusunan dan evaluasi: Life of Mine (LoM). Long Term Plan (LTP). Medium Term Plan (MTP). Short Term Plan (STP). Weekly dan Daily Mine Plan. Mampu membuat dan mengevaluasi: Pit Design. Pushback Design. Haul Road Design. Disposal Design. Stockpile Design. Drainage Design. Sequence Mining. Menguasai perhitungan teknis meliputi: Ore Reserve. Volume Ore dan Waste. Stripping Ratio (SR). Cut and Fill. Fleet Requirement. Productivity Analysis. Menguasai software pertambangan, seperti: Surpac. Minescape. Datamine. Vulcan. MineSched (nilai tambah). AutoCAD. ArcGIS/QGIS (nilai tambah). Microsoft Office (terutama Excel). Memahami operasional pertambangan nikel, termasuk: Open Pit Mining. Ore Control. Loading & Hauling. Stockpile Management. Dewatering. Mine Survey (nilai tambah). Mampu menganalisis pencapaian produksi dan memberikan rekomendasi untuk meningkatkan produktivitas serta efisiensi operasional. Memiliki kemampuan kepemimpinan, komunikasi, analisis, koordinasi lintas departemen, dan pengambilan keputusan yang baik. Bersedia ditempatkan di lokasi tambang dengan sistem roster. Sehat jasmani dan rohani serta bersedia menjalani pemeriksaan kesehatan dan tes narkoba. Tugas dan Tanggung Jawab Menyusun rencana penambangan harian, mingguan, bulanan, hingga jangka panjang sesuai target produksi. Membuat desain pit, haul road, disposal, stockpile, dan infrastruktur tambang lainnya. Menentukan sequence penambangan yang aman, efisien, dan sesuai target produksi. Menghitung volume ore, waste, stripping ratio, serta kebutuhan alat berat. Melakukan evaluasi realisasi produksi terhadap rencana dan menyusun rekomendasi perbaikan. Berkoordinasi dengan Departemen Geologi, Grade Control, Survey, Mine Operation, HSE, dan Plant untuk memastikan implementasi rencana berjalan optimal. Melakukan optimasi desain tambang untuk meningkatkan produktivitas dan efisiensi biaya operasional. Memastikan seluruh desain memenuhi aspek keselamatan, stabilitas lereng, drainase, dan ketentuan teknis pertambangan. Menyusun laporan teknis, KPI, serta presentasi kepada manajemen. Mendukung penyusunan RKAB, anggaran operasional tambang, dan evaluasi pencapaian target produksi. Membimbing dan mengembangkan tim Mine Plan/Engineering agar mampu menjalankan tugas sesuai standar perusahaan. Kompetensi yang Dibutuhkan Mine Planning. Mine Engineering. Pit Design. Production Planning. Mine Scheduling. Fleet Productivity Analysis. Cost Control & Operational Efficiency. Leadership & Team Management. Analytical Thinking. Problem Solving. Decision Making. Communication & Report Writing. Persyaratan Tambahan (Diutamakan) Berpengalaman di pertambangan nikel laterit (open pit) . Memahami penyusunan RKAB dan pelaporan operasional pertambangan. Berpengalaman dalam optimasi desain tambang, analisis produktivitas alat, dan pengendalian biaya operasional. Memiliki kemampuan menggunakan software GIS atau drone mapping menjadi nilai tambah. Memiliki SIM A yang masih berlaku dan mampu mengemudikan kendaraan operasional di area tambang.

jobs.title: Personal Assistant ( Mandarin )
jobs.description: About the role We are seeking a full-time Personal Assistant (Mandarin) to join our Jakarta office. You will provide executive and administrative support to senior management while coordinating with Mandarin-speaking stakeholders. Strong Mandarin communication skills are essential to support collaboration with international business partners and clients. Key Responsibilities Provide executive and administrative support to senior management. Manage calendars, meetings, appointments, and travel arrangements. Coordinate with Mandarin-speaking clients, partners, and stakeholders. Translate and interpret documents, meetings, and business communications (Mandarin–English). Prepare presentations, reports, correspondence, and other business documents. Organize meetings, events, and business trips, including agendas and meeting materials. Handle confidential information with professionalism and discretion. Screen and prioritize emails, calls, and other incoming communications. Support business projects through research, coordination, and follow-up. Liaise with internal teams and external parties to ensure smooth communication and execution. What We're Looking For Fluent in Mandarin (spoken and written) with good English communication skills. Minimum 3–5 years of experience as a Personal Assistant, Executive Assistant, or in a similar role. Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to multitask. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook). High level of professionalism, integrity, and confidentiality. Proactive, resourceful, and able to work independently. Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills. Experience in an international or multicultural business environment is an advantage. What we offer We're committed to providing a supportive and professional working environment. We offer competitive remuneration and a comprehensive benefits package including health insurance, professional development opportunities and career progression pathways. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and foster a collaborative culture that values employee wellbeing and personal growth. As a full-time employee, you will have access to ongoing training and development programmes to enhance your skills and advance your career within our organisation. About us We are a dynamic and professionally managed organization committed to delivering excellence across all aspects of our business operations. We take pride in fostering strong international partnerships while upholding the highest standards of professionalism, integrity, and quality. Our team consists of dedicated and experienced professionals who value collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement. Operating in a multicultural business environment, we embrace diversity and encourage teamwork to achieve shared goals. We are committed to creating opportunities for talented individuals who are passionate about making a meaningful contribution to our continued growth and long-term success. If you are driven, eager to learn, and ready to be part of a collaborative team, we welcome you to join us. Apply now If you are an organized, detail-oriented professional with strong Mandarin language skills and a passion for providing exceptional administrative support, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your CV and a cover letter outlining your relevant experience to our Recruitment Team. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

jobs.title: Customer Service and Operation Specialist (air freight）
jobs.description: Company Overview Established in 2014, EasySpeed Supply Chain Co.,Ltd. is a leading innovator in cross-border e-commerce logistics, providing intelligent, end-to-end solutions for global import and export operations. With an annual revenue exceeding 1 billion U.S. dollars, a global presence spanning 22 offices, and a dedicated team of over 400 employees, we work closely with more than 400 freight agents,40 major airlines, and multiple ocean carriers. Every year, we operate over 1,000 international direct cargo charter flights, manage more than 200,000 tons of international air cargoand facilitate extensive ocean freight services, including full-container load (FCL) and less-than-container load (LCL) shipments. In addition to air and ocean freight, EasySpeed provides customs brokerage, warehousing, last-mile delivery, and tailored supply chain solutions to meet all logistics needs. Driven by continuous innovation, industry expertisee, and an unwavering commitment to excellence, EasySpeed delivers lasting valuue and reliability to our clients. We believe in forging meaningful partnerships, nurturing mutual trust, and adding a human touch to every journey. From air freight to ocean shipping and beyond, we ensure that every shipment moves forward with care, precision, and a genuine sense of connection. https://www.easy-speed.com/ Position Summary We are looking for a dedicated and detail-oriented freight Customer Service and Operation Specialist to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in freight forwarding and a passion for delivering exceptional customer service. This role involves managing customer inquiries, coordinating and handling airfreight shipments from end to end, and ensuring timely and accurate communication with clients and internal teams. Customer Support -Handle daily air freight operations, with a primary focus on GAP shipments. - Act as the primary point of contact for customers regarding the inquiries and shipments. - Address customer questions and issues promptly, ensuring high levels of satisfaction. Shipment Coordination - Manage the logistics of airfreight shipments, including booking, tracking, and documentation. - Collaborate with carriers, customs brokers, and other stakeholders to ensure timely deliveries. Problem Solving - Identify and resolve any issues that arise during the shipping process, proactively communicating with customers about any delays or changes. - Utilize critical thinking to find effective solutions for customer needs. Documentation and Compliance - Prepare and handle all hands-on documentation from end to end, to ensure compliance with international regulations and company policies. - Maintain accurate records of all transactions and communications related to airfreight shipments. Collaboration - Work closely with the teams to provide a seamless customer experience. - Assist in the development of operational improvements to enhance service delivery. Performance Tracking - Monitor customer feedback and service metrics, contributing to the continuous improvement of processes and procedures. Qualifications - Degree in Logistics, or a related field preferred. - Minimum 3 year of experience in handling GAP air freight operations. - Strong master of freight forwarding operations, documentation handling, regulations, and industry practices. - Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with a strong customer service orientation. - Detail-oriented with strong organizational and multitasking abilities. What We Offer - Competitive salary and promotion package. - Opportunities for rapid business development and career growth. - A collaborative and supportive work environment.

jobs.title: ERP Developer (Odoo)
jobs.description: Tanggung Jawab Pekerjaan: Mengembangkan, menyesuaikan, dan memelihara sistem ERP menggunakan framework Odoo 16 atau 18 dan Website Perusahaan Merancang dan mengimplementasikan modul custom Odoo berdasarkan kebutuhan bisnis dan Website Perusahaan Melakukan pengembangan menggunakan Python, PostgreSQL, JavaScript, XML (QWeb), PHP serta framework Laravel dan CodeIgniter Mengintegrasikan Odoo dengan sistem pihak ketiga melalui API (REST/JSON/XML-RPC). Melakukan pengujian ( testing ), perbaikan bug ( debugging ), dan pemecahan masalah ( troubleshooting ) aplikasi. Menganalisis sistem ERP yang ada dan mengusulkan perbaikan untuk meningkatkan performa dan efisiensi. Menyusun dokumentasi teknis dan mendukung dokumentasi fungsional. Berkolaborasi dengan tim internal (Keuangan, Operasional, HR, dll.) untuk mengoptimalkan penggunaan ERP. Mendukung penerapan sistem ( deployment ), konfigurasi, serta pembaruan ( upgrade ). Kualifikasi: Pendidikan: Gelar Sarjana (S1) di bidang Teknologi Informasi (Sistem Informasi, Ilmu Komputer, atau bidang terkait). Minimal 2–3 tahun pengalaman dalam pengembangan perangkat lunak, dengan pengalaman praktis dalam pengembangan Odoo (Odoo ERP) . Memiliki pengalaman terbukti dalam mengembangkan dan menyesuaikan modul Odoo ( CRM, inheritance, views, workflows ). Mahir dalam Pemrograman Python, PostgreSQL, JavaScript, integrasi API (REST/XML-RPC), PHP serta framework Laravel dan CodeIgniter Berpengalaman menangani modul Odoo seperti Sales, Inventory, Accounting, HR, atau Manufacturing . Mampu menunjukkan setidaknya 2–3 modul atau proyek kustom Odoo (diperlukan portofolio). Memiliki pemahaman yang kuat mengenai proses bisnis (sistem ERP). Memiliki kemampuan berpikir analitis yang baik, keterampilan pemecahan masalah, dan keterampilan komunikasi. Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun berkolaborasi dalam tim. Bersedia bekerja di kantor (WFO) hari Senin–Jumat di Harco Mangga Dua, Jakarta Pusat

jobs.title: Brand Marketing Manager (F&B)
jobs.description: Tanggung Jawab -Menyusun dan menjalankan strategi marketing yang selaras dengan target dan pertumbuhan bisnis. -Merancang, mengelola, dan mengevaluasi campaign online maupun offline untuk meningkatkan brand awareness, engagement, dan penjualan. -Mengembangkan strategi digital marketing, social media, content marketing, serta komunikasi brand yang konsisten. -Mengelola promosi, product launching, brand activation, event, sponsorship, dan kolaborasi dengan komunitas maupun partner. -Membangun kerja sama dengan KOL, influencer, media, dan strategic partner untuk memperluas eksposur brand. -Menganalisis performa campaign berdasarkan data dan KPI serta memberikan rekomendasi strategi. -Memimpin dan mengembangkan tim Marketing & Creative agar menghasilkan ide dan eksekusi yang efektif. -Berkolaborasi dengan tim Operasional, Sales, Product Development, dan Manajemen dalam mendukung pencapaian target bisnis. -Melakukan riset pasar, tren konsumen, dan aktivitas kompetitor untuk mengidentifikasi peluang bisnis. -Mewakili perusahaan dalam kegiatan branding, event, maupun aktivitas pemasaran lainnya. Kualifikasi -Pendidikan minimal S1 Marketing, Komunikasi, Manajemen, Bisnis, atau jurusan terkait. -Pengalaman minimal 3 tahun di bidang Marketing, Brand Marketing, Marketing Communication, atau Digital Marketing. -Berpengalaman di industri F&B, Retail, Hospitality, atau Lifestyle menjadi nilai tambah. -Memahami brand management, digital marketing, social media, content strategy, dan consumer behavior. -Berpengalaman menjalankan marketing campaign, promotional program, event, dan product launching. -Memiliki kemampuan analisis data, leadership, komunikasi, presentasi, negosiasi, dan project management yang baik. -Kreatif, proaktif, berorientasi pada target, serta mampu bekerja di lingkungan yang dinamis. -Menguasai Meta Business Suite, Google Analytics, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, atau platform marketing lainnya menjadi nilai tambah. -Percaya diri mewakili perusahaan di depan publik maupun kamera apabila diperlukan. -Bersedia melakukan perjalanan dinas sesuai kebutuhan perusahaan.

jobs.title: Deputy Director Legal
jobs.description: Key Responsibilities: Lead and oversee all legal aspects of the company’s operations, including contract review, litigation, compliance, and land-related matters. Develop and implement legal strategies that align with corporate and mining operational goals. Supervise the end-to-end permitting and licensing process and maintain strong engagement with relevant government institutions (e.g., ESDM, KLHK, local government) to support regulatory compliance and approvals. Monitor and ensure the company’s ongoing compliance with applicable laws and regulations, including mining, environmental, labor, and corporate law. Provide legal support for project financing, major contracts (e.g., procurement, EPC/EPCM), and strategic commercial transactions. Manage legal matters related to land use, community relations, and sustainability obligations. Represent the company in negotiations, legal proceedings, and coordinate with external legal counsel when needed. Lead internal legal education initiatives and ensure governance, ethics, and compliance standards are upheld. Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing legal team to support both corporate and operational needs. Qualifications: Bachelor’s Degree in Law, Master’s Degree or LL.M. is a strong advantage. Licensed to practice law in Indonesia (PERADI certified). Minimum 15 years of legal experience, with at least 5 years in a senior management position. Experience in the mining or energy/natural resources industry is essential. Deep knowledge of Indonesian mining regulations, licensing procedures, environmental law, corporate law, and land law. Proven experience in handling permitting and regulatory matters with government institutions. Strong leadership, risk management, and stakeholder engagement skills. Excellent communication and negotiation skills in both Bahasa Indonesia and English. Strong business acumen and ability to provide pragmatic legal solutions in complex environments.

jobs.title: ⁠⁠Penanggung Jawab Teknis (PJT)
jobs.description: Penanggung Jawab Teknis (PJT) - Kosmetik Impor Tanggung Jawab: Bertanggung jawab atas kepatuhan regulasi produk kosmetik sesuai ketentuan BPOM. Mengelola proses registrasi dan notifikasi produk kosmetik ke BPOM. Memastikan seluruh dokumen teknis dan legal produk lengkap dan sesuai persyaratan. Berkoordinasi dengan pabrik di luar negeri terkait dokumen teknis, spesifikasi produk, COA, MSDS, dan dokumen pendukung lainnya. Memastikan informasi pada label, kemasan, dan klaim produk sesuai dengan regulasi BPOM. Menjadi penanggung jawab teknis perusahaan dalam proses audit atau pemeriksaan dari BPOM. Memantau perubahan regulasi kosmetik dan memastikan perusahaan selalu mematuhi peraturan yang berlaku. Menangani keluhan kualitas produk dan melakukan tindak lanjut apabila diperlukan. Berkoordinasi dengan tim operasional, impor, dan quality assurance terkait produk yang dipasarkan. Kualifikasi: Minimal S1 Farmasi (Apoteker lebih diutamakan) sesuai ketentuan yang berlaku. Memiliki pengalaman dalam registrasi/notifikasi BPOM kosmetik menjadi nilai tambah. Memahami regulasi BPOM, CPKB, dan persyaratan kosmetik impor. Teliti, bertanggung jawab, dan memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik.

jobs.title: Drafter MEP
jobs.description: DIBUTUHKAN SEGERA Drafter MEP untuk di perusahaan Hachi Group bergerak di bidang FnB Restaurant. Penempatan area Tangerang Selatan (Office Hachi Group - Alam Sutera). Job Description: * Membuat dan mengembangkan gambar kerja/shop drawing MEP meliputi HVAC, Electrical, dan Plumbing sesuai kebutuhan proyek. * Menyusun gambar as-built drawing berdasarkan hasil pelaksanaan di lapangan. * Melakukan revisi gambar sesuai kondisi aktual proyek dan instruksi engineer/site team. * Membuat detail gambar instalasi seperti ducting, piping, cable tray, panel, dan supporting system lainnya. * Berkoordinasi dengan Engineer, Project Manager, dan tim lapangan untuk memastikan kesesuaian gambar dengan pelaksanaan. * Memastikan gambar sesuai standar teknis, spesifikasi, dan timeline proyek. * Mengarsipkan serta mengelola file drawing proyek dengan rapi dan sistematis. jobs.title: Marketing Admin
jobs.description: Marketing Admin Job Description Manage daily administrative tasks to support the Marketing team. Handle social media direct messages (DMs), respond to customer inquiries, and escalate issues when needed. Communicate and coordinate with external parties, including clients, vendors, partners, and suppliers, to support marketing activities. Maintain and update marketing documentation/database. Prepare quotations, invoices, reports, and other marketing-related documents. Coordinate with internal teams to ensure the smooth execution of marketing campaigns and operational activities. Assist in planning and executing promotional events, campaigns, and brand activations. Monitor customer feedback and provide timely follow-up to maintain excellent customer service. Ensure all marketing administration is accurate, organized, and completed on time.

jobs.title: Batam Regulatory Affairs Executive
jobs.description: Responsibilities: Maintain a deep understanding of medical device standards, especially ISO 13485, and the EU MDR (European Medical Device Regulations), FDA requirements and other national regulatory frameworks. Support the implementation and ongoing compliance of the Unique Device Identification (UDI) system Manage and control quality documents of external origin to support regulatory compliance activities across the Batam and Perth sites. Collaborate with Perth site to support the development and maintenance of risk management documentation and product classifications in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements. Prepare the necessary technical documentation for regulatory submissions, including Technical Files, PMA submissions, CE documentation, and other regulatory dossiers as required. Support Post-Market Surveillance (PMS) activities by collecting, analysing, and reporting post-market data, complaints, and adverse events to ensure timely and accurate submissions to regulatory authorities. Collaborate closely with the Perth Regulatory Manager and cross-functional teams to support regulatory submissions and compliance projects by gathering, analysing, and maintaining required data and documentation. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in a Science or Engineering discipline, preferably in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Pharmacy, or a related field. Proficiency in written and spoken English is a must. Minimum 3 years' experience in Regulatory Affairs or similar roles within a manufacturing industry (medical device, pharmaceutical, or other healthcare sectors preferred). Strong knowledge of chemistry, material science, and chemical compositions. Demonstrate a strong understanding of medical device regulations and standards such as ISO 13485, MDR, FDA CPAKB, with a proven track record of maintaining compliance. Experience conducting internal and external audits is highly desirable. Experience supporting Halal certification and relevant compliance activities is highly desirable. Experience supporting regulatory submissions and engaging with the Indonesian Ministry of Health and other international regulatory authorities is highly desirable. Willing to be placed in Batam.

jobs.title: Head of Infrastructure Delivery
jobs.description: About Samara Lombok Samara Lombok is a large-scale integrated resort and residential development on the south coast of Lombok, spanning Samara Bay and Samara Hills. Located approximately 25 minutes from Lombok International Airport and close to the Mandalika tourism zone, the development includes hotels, residential villas and the supporting infrastructure required for long-term operations. This role will lead the infrastructure backbone of the development, from active construction through to commissioning and operational handover. The Role Lead and be accountable for Samara Lombok's site-wide infrastructure function, from strategy and planning through to construction delivery, testing and handover. The role owns the infrastructure programme, budgets, contractor performance, quality, safety and risk across earthworks, roads, stormwater and drainage, retaining and slope works, and all site utilities, including electricity, water, CCTV and communications. The Head of Infrastructure will report directly to the Managing Director, Operations & Corporate Governance and work closely with the General Manager, Operations and the wider site team. Key Responsibilities Lead and be accountable for end-to-end delivery of civil infrastructure and utility packages, ensuring works are safe, timely and clearly sequenced against the masterplan. Lead technical review of surveys, designs, specifications and construction documentation for constructability, identifying conflicts, gaps and site risks before execution. Own the infrastructure programme and budget, tracking cost, progress, procurement dependencies and risk with QS, Finance and Procurement. Direct contractors and consultants across multiple work fronts, set clear deliverables and hold each party accountable for agreed outcomes. Set and enforce standards for quality control, HSE compliance, inspections, testing and disciplined record-keeping across all infrastructure works. Lead commissioning of electricity, water, CCTV and communications systems, ensuring each system is tested, documented and ready before handover. Build and lead the infrastructure team, maintain clear weekly reporting on programme, cost, risk and decisions, and oversee final close-out, as-built records, warranties and handover to Operations. What Success Looks Like The infrastructure programme runs safely and predictably, with clear priorities and decisive recovery action when delivery moves off track. Design gaps, constructability issues and site risks are identified early, before they become material delivery or cost issues. Contractors and consultants are actively managed, with reliable visibility of programme, cost, quality and risk. Completed assets are tested, documented and handed to Operations without unresolved critical defects. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management or a related discipline. Equivalent senior practical experience may also be considered. At least 10 years of infrastructure delivery experience, including a minimum of three years in a senior leadership role on complex, multi-package projects. Strong hands-on delivery experience across earthworks, roads, stormwater and drainage, retaining and slope works, and site utilities. Strong understanding of construction methods, geotechnical and structural risk, quality control, programme management and contractor performance. Demonstrated experience coordinating electrical, water, CCTV and communications packages. Experience in large land developments, resorts or remote project environments is an advantage. Professional working proficiency in English and Bahasa Indonesia. Proficient in MS Project or Primavera P6, with the ability to review AutoCAD and Civil 3D drawings and consultant calculations. Willing and able to be based full-time on-site in Lombok.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Manager (Retail Supermarket)
jobs.description: Peluang Karier yang Menantang Kami mencari Digital Marketing Manager yang berpengalaman dan inovatif untuk bergabung dengan tim kami di bidang Retail khusunya Supermarket. Dalam peran ini, Anda akan memainkan peran kunci dalam mengembangkan dan menerapkan strategi pemasaran digital yang komprehensif untuk memperluas jangkauan dan meningkatkan keterlibatan pelanggan kami di seluruh Sulawesi Utara. Kandidat yang ideal memiliki pemahaman mendalam tentang tren pemasaran digital, kemampuan analitis yang kuat, dan jiwa kepemimpinan untuk menginspirasi tim. Tanggung Jawab Utama Merancang dan mengimplementasikan strategi pemasaran digital yang efektif untuk meningkatkan brand awareness, pembangunan pelanggan, dan penjualan di pasar Kab. Kepl Sangihe hingga Sulawesi Utara. Menganalisis data kinerja dan perilaku pelanggan untuk membuat keputusan strategis dalam program Marketing. Menciptakan konten digital yang menarik dan memikat, termasuk gambar, video, dan materi lainnya. Memantau dan mengukur keberhasilan inisiatif marketing digital, melaporkan hasil, dan memberikan rekomendasi untuk perbaikan berkelanjutan. Mengidentifikasi tren industri dan peluang baru untuk meningkatkan traffic pengunjung. Mengelola anggaran pemasaran digital dan memastikan penggunaan yang efektif dan efisien dari sumber daya.

Production and Operations Management:

● Plan, organize, direct, and run optimum day-to-day production operations to exceed our customers’ expectations.
● Oversee the efficient operation and maintenance of the roll forming machinery and the Wagner painting line, ensuring minimal downtime and maximum output.
● Develop and implement production schedules, ensuring timely delivery of products to meet market demand.
● Monitor production metrics and KPIs, analyzing data to identify areas for improvement in efficiency and workflow.

Quality Assurance:
● Uphold and enhance quality control standards to ensure all products meet both internal and international quality benchmarks.
● Work in close collaboration with the quality control team to implement and monitor quality assurance protocols throughout the production process.
● Address any quality issues promptly and effectively, implementing corrective and preventive actions.

Cost Management and Optimization:
● Develop and manage the factory budget, ensuring all production activities are conducted within financial parameters.
● Continuously seek and implement strategies to reduce production costs without compromising product quality or safety.
● Manage inventory levels of raw materials and finished goods to optimize cash flow and minimize waste.

Team Leadership and Development:
● Lead, mentor, and develop the factory team, fostering a supportive and collaborative work environment that encourages high performance.
● Implement and oversee training programs for staff on new equipment, safety procedures, and quality standards.
● Ensure a safe working environment by enforcing health and safety regulations and promoting a culture of safety awareness.

Global Mindset and Strategic Contribution:
● Contribute to the company's global expansion strategy by ensuring the factory is capable of meeting international standards and production volumes.
● Collaborate with senior management on strategic planning, providing insights on production capabilities and potential for growth.
● Stay abreast of the latest manufacturing technologies and industry best practices to maintain a competitive edge.

Requirements
● Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
● A minimum of 3-5 years of experience in a factory management role, preferably within the manufacturing or logistics solutions industry.
● Essential: Proven hands-on experience with roll forming machinery and automated painting lines. Direct experience with Wagner painting systems will be a significant advantage.
● Demonstrable experience in implementing and managing quality control systems and achieving production efficiency improvements.
● Strong understanding of lean manufacturing principles and other continuous improvement methodologies.
● Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to motivate and guide a diverse team.
● A "global mindset" with an understanding of international quality standards and market expectations.
● Fluency in both Indonesian and English is highly desirable.
● A proactive and supportive management style, with a commitment to fostering a positive and productive work culture.

jobs.title: Senior Corporate Finance Accounting & Tax
jobs.description: Mememastikan seluruh proses pencatatan transaksi keuangan berjalan akurat dan tepat waktu. Melakukan jurnal, buku besar (general ledger), dan dokumen pendukung sebelum dilakukan posting. Melakukan rekonsiliasi atas akun bank, piutang, utang, persediaan, dan akun-akun neraca lainnya. Memastikan proses monthly closing berjalan sesuai timeline. Menyiapkan laporan keuangan bulanan, termasuk neraca, laba rugi, dan arus kas. Menyusun pelaporan pajak (PPN, PPh, dan lainnya), serta memastikan kepatuhan terhadap regulasi perpajakan. Menjalankan tugas tambahan lain yang diberikan oleh manajemen terkait fungsi akuntansi.

jobs.title: Back End Developer
jobs.description: Key Responsibilities Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable backend applications and services. Build, optimize, and maintain RESTful APIs to support web and mobile applications. Develop clean, efficient, secure, and maintainable code following industry best practices. Collaborate with Frontend Engineers, QA Engineers, Product Managers, and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality software solutions. Design and optimize database schemas, queries, and data models. Integrate third-party APIs and external services. Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve production issues in a timely manner. Optimize application performance, scalability, reliability, and security. Write unit tests, integration tests, and participate in code reviews to ensure code quality. Contribute to software architecture and technical design discussions. Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives. Maintain technical documentation for applications, APIs, and development processes. Monitor application health, logs, and system performance, and implement improvements when necessary. Continuously research and adopt new technologies, tools, and best practices to improve development efficiency.

jobs.description: Tugas dan Tanggung Jawab : Melaksanakan proses produksi sesuai dengan standar operasional prosedur (SOP) untuk mencapai target harian dan bulanan. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik. Mampu bekerja di bawah tekanan pada saat jam sibuk. Lokasi Penempatan : Palmerah, Jakarta Barat Sistem Kerja : Shift

jobs.title: MARKETING ACQUISITION CORPORATE B2B
jobs.description: Deskripsi Pekerjaan Kami membuka kesempatan bagi profesional yang berpengalaman untuk bergabung sebagai B2B Marketing / Business Development. Jobdesk Melakukan proses akuisisi klien B2B mulai dari prospecting, pendekatan, negosiasi hingga closing. Menyusun, mempersiapkan, dan mempresentasikan materi penawaran kepada klien. Menjalin serta menjaga hubungan baik dengan klien dan partner bisnis. Melakukan analisis target market dan monitoring pipeline penjualan. Kualifikasi Pendidikan minimal S1 Manajemen, Komunikasi, Public Relations, atau jurusan terkait dengan minimal IPK 3.00. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 1-2 tahun sebagai B2B Marketing / Business Development (Multifinance/Contact Center/Banking) Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi, negosiasi, dan presentasi yang baik. Menguasai Microsoft Office terutama Excel dan PowerPoint. Memiliki kemampuan problem solving, analisis, dan membangun relasi yang baik. Mampu berbahasa Inggris menjadi nilai tambah. Bersedia bekerja dengan sistem Work From Office (WFO) di Head Office SIM, Kebagusan, Jakarta Selatan.

jobs.title: Key Account Staff
jobs.description: Note: skema interview merupakan Offline Interview , pastikan Anda bersedia hadir di kantor kami. Kualifikasi: Pendidikan minimal S1 semua jurusan (diutamakan Manajemen, Bisnis, atau Marketing). Pengalaman minimal 1–2 tahun di posisi administrasi sales/key account Terampil mengolah data dan mengoperasikan Excel Teliti, rapi, dan mampu bekerja dengan tenggat waktu ketat Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan koordinasi yang baik Deskripsi Pekerjaan: Membantu eksekusi strategi dalam pencapaian target penjualan (revenue dan volume) di seluruh akun Modern Trade yang dikelola. Membangun dan memelihara hubungan kemitraan strategis jangka panjang dengan pihak Buyer. Menyiapkan data yang diperlukan dalam proses negosiasi Trading Terms dan promosi. Memantau status pembayaran serta berkoordinasi dengan tim Finance untuk memastikan kelancaran administrasi penagihan ke Buyer. Memberikan masukan, dan memproses pengajuan proposal promo reguler ke seluruh Buyer di channel Modern Trade. Melakukan pemantauan eksekusi promo secara langsung di lapangan untuk memastikan ketepatan display, harga promo, dan timeline. Mengawal proses pengajuan dan pencatatan produk baru (listing SKU). Membuat, mendistribusikan, dan memantau jadwal kunjungan Merchandiser. Memastikan tim Merchandiser disiplin menggunakan sistem CRM untuk pencatatan kehadiran, cek stok, penataan display, dan laporan harian. Mereview laporan kunjungan Merchandiser serta melakukan tindak lanjut langsung ke Buyer jika ditemukan kendala. Menjadi contact person bagi pihak Buyer. Menyusun laporan bulanan.

jobs.title: Daily Worker Accounting
jobs.description: Kami mencari Daily Worker Akuntansi untuk bergabung dengan tim Akari Ramen cabang Living World Mall Depasar. Tanggung Jawab Mencatat dan memproses transaksi keuangan harian dengan akurat dan tepat waktu sesuai dengan standar akuntansi yang berlaku. Mengelola akun pembelian, penjualan, dan pengeluaran operasional untuk memastikan kelengkapan dan keakuratan data. Mempersiapkan laporan keuangan bulanan, termasuk neraca saldo, buku besar, dan rekonsiliasi bank. Menverifikasi dan memproses invoice, kwitansi, dan dokumen keuangan lainnya sebelum pembayaran. Melakukan rekonsiliasi bank dan rekening kas untuk mengidentifikasi dan menyelesaikan perbedaan dengan segera. Mendukung proses audit internal dan eksternal dengan menyediakan dokumentasi dan informasi yang diperlukan. Membantu dalam penyusunan anggaran dan analisis varians keuangan untuk mendukung pengambilan keputusan manajemen. Menjaga kerahasiaan informasi keuangan dan mematuhi kebijakan keamanan data perusahaan. Persyaratan Pendidikan minimal Diploma (D3) atau Sarjana (S1) dalam bidang Akuntansi, Keuangan, atau disiplin ilmu terkait. Minimal 2 tahun pengalaman sebagai Staf Akuntansi atau posisi sejenis di perusahaan atau organisasi. Pemahaman yang kuat tentang prinsip-prinsip akuntansi dasar dan standar akuntansi Indonesia (SAI). Kemampuan menggunakan software akuntansi seperti MYOB, Accurate, Zahir, atau software akuntansi lainnya. Mahir dalam menggunakan Microsoft Excel dengan kemampuan membuat formula, pivot table, dan analisis data. Perhatian terhadap detail yang tinggi dengan kemampuan mengidentifikasi dan mengoreksi kesalahan akuntansi. Keterampilan organisasi yang baik dengan kemampuan mengelola multiple tasks dan deadline. Komunikasi yang efektif dalam bahasa Indonesia dan bahasa Inggris (komunikasi dasar) adalah nilai tambah. Integritas tinggi dan komitmen terhadap etika bisnis serta kepatuhan regulasi keuangan. Manfaat Gaji yang kompetitif sesuai dengan pengalaman dan kualifikasi Anda. Paket asuransi kesehatan yang komprehensif meliputi Anda dan keluarga. Tunjangan hari raya dan bonus kinerja berdasarkan pencapaian. Cuti tahunan yang memadai untuk memastikan keseimbangan kehidupan kerja. Lingkungan kerja yang profesional dan kolaboratif di lokasi strategis Denpasar. Peluang pengembangan karir melalui pelatihan dan program pengembangan keterampilan. Kesempatan untuk bekerja dengan tim yang berpengalaman dan saling mendukung. Tentang Kami Akari Ramen adalah restoran berkualitas yang berdedikasi untuk menyajikan hidangan autentik dengan standar layanan terbaik kepada pelanggan kami di Denpasar, Bali. Kami membangun bisnis yang berkelanjutan dengan mengedepankan integritas, profesionalisme, dan inovasi dalam setiap aspek operasional. Tim kami terdiri dari individu-individu berbakat yang berkomitmen pada keunggulan dan kepuasan pelanggan. Kami percaya bahwa kesuksesan bisnis kami dimulai dari tim yang kuat, terorganisir, dan termotivasi. Akari Ramen menawarkan lingkungan kerja yang inklusif di mana setiap anggota tim dihargai dan memiliki kesempatan untuk berkembang dan berkontribusi pada pertumbuhan bersama. Lamar Sekarang Jika Anda memiliki kualifikasi yang sesuai dan antusias untuk bergabung dengan tim Akari Ramen, kami mengundang Anda untuk mengirimkan lamaran dengan CV, surat motivasi, dan referensi terbaru Anda. Jangan lewatkan kesempatan ini untuk menjadi bagian dari tim kami yang dinamis dan berkembang!

jobs.title: SEO Specialist (In-House + Client Accounts)
jobs.description: We’re hiring an SEO Specialist to drive organic growth for our in-house projects while managing a small portfolio of client accounts. This role requires someone who can independently execute across SEO, AEO, and GEO, and continuously adapt to the evolving search landscape, including AI-driven platforms. Key Responsibilities Plan and execute strategies across SEO, AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) Perform keyword research, search intent analysis, and content planning Conduct technical audits and implement improvements (site structure, speed, indexing, crawlability) Optimize content for both traditional search engines and AI-driven search (LLMs, answer engines) Manage on-page SEO (metadata, internal linking, structured data) Execute sustainable link-building strategies Track and report performance (traffic, rankings, conversions, visibility in AI search where applicable) Collaborate with content, design, and development teams Stay ahead of algorithm updates, search trends, and AI developments Requirements 3–5 years hands-on experience in SEO (agency or in-house) Proactive learner — keeps up with SEO, AI, and industry changes Strong knowledge of tools: Ahrefs / SEMrush, GA4, Google Search Console Solid understanding of technical SEO (basic HTML/CSS/JS is a plus) Hands-on familiarity with AEO & GEO concepts (e.g. optimizing for featured snippets, AI answers, LLM visibility) Experience or strong interest in AI-driven search (e.g. ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity) Able to manage multiple projects independently Analytical, detail-oriented, and results-driven Clear communicator — able to explain strategy and insights

jobs.title: Marcom Manager

This role is responsible for strengthening brand awareness, driving customer engagement, and supporting business growth through effective communication strategies and marketing initiatives. The ideal candidate has strong experience in marketing campaign management, cross-functional coordination, and brand communication within a fast-paced retail, fashion, or consumer-focused environment. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute integrated marketing communication strategies aligned with business objectives and brand positioning. Plan, manage, and oversee marketing campaigns across digital, retail, promotional, and offline channels. Coordinate campaign execution with internal stakeholders including Creative, E-Commerce, Merchandising, Retail Operations, Customer Experience, and Product teams. Manage annual marketing calendars, campaign timelines, launch schedules, and promotional activities. Monitor campaign performance and analyze key marketing metrics to identify opportunities for improvement and optimization. Collaborate with external partners, agencies, media, event organizers, and vendors to ensure successful campaign delivery. Ensure consistency of brand messaging and communication across all customer touchpoints. Support product launches, seasonal collections, retail promotions, and special marketing initiatives. Manage departmental priorities, budgets, and resources to maximize marketing effectiveness and return on investment. Lead, mentor, and develop the Marketing Communications team to achieve departmental goals and professional growth. Requirements Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Communications, Business Administration, Advertising, Public Relations, or a related field. Minimum 5 years of experience in Marketing Communications, Brand Marketing, Campaign Management, or Integrated Marketing, with at least 3 years in a managerial role. Strong understanding of marketing strategy, campaign planning, consumer behavior, and brand communication. Proven experience managing multi-channel marketing campaigns from concept through execution and evaluation. Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign performance data and generate actionable insights. Experience working with creative teams, digital marketing teams, agencies, and external partners. Excellent project management, stakeholder management, and communication skills. Experience in fashion retail, lifestyle brands, FMCG, beauty, or e-commerce industries is highly preferred. Good command of English, both written and spoken. Why Join Us? Join a growing fashion retail company with ambitious expansion plans. Lead impactful marketing campaigns that directly influence brand growth and customer engagement. Collaborate with talented professionals across marketing, creative, product, and commercial functions. Opportunity to contribute to the development of a strong and recognizable fashion brand. Work Location Kebayoran Lama, South Jakarta, Indonesia

jobs.title: Recruitment Specialist
jobs.description: Tanggung Jawab Utama Mengidentifikasi dan merekrut kandidat potensial melalui berbagai saluran perekrutan, termasuk job portal, media sosial, networking, dan referensi internal. Melakukan screening awal dan wawancara untuk mengevaluasi kualifikasi dan kesesuaian kandidat dengan persyaratan posisi. Berkolaborasi dengan departemen terkait untuk memahami kebutuhan spesifik posisi yang akan diisi dan profile kandidat ideal. Mengelola proses perekrutan dari posting lowongan kerja hingga tahap penawaran dan onboarding. Memelihara database kandidat yang komprehensif dan mengorganisir informasi pelamar dengan sistematis. Berkomunikasi secara efektif dengan kandidat, memberikan feedback yang konstruktif dan memastikan pengalaman perekrutan yang positif. Melakukan analisis tren pasar kerja dan competitive intelligence untuk strategi perekrutan yang lebih efektif. Membantu dalam pengembangan job description dan posting yang menarik untuk berbagai posisi. Melaporkan metrik perekrutan dan menganalisis efektivitas strategi perekrutan yang dijalankan. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Minimal Diploma (D3) atau Sarjana (S1) di bidang Manajemen Sumber Daya Manusia, Manajemen, Komunikasi, Psikologi, atau bidang terkait. Minimal 2-3 tahun pengalaman kerja sebagai Recruitment Specialist, HR Officer, atau posisi sejenis di bidang perekrutan. Pemahaman mendalam tentang proses perekrutan end-to-end dan best practices industri dalam perekrutan. Keterampilan komunikasi verbal dan tertulis yang sangat baik dalam bahasa Indonesia dan Inggris. Kemampuan untuk melakukan wawancara yang efektif dan mengevaluasi kemampuan kandidat secara objektif. Keahlian dalam menggunakan berbagai platform perekrutan online, aplikasi ATS (Applicant Tracking System), dan tools HR modern. Keterampilan interpersonal yang kuat dengan kemampuan membangun hubungan baik dengan kandidat dan stakeholder internal. Kemampuan manajemen waktu yang baik dan dapat menangani multiple recruitments secara bersamaan. Pengetahuan tentang peraturan ketenagakerjaan Indonesia dan compliance dalam proses perekrutan. Pengalaman dalam perekrutan di industri properti atau real estate dianggap sebagai nilai tambah.

jobs.title: Workshop Manager - Plantation - Sumatra (B-132791)
jobs.description: About The Company: The working venue is in South Sumatra. Our client is a Plantation (Timber) Company . Currently, they are looking for Workshop Manager. Job Responsibilities: Manage day-to-day workshop operations for heavy equipment, logging trucks, and operational vehicles. Plan and execute preventive, corrective, and breakdown maintenance activities. Ensure equipment availability and reliability meet operational targets. Monitor maintenance schedules and ensure timely completion of repair work. Diagnose equipment failures and implement effective troubleshooting and corrective actions. Supervise workshop supervisors, mechanics, electricians, and technicians. Monitor maintenance KPIs, including equipment downtime, MTBF (Mean Time Between Failures), MTTR (Mean Time to Repair), and maintenance costs. Manage spare parts inventory and coordinate procurement activities. Control maintenance expenses in accordance with approved budgets. Coordinate with Operations and Planning teams to prioritize equipment maintenance. Ensure compliance with HSE regulations and company maintenance standards. Prepare maintenance reports, equipment performance analysis, and management presentations. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to improve equipment reliability and workshop productivity. Maintain accurate maintenance records using ERP or maintenance management systems. Perform other responsibilities as assigned. Job Requirements: Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Heavy Equipment Engineering, or a related field. High conversational English proficiency. At least 3 years of experience as a Workshop Manager within the forestry, mining, heavy equipment, construction, plantation, or similar industries, with experience managing maintenance for heavy equipment, logging trucks, and operational vehicles. Strong knowledge of preventive, corrective, and breakdown maintenance, hydraulic systems, electrical systems, diesel engines, powertrain, braking systems, and suspension systems. Experience in spare parts management, inventory control, and maintenance cost control, with strong equipment troubleshooting and reliability improvement skills. Proficient in Microsoft Office and ERP/CMMS systems. Willing to be based in remote operational areas. Good leadership, communication, coordination, and decision-making skills, with the ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities. jobs.title: Cook
jobs.description: Cook CLAY Bali — Ubud CLAY Bali is a new premium restaurant and lounge opening in Ubud. Our food concept is inspired by the Silk Road, open fire, tandoor, clay pots, spices, sharing dishes, and warm hospitality. We are looking for motivated and disciplined Cooks / Line Cooks to join our kitchen team during the pre-opening stage and continue working with us after the restaurant launch. Main Responsibilities Prepare and cook dishes according to recipes and kitchen standards. Work on assigned kitchen stations. Follow preparation lists, portion standards, and plating instructions. Maintain consistent taste, quality, and presentation. Support daily mise en place. Check the quality and freshness of ingredients. Follow food safety, hygiene, and storage standards. Label and store products correctly. Control food waste and report damaged or missing products. Maintain cleanliness and organization of the workstation. Use kitchen equipment safely and correctly. Participate in menu testing, training, and mock service. Work closely with the Sous Chef, Brand Chef, and other kitchen team members. Support receiving, checking, and storing kitchen products when required. Complete opening and closing checklists. Inform the Sous Chef immediately about shortages, equipment problems, or quality issues. Kitchen Stations We are looking for cooks who can work in one or several areas: hot kitchen; cold kitchen; prep; grill and open fire; tandoor and bread; clay-pot dishes; sauces; pastry and desserts. Experience in more than one station will be a strong advantage. Key Requirements Previous experience as a Cook or Line Cook. Restaurant, hotel, or professional kitchen experience. Good basic knowledge of food preparation and kitchen operations. Ability to follow recipes and instructions accurately. Strong attention to cleanliness and hygiene. Ability to work quickly and remain organized during busy service. Good teamwork and communication skills. Discipline, punctuality, and responsibility. Willingness to learn new techniques and recipes. Ability to work flexible shifts, weekends, and public holidays. Basic English is preferred. Based in Bali or ready to work in Ubud. The Right Candidate We are looking for someone who: takes pride in the quality of every dish; keeps the workstation clean and organized; follows recipes and portion standards; works calmly under pressure; respects ingredients and avoids unnecessary waste; communicates clearly with the kitchen team; is willing to learn and grow; understands that consistency is as important as creativity; takes responsibility for the final result. Reporting Line The Cook / Line Cook will report to: Sous Chef; Brand Chef; Kitchen Management Team. Main Result of the Position Every dish must be: prepared according to the approved recipe; consistent in taste and portion; presented according to Clay standards; served on time; produced in a clean, safe, and organized kitchen. To Apply Please send: your updated CV; your current location; your kitchen experience; the kitchen stations you have worked on; your expected salary; your earliest possible starting date; your availability to come to Ubud for an interview or trial shift. Location: Ubud, Bali Employment type: Full-time Position: Cook / Line Cook Company: CLAY Bali

jobs.title: Production Manager
jobs.description: Kualifikasi Bachelor's degree in Food Technology, Industrial Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or a related field. Minimum 5 years of experience in production, with at least 2 years in a Production Manager role within the Food & Beverage or food manufacturing industry. Strong understanding of production planning, capacity planning, and inventory management. In-depth knowledge of GMP, HACCP, Halal standards, Food Safety Management Systems, and Occupational Health & Safety (OHS). Proven leadership, problem-solving, analytical thinking, and decision-making skills. Experienced in monitoring and analyzing production KPIs, productivity, yield, waste, OEE, and production costs. Proficient in Microsoft Office, especially Excel; experience with ERP systems is an advantage. Able to work in a fast-paced environment and effectively lead cross-functional teams. Job Description Plan, manage, and oversee all production operations to ensure targets for quality, quantity, cost, and delivery are achieved. Ensure all production activities comply with established SOPs, GMP, HACCP, Halal requirements, and food safety standards. Monitor production output, raw material utilization, labor productivity, and operational efficiency. Collaborate with PPIC, Purchasing, Warehouse, Quality Assurance (QA), Quality Control (QC), and Engineering teams to ensure smooth production processes. Analyze production performance, including KPIs such as output, yield, waste, downtime, OEE, and manufacturing costs, and implement improvement initiatives. Identify operational issues and develop corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) to improve productivity and efficiency. Lead, coach, develop, and evaluate production teams to enhance performance and capability. Ensure the availability and optimal performance of production equipment through close coordination with the Engineering and Maintenance teams. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly production reports for management review and decision-making. Manage the production budget and drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize productivity, quality, and cost efficiency.

jobs.title: MAINTENANCE & FLEET SUPERVISOR
jobs.description: Tentang Posisi PT Buana Megah Paper Mills membuka kesempatan bagi profesional berpengalaman untuk bergabung sebagai Maintenance & Fleet Supervisor yang bertanggung jawab mengelola operasional bengkel, perawatan armada kendaraan operasional, serta alat berat perusahaan agar selalu dalam kondisi prima, aman, dan siap digunakan untuk mendukung kelancaran operasional perusahaan. Posisi ini akan memimpin tim teknisi dan pengemudi, memastikan seluruh kegiatan preventive maupun corrective maintenance berjalan sesuai standar perusahaan, serta mengawasi efisiensi biaya operasional armada. Tanggung Jawab Utama Mengelola operasional workshop/bengkel kendaraan perusahaan. Menyusun dan mengawasi jadwal preventive maintenance serta corrective maintenance kendaraan operasional dan alat berat. Memastikan seluruh armada selalu dalam kondisi layak jalan dan memenuhi standar keselamatan kerja. Mengatur pembagian pekerjaan teknisi sesuai kompetensi masing-masing. Memimpin, membina, mengevaluasi, serta mengembangkan kinerja tim teknisi dan pengemudi. Melakukan analisis kerusakan kendaraan dan menentukan tindakan perbaikan yang efektif. Mengontrol penggunaan sparepart, stok gudang bengkel, serta kebutuhan pengadaan suku cadang. Melakukan monitoring konsumsi BBM kendaraan dan alat berat serta menganalisis efisiensi penggunaannya. Membuat laporan operasional workshop, biaya maintenance, downtime kendaraan, dan pencapaian KPI. Berkoordinasi dengan departemen terkait untuk memastikan kebutuhan kendaraan operasional terpenuhi. Kualifikasi Pendidikan minimal D3 Teknik Mesin, Teknik Otomotif, atau jurusan yang relevan. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 5 tahun sebagai Supervisor Workshop, Fleet Supervisor, Maintenance Supervisor, atau posisi sejenis. Memahami sistem mesin diesel maupun bensin. Memahami sistem kelistrikan kendaraan dan diagnosa kerusakan. Berpengalaman menangani armada kendaraan operasional perusahaan maupun alat berat. Memiliki kemampuan leadership dan people management yang baik. Mampu menyusun jadwal maintenance kendaraan. Memiliki kemampuan problem solving dan analytical thinking yang baik. Terbiasa bekerja dengan target KPI. Menguasai Microsoft Office terutama Microsoft Excel. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik dan mampu bekerja lintas departemen. Nilai Tambah Memahami preventive maintenance system. Memiliki pengalaman mengelola workshop perusahaan manufaktur. Memahami pengelolaan sparepart dan inventory maintance kendaraan. Memiliki pengalaman mengelola unit kendaraan operasional. Memahami prinsip K3 dan keselamatan kerja.

jobs.title: Videografer & Social Media Specialist
jobs.description: Tanggung Jawab Mengelola akun media sosial perusahaan (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook dan Youtube). Menyusun kalender konten bulanan. Membuat caption, copywriting, dan ide konten kreatif. Berkolaborasi dengan tim desain dan marketing untuk menghasilkan konten yang menarik. Memantau tren media sosial dan menerapkannya pada strategi konten. Menganalisis performa konten menggunakan tools analytics. Meningkatkan engagement, followers, dan awareness brand. Menangani interaksi dengan audiens melalui komentar dan pesan. Kualifikasi Minimal SMA/SMK, D3, atau S1 semua jurusan. Memahami platform media sosial dan algoritmanya. Mampu membuat copywriting yang menarik dan persuasif. Kreatif, inovatif, dan mengikuti tren digital terkini. Menguasai Canva, CapCut, atau aplikasi editing dasar menjadi nilai tambah. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik. Berpengalaman sebagai Social Media Specialist minimal 1 tahun (fresh graduate dipersilakan melamar jika memiliki portofolio). Mengoptimalkan iklan pada platform seperti Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram), TikTok Ads, dan platform lainnya.

jobs.title: Content Creator & Videographer (In House)
jobs.description: Kesempatan PT. Cisitu Indah Lestari mencari seorang Content Creator & Videographer berbakat dan bersemangat untuk bergabung dengan tim kami di Bandung, Jawa Barat. Dalam peran ini, anda harus mampu menghasilkan konten menarik untuk berbagai platform digital, khususnya instagram, Tiktok, Facebook, youtube dll. Anda akan bekerja secara full-time (In House) bersama tim marketing untuk mengembangkan strategi digital dan membangun branding perusahaan. Tanggung Jawab Membuat konsep konten yang kreatif dan menarik untuk media sosial ataupun keperluan internal perusahaan. Melakukan pengambilan foto dan video proyek, event, maupun aktivitas perusahaan. Mengedit video menggunakan Capcut, Adobe Premiere Pro, atau software sejenis. Membuat konten Instagram Reels, Tiktok, Facebook, Youtube dl. Mengikuti tren media sosial dan mengembangkan ide konten yang relevan. Berkoloborasi dengan tim marketing dalam campaign, launching produk, dan evenet perusahaan. Menyusun kalender konten dan memastikan target konten mingguan maupun bulanan tercapai. Sesekali menjadi talent atau voice over unutk kebutuhan konten apabila diperlukan. Mengoptimalkan konten untuk berbagai platform media sosial dan digital channel, memahami spesifikasi teknis dan best practices setiap platform. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Usia 18 - 35 tahun. Pendidikan minimal SMA/SMK. Wajib bekerja secara Full-Time (In House) Aktif menggunakan TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, dan platform media sosial lainnya. Menguasai teknik pengambilan foto dan video menggunakan smartphone maupun kamera. Menguasasi software editing seperti CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, atau aplikasi sejenis. Kreatif, komunikatif, percaya diri, dan mampu bekerja dalam tim. Memiliki portofolio foto dan video menjadi nilai tambah. Berdomisili di bandung dan sekitarnya lebih diutamakan. Manfaat Utama Perusahaan Kesempatan untuk mengembangkan portfolio kreatif yang kuat dengan karya-karya yang dipublikasikan secara luas. Kesempatan mengembangkan kemampuan di bidang content creation dan digital marketing. Lingkungan kerja yang kolaboratif dan mendukung kreativitas serta inovasi. Terlibat langsung dalam berbagai proyek branding perusahaan. Jenjang karir yang jelas seiring perkembangan perusahaan. Fleksibilitas dalam proses kreatif dengan dukungan penuh dari tim marketing dan leadership. Tentang Kami PT. Cisitu Indah Lestari adalah perusahaan yang berkomitmen untuk memberikan solusi pemasaran dan komunikasi yang inovatif dan bermakna. Kami percaya pada kekuatan storytelling visual dan konten kreatif untuk membangun koneksi emosional dengan audiens. Dengan tim yang passionate dan berpengalaman, kami terus berinovasi dalam menciptakan kampanye yang tidak hanya menarik perhatian, tetapi juga menghasilkan dampak bisnis yang nyata. Budaya perusahaan kami mendorong kreativitas, kolaborasi, dan pertumbuhan profesional. Kami mencari talenta-talenta terbaik yang tidak hanya memiliki keterampilan teknis, tetapi juga memiliki semangat untuk menciptakan karya yang bermakna dan memberikan nilai tambah bagi organisasi kami. Lamar Sekarang Jika Anda merasa memiliki passion dalam videografi dan content creation, serta ingin berkontribusi pada tim kreatif kami, kami mengundang Anda untuk mengirimkan aplikasi Anda. Sertakan portofolio atau link ke karya-karya terbaik Anda, serta CV yang mendetail. Kami tidak sabar untuk mengenal Anda dan melihat bagaimana Anda dapat membawa energi kreatif baru ke tim kami di PT. Cisitu Indah Lestari!

  1. Kesempatan untuk mengembangkan portfolio kreatif yang kuat dengan karya-karya yang dipublikasikan secara luas.

  2. Kesempatan mengembangkan kemampuan di bidang content creation dan digital marketing.

  3. Lingkungan kerja yang kolaboratif dan mendukung kreativitas serta inovasi.

  4. Terlibat langsung dalam berbagai proyek branding perusahaan.

Tentang Kami
PT. Cisitu Indah Lestari adalah perusahaan yang berkomitmen untuk memberikan solusi pemasaran dan komunikasi yang inovatif dan bermakna. Kami percaya pada kekuatan storytelling visual dan konten kreatif untuk membangun koneksi emosional dengan audiens. Dengan tim yang passionate dan berpengalaman, kami terus berinovasi dalam menciptakan kampanye yang tidak hanya menarik perhatian, tetapi juga menghasilkan dampak bisnis yang nyata. Budaya perusahaan kami mendorong kreativitas, kolaborasi, dan pertumbuhan profesional. Kami mencari talenta-talenta terbaik yang tidak hanya memiliki keterampilan teknis, tetapi juga memiliki semangat untuk menciptakan karya yang bermakna dan memberikan nilai tambah bagi organisasi kami.

Lamar Sekarang
Jika Anda merasa memiliki passion dalam videografi dan content creation, serta ingin berkontribusi pada tim kreatif kami, kami mengundang Anda untuk mengirimkan aplikasi Anda. Sertakan portofolio atau link ke karya-karya terbaik Anda, serta CV yang mendetail. Kami tidak sabar untuk mengenal Anda dan melihat bagaimana Anda dapat membawa energi kreatif baru ke tim kami di PT. Cisitu Indah Lestari!

jobs.description: Accountant / Chief Accountant CLAY Bali — Ubud CLAY Bali is a new premium restaurant and lounge opening in Ubud. We are currently in the pre-opening stage and are building a strong finance team for the launch and future operations of the restaurant. We are looking for an experienced Accountant / Chief Accountant who will be responsible for accounting and tax compliance, financial discipline, document control, and accurate and timely reporting. Main Responsibilities Maintain full accounting and tax records for the restaurant. Manage accounting operations across multiple legal entities. Correctly allocate income and expenses between legal entities. Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports. Control the accuracy of all payments and accounting transactions. Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable. Monitor bank accounts and perform bank reconciliations. Control cash transactions and petty cash. Prepare and verify payroll. Control service charge, tips, overtime, and other staff payments. Coordinate with Indonesian tax authorities and external tax consultants. Monitor tax deadlines and ensure timely submission of reports. Verify invoices, receipts, contracts, delivery notes, and other financial documents. Control expenses against the approved budget. Support the preparation of cash flow, P&L, budgets, and management reports. Review purchasing documentation and supplier payments. Work closely with the Purchasing Manager, Storekeeper, and department heads. Participate in and control inventory counts. Monitor food cost, beverage cost, and operating expenses. Manage the financial side of the POS system. Perform daily sales reconciliation. Organize and maintain the financial document archive. Prepare reports for the CFO, General Manager, and Owner. Identify financial risks, discrepancies, and missing documentation. Build a transparent and disciplined accounting system for the restaurant. Key Requirements Previous experience as an Accountant, Chief Accountant, or Senior Accountant. Practical accounting experience in Indonesia. Strong knowledge of Indonesian accounting and tax regulations. Experience dealing with Indonesian tax authorities and tax consultants. Experience in restaurants, hotels, or hospitality is strongly preferred. Experience working with multiple legal entities or business divisions. Practical experience with: P&L; cash flow; budgeting; payroll; tax reporting; inventory control; food cost; beverage cost. Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills. Experience with accounting software and POS systems. Experience with iiko will be an advantage. Ability to prepare management reports independently. Strong attention to detail. Good analytical and organizational skills. High level of responsibility, honesty, and confidentiality. Fluent Bahasa Indonesia. Good written and spoken English. Based in Bali or ready to work in Ubud. The Right Candidate We are looking for someone who: understands the financial logic of a restaurant, not only data entry; controls the completeness and accuracy of all documents; does not process payments without proper approval; identifies tax and financial risks in advance; can restore, organize, and structure historical financial data; correctly separates expenses between legal entities; can work effectively in a pre-opening environment; respects deadlines; can build an accounting system from the ground up; prepares clear and understandable reports for management; takes responsibility for the final result. Reporting Line The Accountant / Chief Accountant will report to the Chief Financial Officer (CFO) and work closely with: General Manager; Owner; Purchasing Manager; Storekeeper; Restaurant Manager; Brand Chef; Head Bartender; Operations and Facility; external tax consultants. Main Result of the Position The accounting and financial system of CLAY must be: transparent; properly documented; tax compliant; timely; controlled; clear to the CFO, General Manager, and Owner. All payments, income, expenses, taxes, payroll, invoices, and bank transactions must be accurately recorded, reviewed, and supported by proper documentation. To Apply Please send: your updated CV; your current location; your accounting experience; your experience as a Chief Accountant or Senior Accountant; your experience in restaurants or hospitality; your experience with multiple legal entities; the accounting and POS systems you have worked with; your expected salary; your earliest possible starting date. Location: Ubud, Bali Employment type: Full-time Position: Accountant / Chief Accountant Company: CLAY Bali

jobs.description: Tanggung Jawab Mengembangkan dashboard Business Intelligence menggunakan Tableau untuk menjalankan project transformation PO Sales. Mengembangkan aplikasi web berbasis PHP Laravel. Membuat API untuk integrasi antar aplikasi. Melakukan maintenance, troubleshooting, debugging, dan enhancement terhadap aplikasi maupun dashboard yang telah berjalan. Kualifikasi Pendidikan minimal S1 Teknik Informatika, Sistem Informasi, Ilmu Komputer, atau bidang terkait. Minimal 3 tahun pengalaman pada bidang Business Intelligence dan Web Application Development. Mampu melakukan analisis kebutuhan bisnis dan menerjemahkannya menjadi dashboard yang informatif. Menguasai MySQL secara mendalam seperti : Complex SQL Query, Join Table, Subquery, Stored Procedure, View. Mampu membangun dan memelihara proses ETL (Extract, Transform, Load). Memiliki pengalaman melakukan integrasi data dari berbagai sumber (Database, API, CSV, Excel, Web Service, ERP, dan lainnya). Menguasai bahasa pemrograman PHP. Memahami konsep MVC (Model View Controller), REST API. Mampu melakukan maintenance, debugging, enhancement, dan pengembangan aplikasi berbasis Laravel. Memiliki pengalaman integrasi dengan ERP melalui API, Web Service, atau FTP. Memahami Linux Server dan Apache/Nginx menjadi nilai tambah. Memahami Docker menjadi nilai tambah. Memiliki kemampuan problem solving dan bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim serta berorientasi pada hasil. Bersedia bekerja 6 hari hari kerja

jobs.title: Team Leader Promoter
jobs.description: Job Description Menyusun forecast mingguan tim promoter berdasarkan target bulanan, melakukan daily briefing, serta melakukan tracking performa promoter secara harian (format Excel). Memvalidasi data penjualan setiap hari dan memperbarui SOH (Stock On Hand) tiap toko, serta memastikan kesiapan stok minimal PC dan Print di setiap toko. Memberikan coaching dan training mingguan bersama Trainer serta mendorong keterampilan upsell/cross-sell dan aktivitas media sosial promoter. Memastikan eksekusi merchandising sesuai planogram HP: penempatan POSM, visibility produk HP di area utama, kebersihan area, dan kesiapan unit demo. Bernegosiasi dengan pemilik/PIC toko untuk aktivitas in-store dan penempatan visibility guna meningkatkan penjualan, serta membangun hubungan baik dengan store owner dan staf toko. Memimpin weekly review (hari Rabu) bersama Tim HP: mengevaluasi pencapaian promoter, mengidentifikasi store/promoter issue (below runrate), dan menyusun action plan.
